lsp.query: Ich möchte die Präsidentin bitten, der Regierung in Ankara gegenüber unsere Sorge über diesen Vorfall sowie unsere Hoffnung, dass dieser bedauerliche Vorfall die Lösung des Zypernproblems und die wieder aufgenommenen Friedensverhandlungen nicht beeinträchtigen möge, wie wir auch hoffen, dass Herr Tsiakourmas so schnell wie möglich wieder auf freien Fuß gesetzt wird.
lsp.judge: I would like to ask the President to convey our concern about this incident to the government in Ankara, and to express our hope that this regrettable incident does not impair the solution of the Cyprus problem and the resumed peace negotiations, as we also hope for Mr. Tsiakourmas to be set free as soon as possible.

lsp.query: Zudem lehnt es Herr Denktasch, der Führer "Nord-Zyperns ", das - nur zur Erinnerung - unter türkischer Besatzung steht, ab, an weiteren Gesprächen zur Lösung des Zypernproblems teilzunehmen. Offensichtlich fühlt er sich weitaus stärker als je zuvor, nachdem die Europäische Union die Türkei ohne langes Nachdenken, wie ich meine, in den Kreis der EU-Beitrittskandidaten aufgenommen hat.
lsp.judge: Moreover, Mr. Denktash, the leader of "Northern Cyprus," which, as a reminder, is under Turkish occupation, refuses to participate in further talks aimed at solving the Cyprus problem. Clearly, he feels much stronger than ever before, after the European Union admitted Turkey, without much hesitation, as I see it, into the circle of EU candidate countries.

lsp.query: Diese zukünftige soziale Gemeinschaft bildet die Grundlage der Gemeinsamen Agrarpolitik, für die wir die Niederlassungsbeihilfe und die zusätzlichen Investitionshilfen verstärken müssen, hauptsächlich in jenen strukturschwachen Regionen mit zahlreichen stillgelegten Betrieben und verlassenen Dörfern, wo die jungen Leute die ländliche Wirtschaft wieder ankurbeln können, und zwar durch die Entwicklung von neuartigen Produkten wie dem Agrotourismus, dem ländlichen Tourismus von regionaler Bedeutung oder durch die Wiederansiedlung von Tier- und Pflanzenarten in diesen Naturräumen, womit ein Beitrag zu einer nachhaltigen und dauerhaften Entwicklung der Region geleistet wird.
lsp.judge: This future social community forms the basis for the Common Agricultural Policy, for which we must strengthen the investment support and additional investment aids, primarily in those structurally weak regions with numerous closed-down businesses and abandoned villages, where young people can revitalize rural economy through the development of new products such as agrotourism, regional rural tourism, or by reintroducing animal and plant species in these natural areas, thereby making a contribution to a sustainable and lasting regional development.
lsp.proxy: This future social community forms the basis of the Common Agricultural Policy, for which we must strengthen the settlement aid and additional investment aid, mainly in those structurally weak regions with numerous closed businesses and abandoned villages, where young people can revive the rural economy by developing new products such as agrotourism, rural tourism of regional significance or by re-establishing animal and plant species in these natural areas, thus contributing to sustainable and lasting development of the region.

lsp.query: In den Schlussfolgerungen zu ihrer Mitteilung führt die Kommission u. a. folgende Prioritäten auf: verbesserte Kohärenz unter den verschiedenen Zielen, die die GFP verfolgt, wie etwa die Erhaltung der Ressourcen, die Wirtschaftlichkeit der Fischereiflotten und die Arbeitsplatzsicherung in Gebieten, die von der Fischerei abhängig sind; Berücksichtigung der wirtschaftlichen Dimension der Fischereibewirtschaftung; verbesserte Integration der Umwelt- und der Fischereipolitik; Verbesserung der Bewirtschaftungsinstrumente, wie beispielsweise die mehrjährigen Bewirtschaftungsziele und -pläne, die Steuerung des Fischereiaufwands und die vollständige Integration des Mittelmeerraums in die Bewirtschaftungsregelung der Gemeinschaft; ein übersichtlicherer Entscheidungsfindungsprozess und die Erhaltung der externen Dimension der GFP.
lsp.judge: In the conclusions of their communication, the Commission highlights the following priorities: improved coherence among the various objectives pursued by the Common Fisheries Policy (CFP), such as the conservation of resources, the economic viability of fishing fleets, and job security in regions dependent on fisheries; consideration of the economic dimension of fisheries management; improved integration of environmental and fisheries policies; better management tools, such as multi-annual management plans and objectives, the regulation of fishing effort, and the full integration of the Mediterranean into the Community's management regulation; a more transparent decision-making process and the maintenance of the external dimension of the CFP.

lsp.judge: I thank Mr. Solana and also the Commission explicitly for being willing to inform the European Parliament so that we can reach our final judgment at an appropriate time, thereby ensuring safety for our citizens and our soldiers and securing the credibility of our military operations necessary for the realization of human rights also in the future.

lsp.query: Frau Präsidentin, zunächst möchte ich der Kommission, dem Rat und dem Hohen Vertreter der GASP für ihre Bereitschaft zur Teilnahme an einer Aussprache zu diesem Thema danken und Herrn Solana versichern, dass es hier nicht darum geht, erneut eine längst geführte Diskussion über die Gründe des Eingreifens im ehemaligen Jugoslawien zu entfachen; das wäre nicht richtig, auch weil nun eine ganz andere Situation besteht.

lsp.query: Wir reden nicht über den letzten Beweis, und als wir in diesem Haus über unsere eigene Gesundheit und über BSE gesprochen haben, da waren wir uns auch alle einig, dass das Vorsorgeprinzip gilt, obwohl wir niemals den direkten Beweis führen konnten, dass infiziertes Material zu der neuen Variante der Creutzfeldt-Jacob-Krankheit führt.
lsp.judge: We are not talking about the final proof, and when we discussed our own health and BSE in this house, we were all agreed that the precautionary principle applies, even though we could never provide direct proof that infected material leads to the new variant of Creutzfeldt-Jacob disease.

lsp.query: Herr Präsident, es gibt zwei Gruppen von Personen, gegenüber denen wir eine besondere Verantwortung haben: Das sind zum einen die Jugendlichen, die auf verdienstvolle Art und Weise an den Militäroperationen in Bosnien und im Kosovo beteiligt waren, und natürlich ihre Familienangehörigen, sowie zum anderen die Empfänger dieser Friedensmissionen, d. h. die Bevölkerung der Balkanländer.
lsp.judge: Mr. President, there are two groups of people towards whom we have a special responsibility: on the one hand, the young people who participated in military operations in Bosnia and Kosovo in a worthy manner, and of course their family members, as well as on the other hand, the recipients of these peace missions, that is, the population of the Balkan countries.

lsp.query: Bei allen Kontakten mit der Demokratischen Volksrepublik Korea hat die Union ihre überaus große Beunruhigung im Hinblick auf die schweren Menschenrechtsverletzungen in diesem Land betont. Das betrifft auch die Anzahl politischer Gefangener, das Fehlen einer nationalen Gesetzgebung sowie die Weigerung der koreanischen Behörden, gemäß den internationalen Mechanismen zum Schutz der Menschenrechte zusammenzuarbeiten.
lsp.judge: In all contacts with the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, the Union has emphasized its extremely great concern regarding the serious human rights violations in this country. This also applies to the number of political prisoners, the lack of national legislation, as well as the refusal of the Korean authorities to cooperate according to international mechanisms for the protection of human rights.

lsp.query: Das Europäische Parlament hat sich natürlich konsequent gegenüber sich selbst verhalten, denn - wie der Kriegsverbrecher und ehemalige NATO-Generalsekretär sowie jetzige Hohe Vertreter der EU, Javier Solana, in zynischen Worten in seiner Ansprache hervorhob - das Europäische Parlament hat selbst beharrlich die militärische Intervention auf dem Balkan, sowohl in Bosnien als auch im Kosovo, gefordert.
lsp.judge: The European Parliament has, of course, consistently held itself to this standard, as the war criminal and former NATO Secretary-General, currently the High Representative of the EU, Javier Solana, emphasized in his cynical words during his speech: the European Parliament itself persistently called for military intervention on the Balkans, both in Bosnia and Kosovo.
lsp.proxy: The European Parliament has of course behaved consistently towards itself, because - as the war criminal and former NATO Secretary General and current High Representative of the EU, Javier Solana, highlighted in cynical words in his speech - the European Parliament has persistently demanded military intervention in the Balkans, both in Bosnia and in Kosovo.

lsp.judge: The fact that the armies of the great powers have known for ten years about the harmfulness of ammunition containing depleted uranium, not just for those who use it, proves that the general staffs treat their own soldiers with the same disregard as they do the civilian population and the opposing forces.

lsp.query: Abschließend möchte ich meine Ratlosigkeit angesichts der politischen Kehrtwende zum Ausdruck bringen, die bei unserer Aussprache zutage getreten ist. Während uns seinerzeit einige vorhielten, unsere Kritik an Milosevics Politik diene der NATO und ihren Bombardements, wirft uns Herr Solana heute vor, wir würden bei unseren Vorbehalten gegenüber dem abgereicherten Uran die Menschenrechte der Opfer von Milosevic vergessen.
lsp.judge: In conclusion, I want to express my helplessness regarding the political about-face that has become apparent during our discussion. While some had previously argued that our criticism of Milosevic's politics served the NATO and their bombings, Mr. Solana now accuses us of forgetting the human rights of the victims of Milosevic when we harbor reservations about depleted uranium.
lsp.proxy: Finally, I would like to express my bewilderment at the political about-face that has emerged in our discussion. While some of us were accused at the time of using our criticism of Milosevic's policy to serve the interests of NATO and their bombings, Mr. Solana now accuses us of forgetting the human rights of the victims of Milosevic in our reservations about the enriched uranium.

lsp.query: Das Ziel der Ratspräsidentschaft vor der diesjährigen Sitzung ist es, die EU hinter geschlossenen Positionen zu vereinen, die Beitrittskandidaten zu einer Beteiligung an den Ausführungen und den Entschließungen der EU aufzurufen sowie eine möglichst breite Unterstützung für die Anträge zu erlangen - das betrifft in diesem Jahr insbesondere die Situation im Iran und in Tschetschenien.
lsp.judge: The goal of the presidency prior to this year's meeting is to unite the EU behind closed positions, to invite accession candidates to participate in the discussions and resolutions of the EU, and to secure as broad support as possible for the proposals - this particularly concerns the situation in Iran and Chechnya this year.
lsp.proxy: The goal of the Council presidency before this year's session is to unite the EU behind closed positions, calling on accession candidates to participate in the EU's deliberations and resolutions, and to obtain as broad support as possible for the applications - this year in particular concerns the situation in Iran and Chechnya.

lsp.query: Ich sage das eingedenk des Völkermords in Ruanda im Jahre 1994, wo die Völkergemeinschaft mit ansehen musste, wie Hunderttausende Menschen ermordet wurden. Im Hinblick auf Zentralafrika möchte ich darauf drängen, dass die Europäische Union energischer handelt und auch die Vereinten Nationen größere Wachsamkeit zeigen.
lsp.judge: I say this in remembrance of the genocide in Rwanda in 1994, where the international community had to watch as hundreds of thousands of people were murdered. Regarding Central Africa, I urge that the European Union take more decisive action and that the United Nations also show greater vigilance.

lsp.judge: Similarly to some other speakers today, I am also concerned about the tendency to often and emphatically highlight the intergovernmental model at the expense of what is known as the Community Approach, which assigns the Commission a stronger role and significance.

lsp.judge: Mr. President, Mr. Simpson has indeed presented an excellent report. lsp.query: Davon ausgehend verfolgt die von uns vorgeschlagene Änderung zur bestehenden Verordnung ein zweifaches Ziel: Zum einen zielt sie auf die weitere Harmonisierung des Regulierungssystems im Bereich der Sicherheit der Zivilluftfahrt durch seine Ausdehnung auf die Harmonisierung der Betriebsanforderungen für Luftfahrzeuge; zum anderen geht es um die Festlegung von Verfahren, die es der Gemeinschaft ermöglichen, die Varianten und die Ausnahmen zu bearbeiten, die die Mitgliedstaaten hin und wieder aus operativen Erfordernissen anwenden müssen.
lsp.judge: Based on this, our proposed amendment to the existing regulation aims at achieving a dual objective: on the one hand, it seeks to further harmonize the regulatory system in the field of civil aviation safety by extending it to include the harmonization of operational requirements for aircraft; on the other hand, it focuses on establishing procedures that will enable the community to address the variations and exceptions that member states must occasionally apply due to operational necessities.
lsp.proxy: Based on this, the proposed amendment to the existing regulation pursues a twofold objective: on the one hand, it aims to further harmonise the regulatory system in the field of civil aviation safety by extending it to the harmonisation of the operating requirements for aircraft; on the other hand, it aims to establish procedures that enable the Community to deal with the variants and exceptions that Member States occasionally have to apply from operational requirements.
lsp.reference:
# English
Starting from this, the proposed amendment to the existing regulation pursues a twofold objective: On the one hand, it aims at further harmonization of the regulatory system in the field of civil aviation safety through its extension to the harmonization of operational requirements for aircraft; on the other hand, it is about establishing procedures that enable the community to handle the variants and exceptions that Member States occasionally have to apply from operational requirements.

lsp.query: Der Beitrag, den wir somit leisten, hat zwei Konsequenzen, die ich hier hervorheben möchte: Erstens werden wir, wenn wir dank der Methodik, die wir hoffentlich von der Kommission vorgelegt bekommen und akzeptieren können, eine klarere Definition und Anlastung der internen und externen Kosten an die Nutzer erreichen, die Voraussetzungen dafür schaffen, die Finanzierung der Infrastruktur, die gegenwärtig durch die öffentliche Hand gesichert wird bzw. über die allgemeine Besteuerung erfolgt, auf die Benutzer als solche zu verlagern.
lsp.judge: The contribution we thus make has two consequences that I would like to highlight: Firstly, if we, thanks to the methodology that we hope to receive and accept from the Commission, achieve a clearer definition and allocation of both internal and external costs to users, we will create the prerequisites for shifting the financing of the infrastructure, which is currently secured by the public sector or through general taxation, onto users themselves.
lsp.proxy: The contribution we thus make has two consequences that I would like to highlight here: First, we will, if we can achieve a clearer definition and allocation of internal and external costs to users thanks to the methodology we hope to receive and accept from the Commission, create the conditions to shift the financing of the infrastructure, which is currently secured by the public sector or carried out through general taxation, to users as such.
lsp.reference: The contribution we make in this way has two consequences that I would like to highlight here: Firstly, if we, thanks to the methodology that we hopefully receive and can accept from the commission, achieve a clearer definition and allocation of internal and external costs to the users, we create the conditions to transfer the financing of the infrastructure, which is currently secured by the public hand or takes place through general taxation, to the users as such.

lsp.query: Wenn mir ein gewisser Vergleich mit der Diskussion erlaubt ist, die vor dem Hintergrund der Probleme im Zusammenhang mit der Nahrungsmittelsicherheit über die Reform der Agrarpolitik gegenwärtig nicht nur in Deutschland, sondern auch in einigen weiteren Mitgliedstaaten - mein Land zählt dazu - geführt wird, so prophezeie ich Ihnen angesichts der heutigen Umweltprobleme - trotz gescheiterter Klimakonferenzen - eine ähnliche Situation auch im Bereich der Verkehrspolitik.
lsp.judge: If a comparison with the current discussion on reforming agricultural policy against the background of food security issues, which is not only taking place in Germany but also in several other member states - my country included - is allowed, then I foresee a similar situation in transport policy given today's environmental problems, despite failed climate conferences.
lsp.proxy: If a certain comparison with the discussion is allowed, which is currently not only in Germany but also in some other Member States - my country is among them - is being conducted in the context of the problems related to food security, I predict you, in view of today's environmental problems - despite failed climate conferences - a similar situation also in the field of transport policy.
lsp.reference: If a certain comparison with the discussion is allowed, which is being led in the context of food security issues in the background of the reform of agricultural policy not only in Germany, but also in some other member states - my country is among them - at present, I prophesize to you, in view of the current environmental problems - despite failed climate conferences - a similar situation also in the field of transportation policy.

lsp.query: Frau Karamanou, ich glaube nicht, dass die schwache Vertretung der Frauen oder auch der Jugendlichen in unseren Parlamenten auf ein Übermaß an Demokratie zurückzuführen ist, sondern auf ein Demokratiedefizit, und die Wahllisten, die von den Parteien aufgestellt werden - die sogar, wie Sie es in Ihrem Bericht empfehlen, als Listen mit einer Quotenregelung aufgestellt werden, wo es nicht einmal mehr möglich ist, eine Vorzugsstimme abzugeben - bilden ein hervorragendes System, um eine proportionale Vertretung der Parteien, d. h. der von den Parteien ausgewählten Funktionäre und Kandidaten, egal ob Frauen oder Männer, in den politischen Organen zu erreichen.
lsp.judge: Ms. Karamanou, I do not believe that the weak representation of women or even young people in our parliaments is due to an excess of democracy, but rather to a democratic deficit. The election lists that parties submit - which, as you recommend in your report, could even be quota-regulated lists where it is no longer possible to cast a preferential vote - form an excellent system to achieve proportional representation of parties, i.e., of the party-selected officials and candidates, whether they are women or men, in political bodies.
lsp.proxy: Mrs. Karamanou, I do not believe that the weak representation of women or even of young people in our parliaments is due to an excess of democracy, but to a democracy deficit, and the lists of candidates that are put forward by the parties - even, as you recommend in your report, as lists with a quota system, where it is no longer even possible to cast a preferential vote - form an excellent system for achieving a proportional representation of the parties, i.e. of the functionaries and candidates selected by the parties, whether women or men, in the political bodies.
lsp.reference: Mrs. Karamanou, I do not believe that the weak representation of women or also of young people in our parliaments is due to an excess of democracy, but rather a democracy deficit, and the electoral lists that are set up by the parties - even those that, as you recommend in your report, are set up as lists with a quota regulation, where it is no longer even possible to cast a preferential vote - form an excellent system to achieve a proportional representation of the parties, i.e. the officials and candidates selected by the parties, regardless of whether they are women or men, in the political organs.

lsp.query: Man sollte vielmehr die politischen Parteien auffordern, ihre Strukturen und Verfahren zu reformieren, um die unmittelbaren und mittelbaren Hindernisse für die Mitwirkung der Frauen aus dem Wege zu räumen, wobei selbstverständlich die Staaten selbst durch finanzielle Anreize die Parteien ermutigen könnten, möglichst viele Kandidatinnen auf die Wahllisten zu setzen.
lsp.judge: One should rather urge political parties to reform their structures and procedures to remove the direct and indirect obstacles to women's participation, with states naturally encouraging parties through financial incentives to place as many female candidates as possible on the election lists.
lsp.proxy: Rather, political parties should be encouraged to reform their structures and procedures to remove the immediate and indirect obstacles to women's participation, while of course states themselves could encourage parties with financial incentives to put as many female candidates on the lists as possible.
lsp.reference: One should rather urge the political parties to reform their structures and procedures in order to remove the immediate and indirect obstacles to women's participation, where, of course, the states themselves could encourage the parties with financial incentives to place as many female candidates as possible on the electoral lists.

lsp.query: Ich möchte der Kommission für diese Mitteilung zur Holz verarbeitenden Industrie danken und den Berichterstatter beglückwünschen und ihm dafür danken, dass er einige meiner im Industrieausschuss eingebrachten Änderungsvorschläge berücksichtigt hat, selbst wenn er meinen Änderungsantrag 5 überflüssig fand.
lsp.judge: I would like to thank the Commission for this communication on the wood processing industry and congratulate the rapporteur, thanking him for taking into account some of my amendments submitted in the Industry Committee, even though he found my Amendment 5 superfluous.

lsp.query: Da er sich aber wesentlich langsamer erneuert, müsste eine neue, eine dritte Kategorie geschaffen werden, die zwischen fossilen und schnell erneuerbaren Energiequellen liegt, das heißt die Kategorie die eines Brennstoffs mit langsamer Regeneration.
lsp.judge: Since it renewes significantly more slowly, a new, third category would have to be created, which lies between fossil and rapidly renewable energy sources, i.e., the category of a fuel with slow regeneration.
lsp.proxy: However, since it is renewed much slower, a new category, the third category, should be created, which lies between fossil and rapidly renewable energy sources, that is, the category of a fuel with slow regeneration.
lsp.reference: Since he renews himself significantly slower, a new category, a third category, would have to be created, which lies between fossil and quickly renewable energy sources, that is, the category of a fuel with slower regeneration.

lsp.query: Diese Problematik ist für den Alpenbereich - und ich komme ja aus dem Alpenbereich - und vor allem in Bezug auf die Alpentransversale München-Verona von ganz besonderer Bedeutung, und wir hoffen, dass sich die Kommission durch das neuerliche Votum, das das Parlament hier zum Ausdruck gebracht hat, veranlasst sieht, die entsprechenden Vorbereitungsarbeiten noch zu beschleunigen und mit viel größerer Konzentration und Stärke voranzutreiben, als es bisher erfolgt ist, damit dieses dringende Problem im Alpenbereich einer Lösung zugeführt werden kann.
lsp.judge: This issue is particularly significant for the Alpine region - and I do come from this region - especially in relation to the transverse Alpine route from Munich to Verona, and we hope that the Commission will be prompted by the new vote expressed by the Parliament here to accelerate the preparatory work even further and to advance it with much greater concentration and strength than has been the case so far, in order to address this urgent problem in the Alpine region.
lsp.proxy: This problem is of particular importance for the Alpine region - and I come from the Alpine region - and especially in relation to the Alpine transversal Munich-Verona, and we hope that the Commission will be encouraged by the renewed vote expressed by the Parliament here to accelerate the corresponding preparatory work and to proceed with much greater concentration and strength than has been the case so far, so that this urgent problem in the Alpine region can be resolved.
lsp.reference: This issue is of particular importance for the Alpine region - and I come from the Alpine region - and especially in relation to the Alpine transversal Munich-Verona, and we hope that the Commission will be motivated by the renewed vote expressed by Parliament here, to accelerate the corresponding preparatory work and to make progress with much greater concentration and strength than has been the case so far, so that this urgent problem in the Alpine region can be brought to a solution.

lsp.query: Aus diesen Gründen kann ich, obwohl ich für viele Änderungsanträge der Fraktion der Grünen/Freie Europäische Allianz, in denen konkrete Maßnahmen gefordert werden, Verständnis habe, diese hier nicht unterstützen, da sie den Konsens in den vorstehend genannten Prinzipien gefährden würden. Sie können später im Verlauf der Umsetzung eines Gebührenrahmens geprüft werden.
lsp.judge: For these reasons, although I understand many of the amendments proposed by the Green/Freie European Alliance faction, which call for specific measures, I cannot support them here as they would jeopardize the consensus in the aforementioned principles. They can be reviewed later during the implementation of a fee framework.

lsp.query: Für uns sollte dies Anlass ein, unsere Stimme zu erheben, um diese Machenschaften Russlands gegenüber seinem ehemaligen Vasallen zu verurteilen, und durch konkretes Handeln zur politischen Stabilisierung dieser Region und ihrem ökonomischen Aufschwung beizutragen. Und dann sollten wir, wie in der Entschließung vorgeschlagen, einen Sondergesandten für den Südkaukasus benennen, denn ein Flächenbrand im Südkaukasus würde auch Europa nicht verschonen.
lsp.judge: For us, this should serve as an opportunity to raise our voice to condemn Russia's machinations against its former vassal, and through concrete action, contribute to the political stabilization of this region and its economic upswing. And then, as proposed in the resolution, we should appoint a special envoy for the South Caucasus, for a conflagration in the South Caucasus would not spare Europe either.
lsp.proxy: For us, this should be an occasion to raise our voice to condemn these machinations of Russia against its former vassal, and to contribute to the political stabilization of this region and its economic upswing through concrete action. And then we should, as proposed in the resolution, appoint a special envoy for the South Caucasus, because a conflagration in the South Caucasus would not spare Europe either.

And then we should, as proposed in the resolution, appoint a special envoy for the South Caucasus, because a fire in the South Caucasus would not spare Europe either.

lsp.query: Ich appelliere an den Kommissar, unsere humanitäre Hilfe zur politischen Priorität Nr. 1 zu machen - für die USA und für Russland ist die Kaukasusregion längst Priorität -, weil ich das Gefühl habe, dass die Europäische Union - abgesehen von der Kollegin Schleicher, die eine großartige Arbeit leistet - dabei ist, diese Herausforderung zu verschlafen.
lsp.judge: I appeal to the Commissioner to make our humanitarian aid a top political priority - for the USA and Russia, the Caucasus region is already a top priority - because I feel that the European Union, apart from colleague Schleicher who does great work, is in danger of overlooking this challenge.
lsp.proxy: I appeal to the Commissioner to make our humanitarian aid our number one political priority - for the US and for Russia, the Caucasus region has long been a priority - because I feel that the European Union - apart from Ms. Schleicher, who is doing a great job - is in danger of sleeping through this challenge.
lsp.reference: I appeal to the Commissioner to make our humanitarian aid a political priority number 1 - for the USA and for Russia, the Caucasus region has long been a priority - because I feel that the European Union - aside from colleague Schleicher, who is doing a great job - is in the process of sleeping through this challenge.

lsp.query: So heißt es in dem von dem hochgeschätzten Kollegen Duff eingereichten Entschließungsantrag der ELDR-Fraktion: "Das Europäische Parlament begrüßt den Beschluss der türkischen Regierung, ihre umstrittenen Pläne zur Verlegung von Gefangenen in diese Gefängnisse zu vertagen und sich um einen "sozialen Konsens über die Gefängnisreform " zu bemühen.
lsp.judge: So it reads in the resolution motion submitted by highly esteemed colleague Duff on behalf of the ELDR faction: "The European Parliament welcomes the decision of the Turkish government to postpone its controversial plans for transferring prisoners to these prisons and to strive for a 'social consensus on prison reform'."

ilsp.query: Frau Präsidentin! Wie schon mehrere Male zuvor und in meinen mehrfachen Schreiben an Sie zum Ausdruck gebracht, möchte ich auch mit meiner heutigen Wortmeldung darauf hinweisen, dass in der Türkei seit dem 20. Oktober, also seit Monaten, Hunderte unter menschenunwürdigen Bedingungen lebende politische Gefangene in einem Hungerstreik stehen, wobei sie auch den Tod in Kauf nehmen - einige von ihnen sind bereits gestorben -, damit die türkische Regierung ihr Vorhaben, sie in weiße Einzelzellen zu sperren und dadurch ihre Moral und ihren Widerstand zu brechen, nicht verwirklichen kann.
ilsp.judge: Madam President! As I have expressed on several occasions and in my multiple letters to you, I would like to draw your attention once again with today's statement that hundreds of political prisoners in Turkey have been on a hunger strike since October 20th, thus for months, living under inhuman conditions, and are even willing to risk death – some of them have already passed away – in order to prevent the Turkish government from carrying out its plan to confine them to white solitary cells and thereby break their morale and resistance.
ilsp.proxy: Madam President! As I have already expressed on several occasions and in my repeated letters to you, I would also like to draw attention to the fact that in Turkey, since October 20, that is, for months, hundreds of political prisoners living under inhumane conditions have been on hunger strike, some of whom have already died, in order to prevent the Turkish government from carrying out its plan to imprison them in white solitary cells and thereby break their morale and resistance.
ilsp.reference: Madam President! As I have already expressed on several occasions and in my multiple written submissions to you, I would like to draw your attention once again today to the fact that in Turkey, hundreds of political prisoners living under inhumane conditions have been on hunger strike since October 20, putting their lives at risk - some of them have already died - in order to prevent the Turkish government from carrying out its plan to imprison them in white solitary cells and thereby break their morale and their resistance.

ilsp.query: In ähnlicher Weise werden die Rechte der Gläubiger in anderen Mitgliedstaaten als ihrem Herkunftsmitgliedstaat durch die zugesicherte Zusammenarbeit zwischen den zuständigen Behörden der Mitgliedstaaten gewährleistet, aber lassen Sie uns, falls jemand von Ihnen das Dokument nicht gelesen haben sollte, ganz deutlich sagen, dass es hier nicht um Harmonisierung, sondern um die gegenseitige Anerkennung der Sanierungsmaßnahmen und Liquidationsverfahren der Mitgliedstaaten geht.
ilsp.judge: In a similar manner, the rights of creditors in other Member States as compared to their home Member State are secured through the assured cooperation between the competent authorities of the Member States, but let us, if someone among you has not read the document, make it very clear that we are not talking about harmonization here, but about the mutual recognition of the insolvency proceedings and liquidation procedures of the Member States.
ilsp.proxy: In a similar way, the rights of creditors in other Member States than their home Member State are guaranteed by the ensured cooperation between the competent authorities of the Member States, but let us, if anyone of you has not read the document, say it very clearly that it is not about harmonization, but about the mutual recognition of the restructuring measures and liquidation procedures of the Member States.
ilsp.reference: In a similar manner, the rights of creditors are ensured in other member states than their home member state through the guaranteed cooperation between the competent authorities of the member states. However, let us make it very clear, in case someone among you has not read the document, that it is not about harmonization, but about the mutual recognition of the restructuring measures and liquidation procedures of the member states.

ilsp.judge: Mr. President, I congratulate Mrs. de Veyrac on her engaged elaboration of the topic "Convention for the Protection of Cultural and Natural Heritage of Europe in the States of the European Union," for her report underscores how indispensable it is for Europe to take sustained action on this crucial issue and what global measures are also required.

ilsp.query: Der Rechnungshof erinnert uns daran, dass bei zwingend vorgeschriebenen Sicherheitsleistungen der Grundsatz gilt, dass sie von den Zollbehörden in einer Höhe festzusetzen sind, die dem genauen Betrag der Zollschuld entspricht, sofern dieser Betrag zweifelsfrei ermittelt werden kann, oder andernfalls dem von den Zollbehörden geschätzten höchstmöglichen Betrag der Zollschuld, die entstanden ist oder entstehen kann.
ilsp.judge: The Court of Auditors reminds us that in the case of mandatory security arrangements, the principle applies that these must be set by the customs authorities at an amount exactly corresponding to the customs debt, provided that this amount can be determined without doubt, or alternatively at the highest possible amount of the customs debt estimated by the customs authorities, which has arisen or may arise.
ilsp.proxy: The Court of Auditors reminds us that the principle applies that they must be set by the customs authorities at an amount that corresponds to the exact amount of the customs debt, provided that this amount can be determined with certainty, or otherwise at the highest possible amount of the customs debt that has arisen or may arise.
ilsp.reference: The Court of Auditors reminds us that in the case of mandatory security measures, the principle applies that they must be set by the customs authorities at a level corresponding to the exact amount of the customs debt, provided that this amount can be determined with certainty, or otherwise at the highest estimated amount of the customs debt that has arisen or may arise.

ilsp.query: Erwiesenermaßen war es richtig, das Büro in Thessaloniki zu belassen, denn hätten wir es nach Pristina ausgelagert, hätte Jugoslawien heute keinerlei Aussicht auf eine finanzielle Unterstützung durch die Agentur für Wiederaufbau, denn kein Serbe könnte jemals nach Pristina reisen, um dort auch nur einen Euro einzufordern.
ilsp.judge: It turned out to be correct to keep the office in Thessaloniki, as if we had relocated it to Pristina, Yugoslavia would have had no chance of receiving any financial support from the Reconstruction Agency today, since no Serb could ever travel to Pristina to claim even a single euro.
ilsp.proxy: It was undoubtedly right to leave the office in Thessaloniki, because if we had relocated it to Pristina, Yugoslavia would have no prospect of financial support from the Agency for Reconstruction today, because no Serb could ever travel to Pristina to claim even a euro there.

ilsp.query: Die tiefgreifende politische Umgestaltung der Strukturen der bundesdeutschen Regierung ist ein deutliches Signal dafür, dass es selbst im Herzen Europas, wo die GAP entworfen wurde und wo sie stets ihre große Stütze fand, immer unhaltbarer ist, ein Modell einer Agrarpolitik aufrecht zu erhalten, das zur Bewahrung des industriellen Systems und der großen landwirtschaftlichen Betriebe konzipiert wurde.
ilsp.judge: The profound political restructuring of the federal German government's structures is a clear signal that it is increasingly untenable to maintain an agricultural policy model designed to preserve the industrial system and large agricultural enterprises, even at the heart of Europe where the Common Agricultural Policy was conceived and always found its strong support.
ilsp.proxy: The deep political restructuring of the structures of the German government is a clear signal that it is even more untenable in the heart of Europe, where the CAP was designed and where it has always found its great support, to maintain a model of agricultural policy designed to preserve the industrial system and large agricultural enterprises.
ilsp.reference: The far-reaching political restructuring of the federal government's structures is a clear indication that even at the heart of Europe, where the Common Agricultural Policy (CAP) was designed and where it has always found its strong support, it is becoming increasingly unsustainable to maintain a model of agricultural policy that was conceived to preserve the industrial system and large-scale agricultural enterprises.

ilsp.query: Wir können nicht hinnehmen, dass Unternehmen, die in den Genuss von europäischen Beihilfen gekommen sind, wenn sie sich finanziell gesund gestoßen haben, aus Gründen der Strukturanpassung die Entlassung tausender Arbeitnehmer beschließen und damit deren Familien in eine Notlage bringen, zu deren Unterstützung dann wieder nationale und europäische öffentliche Gelder in Anspruch genommen werden.
ilsp.judge: We cannot accept that companies benefiting from European subsidies, when they have become financially sound due to structural adaptation, decide to lay off thousands of employees and thereby put their families in hardship, only to claim national and European public funds for support again.
ilsp.proxy: We cannot accept that companies that have benefited from European subsidies when they have recovered financially, decide to lay off thousands of workers for reasons of structural adjustment and thus bring their families into a state of need, to which national and European public funds are then taken into use for their support.
ilsp.reference: We cannot accept that companies that have benefited from European subsidies, having financially recovered, decide to lay off thousands of employees for reasons of structural adjustment and thereby bring their families into a state of emergency, only to then again draw on national and European public funds for their support.

ilsp.query: Die Förderung der Konsolidierung des Friedensprozesses in Nordirland und die Unterstützung insbesondere der grenzüberschreitenden Zusammenarbeit durch die örtlichen Initiativen, auf die Herr Hume noch einmal Bezug genommen hat, war nicht nur ein innovatives Ziel, sondern meines Erachtens auch das richtige Programm, und ich freue mich, noch einmal zur Kenntnis zu nehmen, dass es vom Parlament unterstützt wird.
ilsp.judge: The promotion of the consolidation of the peace process in Northern Ireland and the support, in particular, of cross-border cooperation through local initiatives, to which Mr. Hume has referred again, was not only an innovative goal but, in my view, also the right program, and I am pleased to take note once more that it is supported by the Parliament.

ilsp.query: Die Europäische Zentralbank hat auf den Bericht geantwortet, aber ihre Antworten fielen sehr kurz aus, ich würde sagen kurz und knapp, und der Rechnungshof hielt diese für nicht ausreichend, da sie keinerlei Hinweise darauf enthielten, welche Schritte die EZB einzuleiten gedenkt, um die im Bericht des Rechnungshofs aufgedeckten Unzulänglichkeiten abzustellen.
ilsp.judge: The European Central Bank responded to the report, but their answers were very brief, I would say short and to the point, and the Court of Auditors considered them insufficient as they contained no indications of the steps the ECB intends to take to address the deficiencies uncovered in the Court of Auditors' report.

ilsp.query: Wenn sich aber - und das sollte durchaus festgeschrieben werden - nach 18 Monaten bzw. nach zwei Jahren eine Bewertung als notwendig erweist und diese Bewertung ausweist, dass den Grenzarbeitnehmern unzumutbare Nachteile entstehen, dann muss die Möglichkeit bestehen, und diesen Punkt möchte ich in den Bericht aufgenommen sehen, eine andere Entscheidung zu treffen.
ilsp.judge: But if - and this should certainly be recorded - after 18 months or two years a review proves necessary and this review shows that the border workers are facing unacceptable disadvantages, then there must be the possibility to make a different decision, and this point I would like to see included in the report.
ilsp.proxy: However, if - and this should be clearly stated - after 18 months or two years, an assessment is deemed necessary and this assessment shows that the border workers are suffering from unbearable disadvantages, then the possibility must exist, and I would like to see this point included in the report, to make a different decision.
ilsp.reference: However, and this should be clearly stated - if an evaluation becomes necessary after 18 months or two years, and this evaluation shows that frontier workers are suffering unacceptable disadvantages, then there must be the possibility, and I would like to see this point included in the report, of making a different decision.

ilsp.query: Die EU gefällt sich in wohlklingenden Erklärungen über die Kultur und stellt das kulturelle Erbe als Hauptmerkmal der besonderen Identität und historischen Entwicklung einer Gesellschaft dar, hat aber nichts für die Rückführung des Parthenon-Marmors an den natürlichen und historischen Ort unternommen, mit dem er untrennbar verbunden ist. Dies hätte als elementarer, anschaulicher Beweis für den Respekt gegenüber dem kulturellen und historischen Erbe und für den Schutz des historischen Vermächtnisses gelten können.
ilsp.judge: The EU likes to boast about its cultural rhetoric and presents cultural heritage as the main hallmark of a society's special identity and historical development, yet it has done nothing to return the Parthenon Marbles to their natural and historical place, which they are inextricably linked to. This could have served as an elementary and tangible proof of respect for cultural and historical heritage and for the protection of historical legacy.
ilsp.proxy: The EU is pleased with well-sounding statements about culture and considers cultural heritage as the main feature of the special identity and historical development of a society, but has done nothing for the return of the Parthenon Marbles to their natural and historical place, with which they are inseparably connected. This could have been considered as an elementary, tangible evidence of respect for cultural and historical heritage and for the protection of historical heritage.
ilsp.reference: The EU boasts of well-sounding declarations about culture and presents cultural heritage as the main feature of a society's special identity and historical development, but has done nothing to repatriate the Parthenon Marbles to their natural and historical site, with which they are inextricably linked. This could have served as a fundamental, tangible proof of respect for cultural and historical heritage and for the protection of the historical legacy.

ilsp.query: Allerdings haben wir Vorbehalte gegenüber europäischen Rechtsvorschriften, die unter dem Vorwand des Schutzes (eines viel zu ausschließlichen Konzepts) der Umwelt nur zur Beseitigung der örtlichen Traditionen und Gebräuche führen, die untrennbarer Bestandteil der Kultur unserer Regionen sind, was ja wohl das Gegenteil dessen wäre, was dieser Bericht anstrebt, den wir unterstützen, aber bei dessen Abstimmung wir uns aus diesem Grunde der Stimme enthalten.
ilsp.judge: However, we have reservations about European regulations that, under the pretext of protecting (a far too exclusive concept) the environment, only lead to the elimination of local traditions and customs, which are an integral part of the culture of our regions, which is certainly the opposite of what this report aims to achieve, which we support, but for whose vote we abstain on this account.
ilsp.proxy: However, we have reservations about European regulations that, under the pretext of protecting (a much too exclusive concept) the environment, only lead to the elimination of local traditions and customs that are an integral part of the culture of our regions, which is of course the opposite of what this report aims to achieve, which we support, but for which we abstain from voting for this reason.
ilsp.reference: However, we have reservations regarding European regulations that, under the pretext of environmental protection (a concept that is far too exclusive), only lead to the elimination of local traditions and customs, which are an integral part of the culture of our regions, which is indeed the opposite of what this report aims to achieve, one that we support, but for this reason we abstain from voting on it.

ilsp.query: Wie die Berichterstatterin hervorhebt, gibt es bei anerkannten Natur- und Kulturstätten ein Ungleichgewicht zwischen den europäischen Ländern und der übrigen Welt. Deshalb gilt es, die Drittländer darin zu unterstützen und zu ermutigen, die Liste des Kultur- und Naturerbes umfassend zu vervollständigen, damit es geschützt werden kann.
ilsp.judge: As the reporter points out, there is an imbalance between recognized natural and cultural sites among European countries and the rest of the world. Therefore, it is necessary to support and encourage third countries to comprehensively complete the list of cultural and natural heritage so that it can be protected.
ilsp.proxy: As the reporter highlights, there is an imbalance between European countries and the rest of the world in recognized natural and cultural sites. Therefore, it is necessary to support and encourage the third countries to complete the list of cultural and natural heritage comprehensively so that it can be protected.
ilsp.reference: As the rapporteur highlights, there is an imbalance between European countries and the rest of the world at recognized natural and cultural sites. Therefore, it is necessary to support and encourage third countries in comprehensively completing the list of cultural and natural heritage, so that it can be protected.

ilsp.query: (ES) Meine Zustimmung zum Bericht de Veyrac über die Umsetzung des Übereinkommens zum Schutz des Kultur- und Naturerbes der Welt in den Staaten der Europäischen Union basiert auf der Überzeugung, dass es notwendig ist, die kulturelle Dimension der Europäischen Union weiterzuentwickeln und eine Kulturpolitik in der Union zu gewährleisten, die als eines der Hauptmerkmale ihres geistigen Reichtums und des Alten Kontinents die kulturelle, sprachliche, architektonische und künstlerische Vielfalt sowie alle jene Elemente zum Tragen bringt, die unser gemeinsames kulturelles Erbe darstellen.
ilsp.judge: My consent to the de Veyrac report on the implementation of the Convention for the Protection of Cultural and Natural Heritage of World Heritage Sites in the States of the European Union is based on the conviction that it is necessary to further develop the cultural dimension of the European Union and to ensure a culture policy within the Union that, as one of the main features of its spiritual wealth and that of the Old Continent, secures cultural, linguistic, architectural, and artistic diversity as well as all those elements that constitute our common cultural heritage.
ilsp.proxy: (ES) My approval of the Veyrac report on the implementation of the Convention for the Protection of the World Cultural and Natural Heritage in the States of the European Union is based on the conviction that it is necessary to further develop the cultural dimension of the European Union and to ensure a cultural policy in the Union that is one of the main characteristics of its spiritual wealth and the old continent, bringing together the cultural, linguistic, architectural and artistic diversity and all those elements that represent our common cultural heritage.
ilsp.reference: My consent to the report by de Veyrac on the implementation of the Convention for the Protection of the World's Cultural and Natural Heritage in the Member States of the European Union is based on the conviction that it is necessary to further develop the cultural dimension of the European Union and to ensure a cultural policy in the Union that, as one of the main characteristics of its spiritual wealth and the Old Continent, encompasses the cultural, linguistic, architectural, and artistic diversity, as well as all those elements that represent our shared cultural heritage.

ilsp.query: Deshalb bestehe ich darauf, im Rahmen dieser Vereinfachung und Verbesserung der gemeinschaftlichen Rechtsvorschriften im Hinblick auf die in diesem Bericht erwähnte Koordinierung der sozialen Sicherheit zu berücksichtigen, dass es angebracht wäre, wenn ein Arbeitnehmer, der in mehreren Mitgliedstaaten der Europäischen Union beschäftigt war, seine Rente nicht "häppchenweise " in verschiedenen Staaten, sondern von einer einzigen Rentenzahlstelle erhielte.
ilsp.judge: That is why I insist on taking into account, within this simplification and improvement of the community laws concerning the coordination of social security as mentioned in this report, that it would be appropriate for an employee who has been employed in several Member States of the European Union to receive their pension not "piecemeal" in different states, but from a single pension payment office.
ilsp.proxy: Therefore, I insist that, in the context of this simplification and improvement of the Community's legal provisions in view of the coordination of social security referred to in this report, it would be appropriate for an employee who had been employed in several Member States of the European Union to receive his pension not "happily" in various States, but from a single pension payment centre.
ilsp.reference: Therefore, I insist that, in the context of this simplification and improvement of the community regulations regarding the coordination of social security mentioned in this report, it would be appropriate for an employee who has been employed in several member states of the European Union to receive their pension not "piecemeal" in various states, but from a single pension payment office.

ilsp.query: Auffälligerweise wird bei der gesamten Wettbewerbspolitik der Europäischen Union dem Wettbewerb zwar große Beachtung geschenkt, nehmen jedoch beispielsweise im Futtermittelsektor die Abnehmer, die Supermärkte, allmählich eine Monopolstellung ein, während gleichzeitig der Vertrieb durch die Bauernhöfe, durch den kleinen landwirtschaftlichen Betrieb, noch zersplittert ist.
ilsp.judge: Interestingly, while the entire competition policy of the European Union pays great attention to competition, for example in the feed sector, consumers, supermarkets, are gradually establishing a monopolistic position, while the distribution through farms, small agricultural operations, remains fragmented.

ilsp.query: Eindeutige Anweisungen sind zwar nützlich und notwendig, doch erstaunt es mich, dass so viele Kolleginnen und Kollegen eine Überarbeitung der Vogel- und Habitatrichtlinie fordern, um bestimmte darin enthaltene Begriffe, wie "wesentliche Folgen ", "Ausgleichsregelung " und "überwiegend öffentliches Interesse ", noch exakter zu definieren.
ilsp.judge: Unique instructions are useful and necessary, yet it surprises me that so many colleagues are calling for an amendment of the Birds and Habitats Directives to define certain terms more precisely, such as "essential effects," "compensation mechanism," and "overriding public interest."
ilsp.proxy: Clear instructions are certainly useful and necessary, but it surprises me that so many colleagues are calling for a revision of the bird and habitat guidelines to define certain terms contained therein, such as "significant consequences", "compensation rule" and "overwhelming public interest", even more precisely.
ilsp.reference: Clear instructions are indeed useful and necessary, but it surprises me that so many colleagues are calling for a revision of the bird and habitat guidelines to more precisely define certain terms contained within, such as "substantial consequences", "compensatory regulation", and "overriding public interest".

ilsp.query: Bei diesen Faktoren handelt es sich erstens um die GAP, die vor allem nach 1992 und mit der Agenda 2000 eine Form angenommen hat, die den meisten landwirtschaftlichen Betrieben mittlerer Größe in der Gemeinschaft nicht das zum Überleben notwendige Einkommen garantiert, die den Haushaltsvorständen nicht den nötigen Lebensunterhalt sichert. Deshalb werden in einem Sektor wie der Landwirtschaft, die nicht nur keine Gewinne erwirtschaftet, sondern noch nicht einmal ein Mindesteinkommen gewährleistet, trotz der vielen Beihilfen - so viele sind es aber nun auch wieder nicht ­ nur wenige Investitionen, selbst in geringer Höhe, getätigt.
ilsp.judge: These factors first refer to the GAP, which has taken on a form primarily after 1992 and with Agenda 2000, that does not guarantee sufficient income for survival to most medium-sized agricultural enterprises within the community, nor does it secure a decent living for budget authorities. Therefore, in a sector like agriculture, which not only fails to generate profits but also does not even ensure a minimum income, despite many subsidies – although there are indeed quite a few of them – only very few investments, even at low levels, are made.
ilsp.proxy: First of all, it is the GAP, which has taken the form of the CAP since 1992 and with the Agenda 2000, which does not guarantee the necessary income for most medium-sized agricultural holdings in the Community, which does not secure the necessary living for the household heads. Therefore, in a sector such as agriculture, which not only does not make profits, but does not even guarantee a minimum income, despite the many subsidies - there are not so many of them, however - only a few investments, even of a small amount, are made.
ilsp.reference: It is primarily the CAP that is involved here, which, especially after 1992 and with the Agenda 2000, has taken on a form that does not guarantee the necessary income for the survival of most medium-sized agricultural businesses in the community, nor does it secure the necessary living expenses for the household heads. Therefore, in a sector like agriculture, which not only fails to generate profits but also does not even ensure a minimum income, despite the many subsidies - and there are not that many, after all - only a few investments, even of a small scale, have been made.

ilsp.query: Herr Präsident, der Bericht befasst sich mit einer äußerst komplizierten Thematik. Wie der Berichterstatter bereits andeutete, waren die Perspektiven für junge Menschen in der Landwirtschaft seit Einführung der GAP wahrscheinlich nie so schlecht wie heute, und wir können ihre Perspektiven nicht von denen der Agrarwirtschaft insgesamt oder vom Wohlergehen der Gemeinden auf dem Lande trennen.
ilsp.judge: Mr. President, the report deals with an extremely complex topic. As the rapporteur already hinted, the prospects for young people in agriculture have probably never been as bad as they are today, and we cannot separate their prospects from those of agriculture as a whole or the well-being of rural communities.

ilsp.query: Ist der Kommission bewusst, dass sie durch die Rücknahme des Anspruchs auf Exporterstattungen für aus landwirtschaftlichen Rohstoffen erzeugte chemische Produkte die Wettbewerbsfähigkeit der europäischen chemischen Industrie zusätzlich schwer beeinträchtigt hat, die ohnehin auf Größenordnungsvorteile, die die Glukose-Lieferanten der US-Industrie nutzen können, wegen des EU-Quotensystems für Isoglukose und des Fehlens eines Äthanolprogramms in der EU verzichten muss?
ilsp.judge: Is the Commission aware that by withdrawing the claim for export refunds on chemical products produced from agricultural raw materials, it has additionally severely impaired the competitiveness of the European chemical industry, which already had to forego sizeable advantages due to the EU quota system for isoglucose and the lack of an ethanol program in the EU, which glucose suppliers to the US industry can utilize?
ilsp.proxy: Is the Commission aware that it has further seriously impaired the competitiveness of the European chemical industry by withdrawing the claim for export refunds for chemical products produced from agricultural raw materials, which is already disadvantaged by the size advantages that the US industry's glucose suppliers can use due to the EU quota system for isoglucose and the lack of an ethanol program in the EU?
ilsp.reference: Is the Commission aware that by withdrawing the claim for export refunds on chemically produced products made from agricultural raw materials, it has further severely impaired the competitiveness of the European chemical industry, which already has to forgo scale advantages that glucose suppliers to the US industry can utilize due to the EU's isoglucose quota system and the absence of an ethanol program in the EU?

ilsp.query: Betrifft: Bewertung des Zwischenberichts des britischen Nuclear Installations Inspectorate (NII, Aufsichtsbehörde für kerntechnische Anlagen) über British Nuclear Fuels Ltd. (BNFL) Hat die Kommission den vom britischen Nuclear Installations Inspectorate erstellten Zwischenbericht bewertet, in dem über die Fortschritte von BNFL bei der Umsetzung der vom NII vorgeschriebenen Verbesserungen in Bezug auf die Sicherheits- und Managementstrukturen in Sellafield berichtet wird, sofern die Aktivitäten in Sellafield negative Auswirkungen auf andere Mitgliedstaaten haben?
ilsp.judge: Regarding the evaluation of the interim report by the British Nuclear Installations Inspectorate (NII, the nuclear installations inspectorate) on British Nuclear Fuels Ltd. (BNFL), has the Commission evaluated the interim report prepared by the British Nuclear Installations Inspectorate, which reports on BNFL's progress in implementing the improvements required by the NII regarding safety and management structures at Sellafield, provided that activities at Sellafield have negative impacts on other Member States?
ilsp.proxy: Subject: Assessment of the interim report of the British Nuclear Installations Inspectorate (NII, Nuclear Installations Inspectorate) on British Nuclear Fuels Ltd. ilsp.query: Betrifft: Finanzielle Unterstützung für die von den Molukken-Inseln vertriebene christliche Bevölkerung Ein besonders dringliches Problem sind die Verfolgungen, Gewalttätigkeiten und Terrorakte gegen die christliche Bevölkerung auf den Molukken-Inseln, einem indonesischen Archipel, vor allem jene Gewalttaten von Jihad-Aktivisten auf der Insel Ambon, die Kirchen geschändet und in Brand gesteckt und die Christen vertrieben haben, nachdem sie viele von ihnen getötet hatten.
ilsp.judge: Regarding financial support for the Christian population displaced from the Maluku Islands: One particularly urgent issue are the persecutions, violence, and terrorist acts against the Christian population on the Maluku Islands, an Indonesian archipelago, especially those violent acts by Jihad activists on the island of Ambon, who desecrated and set churches on fire, driving Christians away after killing many of them.
ilsp.proxy: Subject: Financial support for the Christian population displaced from the Moluccas Islands A particularly urgent problem is the persecution, violence and terrorist acts against the Christian population on the Moluccas Islands, an Indonesian archipelago, especially those acts of Jihad activists on the island of Ambon, who have desecrated and set fire to churches and have driven out the Christians after they had killed many of them.
ilsp.reference:
Subject: Financial Support for the Christian Population Displaced from the Moluccas Islands

A particularly pressing issue is the persecution, violence, and terrorist acts against the Christian population on the Moluccas Islands, an Indonesian archipelago, particularly the violent acts by Jihad activists on the island of Ambon, who have desecrated churches and set them on fire, and driven out the Christians after killing many of them.

ilsp.query: Heute Nachmittag habe ich erfahren, dass zehn Mitglieder der Umweltorganisation Greenpeace, zehn pazifistische Umweltschützer, durch die Militärbehörde von La Roca auf Gibraltar festgenommen wurden, weil sie versucht hatten, sich dem U-Boot "Tireless " mit einem Spruchband zu nähern, um etwas zum Ausdruck zu bringen, was meiner Meinung nach alle Welt denkt, nämlich dass das Meer nicht durch Nuklearenergie in Beschlag genommen werden darf.
ilsp.judge: Today afternoon, I learned that ten members of the environmental organization Greenpeace, ten pacifistic environmental protectors, were arrested by the military authority of La Roca on Gibraltar because they had tried to approach the submarine "Tireless" with a banner to express something that, in my opinion, everyone in the world thinks, namely that the sea must not be occupied by nuclear energy.
ilsp.proxy: This afternoon I learned that ten members of the environmental organization Greenpeace, ten pacifist environmentalists, were arrested by the military authorities of La Roca in Gibraltar because they had tried to approach the submarine "Tireless" with a slogan to express something that, in my opinion, everyone thinks, namely that the sea must not be taken over by nuclear energy.

ilsp.query: Diese Umweltschützer sind immer noch in Haft und da das Parlament bei der Wahrung der Interessen der Bewohner von Campo de Gibraltar und der Bucht von Algeciras - um es einmal so zu sagen - wenig Sensibilität gezeigt hat, bitte ich darum, dass man wenigstens geeignete Maßnahmen ergreift, damit diese pazifistischen Umweltschützer zu Hause schlafen können.
ilsp.judge: These environmental activists are still in custody, and since the parliament has shown little sensitivity towards the interests of the residents of Campo de Gibraltar and the Bay of Algeciras, I beg that at least appropriate measures be taken so that these pacifist environmental activists can sleep at home.
