ilsp.query: Wenn sich aber - und das sollte durchaus festgeschrieben werden - nach 18 Monaten bzw. nach zwei Jahren eine Bewertung als notwendig erweist und diese Bewertung ausweist, dass den Grenzarbeitnehmern unzumutbare Nachteile entstehen, dann muss die Möglichkeit bestehen, und diesen Punkt möchte ich in den Bericht aufgenommen sehen, eine andere Entscheidung zu treffen.
ilsp.judge: But if - and this should certainly be recorded - after 18 months or two years a review proves necessary and this review shows that the border workers are facing unacceptable disadvantages, then there must be the possibility to make a different decision, and this point I would like to see included in the report.
ilsp.proxy: But if - and this should certainly be enshrined - after 18 months or two years an assessment proves necessary and this assessment shows that border workers are facing unacceptable disadvantages, then the possibility must exist, and I would like to see this point included in the report, to make a different decision.
ilsp.reference: However, and this should be clearly stated - if an evaluation becomes necessary after 18 months or two years, and this evaluation shows that frontier workers are suffering unacceptable disadvantages, then there must be the possibility, and I would like to see this point included in the report, of making a different decision.

ilsp.query: (ES) Meine Zustimmung zum Bericht de Veyrac über die Umsetzung des Übereinkommens zum Schutz des Kultur- und Naturerbes der Welt in den Staaten der Europäischen Union basiert auf der Überzeugung, dass es notwendig ist, die kulturelle Dimension der Europäischen Union weiterzuentwickeln und eine Kulturpolitik in der Union zu gewährleisten, die als eines der Hauptmerkmale ihres geistigen Reichtums und des Alten Kontinents die kulturelle, sprachliche, architektonische und künstlerische Vielfalt sowie alle jene Elemente zum Tragen bringt, die unser gemeinsames kulturelles Erbe darstellen.
ilsp.judge: My consent to the de Veyrac report on the implementation of the Convention for the Protection of Cultural and Natural Heritage of World Heritage Sites in the States of the European Union is based on the conviction that it is necessary to further develop the cultural dimension of the European Union and to ensure a culture policy within the Union that, as one of the main features of its spiritual wealth and that of the Old Continent, secures cultural, linguistic, architectural, and artistic diversity as well as all those elements that constitute our common cultural heritage.
ilsp.proxy: My consent to the de Veyrac report on the implementation of the Convention for the Protection of the World Cultural and Natural Heritage in the European Union member states is based on the conviction that it is necessary to further develop the cultural dimension of the European Union and to ensure a cultural policy in the Union that, as one of the main features of its intellectual wealth and of the Old Continent, brings to bear the cultural, linguistic, architectural and artistic diversity as well as all those elements that constitute our common cultural heritage.
ilsp.reference: My consent to the report by de Veyrac on the implementation of the Convention for the Protection of the World's Cultural and Natural Heritage in the Member States of the European Union is based on the conviction that it is necessary to further develop the cultural dimension of the European Union and to ensure a cultural policy in the Union that, as one of the main characteristics of its spiritual wealth and the Old Continent, encompasses the cultural, linguistic, architectural, and artistic diversity, as well as all those elements that represent our shared cultural heritage.

ilsp.query: Bei diesen Faktoren handelt es sich erstens um die GAP, die vor allem nach 1992 und mit der Agenda 2000 eine Form angenommen hat, die den meisten landwirtschaftlichen Betrieben mittlerer Größe in der Gemeinschaft nicht das zum Überleben notwendige Einkommen garantiert, die den Haushaltsvorständen nicht den nötigen Lebensunterhalt sichert. Deshalb werden in einem Sektor wie der Landwirtschaft, die nicht nur keine Gewinne erwirtschaftet, sondern noch nicht einmal ein Mindesteinkommen gewährleistet, trotz der vielen Beihilfen - so viele sind es aber nun auch wieder nicht ­ nur wenige Investitionen, selbst in geringer Höhe, getätigt.
ilsp.judge: These factors first refer to the GAP, which has taken on a form primarily after 1992 and with Agenda 2000, that does not guarantee sufficient income for survival to most medium-sized agricultural enterprises within the community, nor does it secure a decent living for budget authorities. Therefore, in a sector like agriculture, which not only fails to generate profits but also does not even ensure a minimum income, despite many subsidies – although there are indeed quite a few of them – only very few investments, even at low levels, are made.
ilsp.proxy: These factors first of all include the GAP, which, especially after 1992 and with Agenda 2000, has taken a form that does not guarantee the income necessary for survival to most medium-sized agricultural businesses in the Community, nor does it secure the necessary livelihood for household heads. Therefore, in a sector like agriculture, which not only generates no profits but does not even guarantee a minimum income, despite the many subsidies - although there aren't that many anymore - only few investments, even in small amounts, are made.
ilsp.reference: It is primarily the CAP that is involved here, which, especially after 1992 and with the Agenda 2000, has taken on a form that does not guarantee the necessary income for the survival of most medium-sized agricultural businesses in the community, nor does it secure the necessary living expenses for the household heads. Therefore, in a sector like agriculture, which not only fails to generate profits but also does not even ensure a minimum income, despite the many subsidies - and there are not that many, after all - only a few investments, even of a small scale, have been made.

ilsp.query: Der Bericht unterstreicht die Notwendigkeit von Maßnahmen zur Förderung von Berufsanfängern und der unionsweiten Standardisierung. Wie der Berichterstatter feststellte, setzte sich auch der ausgezeichnete STOA-Bericht, der zu Beginn des vergangenen Jahres vorgelegt worden war, mit dieser Thematik auseinander.
ilsp.judge: The report emphasizes the necessity of measures to promote young professionals and the uniform standardization across the union. As the rapporteur noted, the excellent STOA report presented at the beginning of the previous year also dealt with this theme.
ilsp.proxy: The report underscores the need for measures to promote young professionals and union-wide standardization. As the rapporteur noted, the excellent STOA report, which was presented at the beginning of last year, also dealt with this issue.
ilsp.reference: The report highlights the need for measures to support new entrants to the workforce and for EU-wide standardization. As the rapporteur noted, the excellent STOA report, which was presented at the beginning of last year, also dealt with this issue.

ilsp.query: Diese Umweltschützer sind immer noch in Haft und da das Parlament bei der Wahrung der Interessen der Bewohner von Campo de Gibraltar und der Bucht von Algeciras - um es einmal so zu sagen - wenig Sensibilität gezeigt hat, bitte ich darum, dass man wenigstens geeignete Maßnahmen ergreift, damit diese pazifistischen Umweltschützer zu Hause schlafen können.
ilsp.judge: These environmental activists are still in custody, and since the parliament has shown little sensitivity towards the interests of the residents of Campo de Gibraltar and the Bay of Algeciras, I beg that at least appropriate measures be taken so that these pacifist environmental activists can sleep at home.
ilsp.proxy: These environmental activists are still in custody, and since the Parliament has shown little sensitivity, so to speak, in upholding the interests of the residents of Campo de Gibraltar and the Bay of Algeciras, I request that at least appropriate measures be taken so that these pacifist environmental activists can sleep at home.
ilsp.reference: These environmental activists are still in custody and since the parliament has shown little sensitivity in safeguarding the interests of the residents of Campo de Gibraltar and the Bay of Algeciras - to put it that way - I kindly request that at least appropriate measures be taken so that these pacifist environmental activists can sleep at home.

ilsp.query: Es muss sowohl den Bürgern der Europäischen Union als auch den Bürgern Marokkos klar sein, dass alle Institutionen der Europäischen Union, und zwar auf höchster Ebene, dieses Abkommen wollen: Der Europäische Rat will es und hat es so in Nizza erklärt, der Präsident der Kommission, der nach Rabat gereist ist, will es, und auch das Europäische Parlament in Straßburg will es.
ilsp.judge: Both the citizens of the European Union and the citizens of Morocco must be clear that all institutions of the European Union, at the highest level, want this agreement: The European Council wants it and stated so in Nice, the President of the Commission, who traveled to Rabat, wants it, and also the European Parliament in Strasbourg wants it.
ilsp.proxy: It must be clear to both citizens of the European Union and citizens of Morocco that all institutions of the European Union, at the highest level, want this agreement: The European Council wants it and declared it so in Nice, the President of the Commission, who traveled to Rabat, wants it, and the European Parliament in Strasbourg also wants it.
ilsp.reference: It must be clear to both citizens of the European Union and citizens of Morocco that all institutions of the European Union, at the highest level, want this agreement: The European Council wants it and has stated so in Nice, the President of the Commission, who has traveled to Rabat, wants it, and so does the European Parliament in Strasbourg.

ilsp.query: Ich bekräftige erneut meine Forderung, wie ich es in der Vergangenheit so häufig getan habe, dass zur Gewährleistung einer angemessenen Dezentralisierungspolitik der Zugang zu den Küstengewässern innerhalb der 12-Meilen-Zone weiterhin ausschließlich den Anrainerstaaten vorbehalten bleiben muss und dass diese ausschließliche Fischereizone auf 24 Seemeilen ausgedehnt wird, wie es dieses Haus im Februar 1999 gefordert hat.
ilsp.judge: I reiterate my demand, as I have done in the past, that access to coastal waters within the 12-mile zone must remain exclusively reserved for the coastal states to ensure an appropriate decentralization policy, and that this exclusive fishing zone be extended to 24 nautical miles, as this House demanded in February 1999.
ilsp.proxy: I reiterate my demand, as I have done so often in the past, that access to coastal waters within the 12-mile zone should continue to be reserved exclusively for riparian states to ensure an appropriate decentralization policy, and that this exclusive fishing zone be extended to 24 nautical miles, as this House demanded in February 1999.
ilsp.reference: I reiterate my demand, as I have done so frequently in the past, that to ensure an appropriate policy of decentralization, access to coastal waters within the 12-mile zone must remain exclusively reserved for coastal states and that this exclusive fishing zone be extended to 24 nautical miles, as this House demanded in February 1999.

ilsp.query: Wir konnten auch die Schwachstellen im politischen Bereich kennen lernen, die ihren Ausdruck in einem äußerst gewalttätigen Klima finden, das die Beziehungen zwischen der Regierung von Frau Hasina Wajed, der Awani-Liga und den Oppositionskräften, insbesondere der Bangladesh National Party (BNP), die im Übrigen nicht regelmäßig an den Arbeiten des Parlaments teilnimmt, kennzeichnet.
ilsp.judge: We also became acquainted with the weaknesses in the political sphere, which find expression in an extremely violent climate that characterizes the relationships between the government under Mrs. Hasina Wajed, the Awami League, and opposition forces, particularly the Bangladesh National Party (BNP), which, incidentally, does not regularly participate in the parliamentary works.
ilsp.proxy: We were also able to learn about the weaknesses in the political sphere, which find expression in an extremely violent climate that characterizes the relations between the government of Mrs. Hasina Wajed, the Awami League and the opposition forces, in particular the Bangladesh National Party (BNP), which, by the way, does not regularly participate in the work of parliament.
ilsp.reference: We were also able to learn about the weaknesses in the political sphere, which found their expression in an extremely violent climate that characterizes the relationships between the government of Prime Minister Hasina Wajed, the Awami League, and the opposition forces, particularly the Bangladesh National Party (BNP), which, incidentally, does not regularly participate in the work of the parliament.

ilsp.query: Ich möchte Ihnen kurz die von der Allianz auf ihrer Tagung am 10. Januar getroffenen Maßnahmen in Erinnerung rufen: Erstens berief sie eine Beratung nationaler Militärmedizinexperten ein, um Kontakt miteinander aufzunehmen und alle Ideen, Sachverhalte, Ziele usw. auszutauschen; es wurde sofort eine Arbeitsgruppe gebildet, die als Zentrum für den Informationsaustausch dienen sollte und an der alle teilnehmen konnten - es scheint mir wichtig, das zu unterstreichen -, nicht nur die Länder der Allianz, sondern alle Länder, die in der einen oder anderen Weise an den friedenserhaltenden Operationen beteiligt waren.
ilsp.judge: I would like to briefly remind you of the measures taken by the Alliance at their meeting on January 10th: Firstly, they convened a consultation with national military medical experts to establish contact with each other and exchange all ideas, facts, objectives, etc.; an immediate working group was formed that should serve as a center for information exchange and to which all countries could participate - it seems important to emphasize this - not just the Alliance countries, but all countries that were in any way involved in peacekeeping operations.
ilsp.proxy: I would like to briefly remind you of the measures taken by the Allianz at its meeting on January 10th: First, it convened a consultation of national military medical experts to establish contact and exchange all ideas, facts, goals, etc.; an immediate working group was formed, which was to serve as a center for information exchange and which all could participate in - it seems important to me to emphasize this - not only the countries of the Allianz, but all countries that were involved in peacekeeping operations in one way or another.
ilsp.reference: I would like to remind you of the measures taken by the Alliance at their meeting on January 10th: Firstly, they convened a consultation of national military medical experts to establish contact with one another and exchange all ideas, matters, goals, etc.; an immediate working group was formed, which was intended to serve as a centre for information exchange and in which all could participate - I think it's essential to stress this - not only the Alliance member states, but all countries that were involved in some way in the peacekeeping operations.

ilsp.query: Was den Wunsch nach Verzicht auf eine geographische Begrenzung für diese schnelle Eingreiftruppe anbelangt, so erinnert dies an die Raubzüge der früheren Kolonialmächte in Afrika und anderswo, wie sie etwa von Frankreich begangen wurden, um vom Volk abgelehnte Diktatoren zu schützen, oder wie sie derzeit von Großbritannien in Sierra Leone durchgeführt werden.
ilsp.judge: Regarding the desire to forgo a geographical limitation for this rapid reaction force, this reminds us of the plundering expeditions of former colonial powers in Africa and elsewhere, such as those carried out by France to protect despotic leaders rejected by the people, or as they are currently conducted by the United Kingdom in Sierra Leone.
ilsp.proxy: As for the desire to waive a geographical limitation for this rapid reaction force, this recalls the raids of former colonial powers in Africa and elsewhere, such as those carried out by France to protect dictators rejected by the people, or as they are currently being carried out by Britain in Sierra Leone.

ilsp.query: Was seit der reichlich hysterischen Aufbauschung dieser Krise in den meisten unserer Mitgliedstaaten geschieht, trägt sicher nicht dazu bei, junge Menschen zu motivieren, in der Landwirtschaft zu bleiben und erst recht nicht, im ländlichen Raum ihre Zukunft zu sehen, wo sie, wie es in unserem Bericht so schön steht, eine wichtige soziale Funktion zu erfüllen haben, indem sie sich der Landschaftspflege und -erhaltung widmen und zur Deckung des wirtschaftlichen, sozialen und ökologischen Bedarfs des ländlichen Raums beitragen.
ilsp.judge: What has happened since the rather hysterical hype of this crisis in most of our member states certainly does not contribute to motivating young people to stay in agriculture, let alone see their future in rural areas, where, as our report beautifully states, they have an important social function to fulfill by dedicating themselves to landscape conservation and contributing to the economic, social, and ecological needs of the countryside.
ilsp.proxy: What is happening in most of our member states since the rather hysterical build-up of this crisis certainly does not contribute to motivating young people to stay in agriculture and even less so to see their future in the countryside, where, as our report so beautifully puts it, they have an important social function to fulfill by dedicating themselves to landscape care and conservation and contributing to the economic, social and ecological needs of the countryside.
ilsp.reference: What has been happening since the over-the-top dramatization of this crisis in most of our member states certainly does not contribute to motivating young people to stay in agriculture and even less to seeing their future in rural areas, where, as our report so aptly puts it, they have an important social function to fulfill by devoting themselves to landscape care and conservation and contributing to meeting the economic, social, and ecological needs of rural areas.

ilsp.query: Herr Präsident, ich habe zwar für diesen Bericht über die Gemeinsame Fischereipolitik gestimmt, doch fordere ich das Europäische Parlament, den Rat und die Kommission auf, einen unter Ziffer 20 des Berichts gehörenden, jedoch vergessenen Aspekt stärker im Auge zu haben und zu überwachen, nämlich auf welche Art und Weise bzw. ob überhaupt Rentenbetrag, -höhe und -bedingungen im Fischereisektor, und insbesondere der Rentner im Bereich der handwerklichen Fischerei, kontrolliert werden.
ilsp.judge: Mr. President, although I voted for this report on the Common Fisheries Policy, I urge the European Parliament, the Council, and the Commission to pay more attention to and monitor an aspect that is mentioned under point 20 of the report but has been overlooked, namely how, or even if at all, pension amounts, levels, and conditions in the fisheries sector, and particularly among pensioners in the artisanal fishing sector, are controlled.
ilsp.proxy: Mr. President, although I voted in favour of this report on the Common Fisheries Policy, I call on the European Parliament, the Council and the Commission to pay closer attention to and monitor an aspect belonging to point 20 of the report, which has been overlooked, namely the way in which, or whether at all, pension amount, level and conditions in the fishing sector, and in particular for pensioners in the artisanal fishing sector, are controlled.
ilsp.reference: Mr. President, I have indeed voted in favor of this report on the Common Fisheries Policy, but I call on the European Parliament, the Council, and the Commission to pay closer attention to and monitor a particular aspect mentioned under point 20 of the report, which has been overlooked, namely how, or indeed whether, pension amounts, levels, and conditions are controlled in the fishing sector, and particularly for pensioners in the artisanal fishing industry.

ilsp.query: Der Einsatz dieses Waffentyps durch die Vereinigten Staaten und andere NATO-Länder während des Golfkriegs, in Bosnien und im Kosovo hat bereits den Tod vieler Soldaten, Leiden und Todesfälle bei den Bewohnern der bombardierten Gebiete und die Verseuchung der Umwelt in den betroffenen Regionen verursacht.
ilsp.judge: The deployment of this type of weapon by the United States and other NATO countries during the Gulf War, in Bosnia, and in Kosovo has already caused the deaths of many soldiers, suffering and fatalities among the inhabitants of the bombed areas, and environmental pollution in the affected regions.
ilsp.proxy: The use of this type of weapon by the United States and other NATO countries during the Gulf War, in Bosnia and Kosovo has already caused the death of many soldiers, suffering and fatalities among the inhabitants of the bombed areas and the contamination of the environment in the affected regions.
ilsp.reference: The deployment of this type of weapon by the United States and other NATO countries during the Gulf War, in Bosnia, and in Kosovo has already caused the deaths of many soldiers, suffering, and fatalities among the inhabitants of the bombed areas, as well as environmental pollution in the affected regions.

ilsp.query: Der von mir bereits erwähnte Beschluss besagt, dass ein Bürger eines EU-Mitgliedstaates, der sich um konsularische Hilfe an eine diplomatische oder konsularische Vertretung eines anderen Mitgliedstaates wendet, so zu behandeln ist, als wäre er Bürger des Landes, das durch die betreffende Botschaft oder das Konsulat vertreten wird.
ilsp.judge: The resolution I have already mentioned states that a citizen of an EU member state who seeks consular assistance from a diplomatic or consular representation of another member state should be treated as if they were a citizen of the country represented by the embassy or consulate.
ilsp.proxy: The resolution I mentioned earlier states that a citizen of an EU member state who seeks consular assistance from a diplomatic or consular representation of another member state shall be treated as if he were a citizen of the country represented by the embassy or consulate in question.
ilsp.reference: The decision I mentioned earlier states that a citizen of an EU member state who seeks consular assistance from a diplomatic or consular representation of another member state is to be treated as if they were a citizen of the country represented by the relevant embassy or consulate.

ilsp.query: Der Rat begrüßt außerdem die Tatsache, dass sich die EU und die ASEAN in ihrer in Vientiane beschlossenen gemeinsamen Erklärung verpflichten, die Bemühungen des Sonderbeauftragten des UNO-Generalsekretärs für Birma, Tan Sri Razali Ismail, um eine positive Entwicklung in Burma zu unterstützen.
ilsp.judge: The Council also welcomes that the EU and the ASEAN have committed themselves in their joint declaration adopted in Vientiane to support the efforts of the Special Adviser of the UN Secretary-General for Myanmar, Tan Sri Razali Ismail, to promote a positive development in Myanmar.
ilsp.proxy: The Council also welcomes the fact that the EU and ASEAN, in their joint declaration adopted in Vientiane, commit to supporting the efforts of the UN Secretary-General's Special Envoy for Burma, Tan Sri Razali Ismail, to promote a positive development in Burma.
ilsp.reference: The Council also welcomes the fact that the EU and ASEAN have committed themselves in their joint statement adopted in Vientiane to supporting the efforts of the UN Secretary-General's Special Envoy for Myanmar, Tan Sri Razali Ismail, to promote a positive development in Myanmar.

ilsp.query: Im Ausschuss für Regionalpolitik, Verkehr und Fremdenverkehr ist man sich jedoch darüber im Klaren, dass die Gewerkschaften und die Luftfahrtunternehmen am besten geeignet sind, um eine Lösung für dieses Problem zu finden, und so haben sich die Mitglieder des Ausschusses in einem Kompromiss darauf geeinigt, allen Beteiligten bis zum 1. Mai 2001 Zeit zu geben, um eine Einigung zu erreichen, auf deren Grundlage dann der Text des neuen Abschnitts Q erstellt werden soll.
ilsp.judge: In the Committee on Regional Policy, Transport, and Tourism, it is clear that the trade unions and aviation companies are best suited to find a solution to this problem, and thus the committee members have agreed on a compromise to give all parties until May 1, 2001, to reach an agreement on which basis the text of the new section Q will then be drafted.
ilsp.proxy: However, the Committee for Regional Policy, Transport and Tourism is aware that the trade unions and the airlines are best suited to find a solution to this problem, and so the committee members have agreed in a compromise to give all parties until May 1, 2001 to reach an agreement, on the basis of which the text of the new section Q will then be created.

ilsp.query: Meines Erachtens wird hierdurch deutlich, dass die Verkehrssicherheit nicht mit herausgegriffenen Einzelmaßnahmen im erforderlichen Maße erhöht werden kann, sondern dass dies nur durch einen ganzen Komplex von Maßnahmen machbar ist, und dazu gehören Verkehrserziehung, Geschwindigkeitsbegrenzung, Alkoholbegrenzung, besserer Straßenausbau, Verkehrsleitsysteme, erhöhter Sicherheitsstandard der Fahrzeuge, stärkere Kontrollen der Einhaltung der Straßenverkehrsordnung und auch eine permanente Begutachtung der Fahrzeuge, die sich im Straßenverkehr befinden.
ilsp.judge: In my opinion, it becomes clear here that traffic safety cannot be increased sufficiently through makeshift individual measures alone, but can only be achieved through a comprehensive range of measures, which include traffic education, speed limits, alcohol limits, better road infrastructure, traffic control systems, higher vehicle safety standards, stronger enforcement of traffic regulations, and also continuous inspection of vehicles in circulation.
ilsp.proxy: In my opinion, this clearly shows that road safety cannot be sufficiently increased by isolated measures, but only by a comprehensive package of measures, which include traffic education, speed limits, alcohol limits, improved road construction, traffic management systems, higher safety standards for vehicles, stricter enforcement of traffic regulations, and also a permanent inspection of vehicles on the road.
ilsp.reference: In my opinion, it becomes clear that road safety cannot be increased to the required extent by isolated individual measures, but rather that this can only be achieved through a comprehensive set of measures, including traffic education, speed limits, alcohol restrictions, improved road infrastructure, traffic management systems, enhanced vehicle safety standards, stricter enforcement of traffic regulations, and also a permanent inspection of vehicles that are in operation on the roads.

ilsp.query: Herr Präsident, die Straßenverkehrssicherheit kann und muss sowohl für Europa insgesamt als auch für jedes einzelne Land eine Priorität darstellen. Deshalb stimme ich auch dem Vorschlag von Frau Hedkvist Petersen - die ich mir an dieser Stelle zu ihrem Bericht zu beglückwünschen erlaube - zu, einen strategischen Plan für die Straßenverkehrssicherheit zu entwerfen und eine Reihe strikter, aber auch realistischer quantitativer Ziele festzulegen.
ilsp.judge: Mr. President, road traffic safety must and can be a priority for Europe as a whole and for each individual country. That is why I also support Mrs. Hedkvist Petersen's proposal – which I would like to congratulate her on at this point regarding her report – to develop a strategic plan for road traffic safety and to set a series of strict but also realistic quantitative goals.
ilsp.proxy: Mr. President, road safety must be a priority for both Europe as a whole and for each individual country. That is why I also agree with Ms. Hedkvist Petersen's proposal - which I would like to congratulate her on at this point for her report - to develop a strategic plan for road safety and set a number of strict but also realistic quantitative goals.
ilsp.reference: Mr. President, road safety can and must be a priority both for Europe as a whole and for each individual country. That's why I also agree with the proposal by Mrs. Hedkvist Petersen - whom I would like to congratulate on her report at this point - to draw up a strategic plan for road safety and set a series of strict, but also realistic, quantitative targets.

ilsp.query: Der nächste Schritt muss darin bestehen, dass man in Erwägung zieht, in den Fällen, wo die Anlastung einiger dieser Kosten keinen Sinn mehr hätte - ich denke dabei an die italienischen Autobahnen, die sich weitgehend amortisiert haben -, mit diesen heute existierenden Gebühren Fonds zu bilden, die möglicherweise für Quersubventionen genutzt werden könnten, um zu erreichen, dass bestimmte den Straßenbenutzern auferlegte Gebühren für die Verbesserung der Infrastruktur anderer, mit Sicherheit umweltverträglicherer Verkehrsträger verwendet werden.
ilsp.judge: The next step must be to consider forming funds with these existing tolls in cases where the imposition of some of these costs no longer makes sense – I am thinking of Italian motorways that have been largely paid off – which could then be used for cross-subsidies to ensure that certain tolls imposed on road users for the improvement of infrastructure of other, undoubtedly more environmentally friendly transport modes, are utilized.
ilsp.proxy: The next step must be to consider, in cases where relieving some of these costs would no longer make sense - I'm thinking of Italian motorways, which have largely been amortized - forming existing toll funds that could possibly be used for cross-subsidies to ensure that certain fees imposed on road users for the improvement of infrastructure of other, certainly more environmentally friendly modes of transport are used.
ilsp.reference: The next step must be to consider forming funds using the existing fees in cases where the allocation of some of these costs would no longer make sense - I am thinking of the Italian motorways, which have largely been amortized - that could possibly be used for cross-subsidies to achieve the goal that certain fees imposed on road users are used for the improvement of the infrastructure of other, certainly more environmentally friendly modes of transport.

ilsp.query: Der Berichterstatter freut sich über die grundsätzliche Übereinstimmung in den im Bericht enthaltenen grundlegenden Prinzipien, nämlich darin, dass es in die Zuständigkeit der Gemeinschaft fällt, eine gemeinsame Methodik zur Berechnung der Kosten des Verkehrs zu entwickeln; dass externe Kosten in eine solche Bewertung einfließen sollten; dass die Einnahmen für die Verringerung von Umweltschäden und die Förderung des Übergangs zu umweltschonenderen Verkehrsträgern zu verwenden seien; dass die Umsetzung vom Prinzip der Subsidiarität bestimmt sein sollte; dass die Nutzer und Verursacher in Abhängigkeit von der Benutzung zahlen und dass Ausnahmen für die weniger mobilen Mitglieder der Gesellschaft und die Bewohner ländlicher Gebiete gelten sollten.
ilsp.judge: The rapporteur is pleased with the fundamental agreement on the basic principles contained in the report, namely that it falls within the competence of the Community to develop a common methodology for calculating the costs of transport; that external costs should be taken into account in such an assessment; that revenues for reducing environmental damage and promoting the transition to more environmentally friendly modes of transport should be used; that implementation should be determined by the principle of subsidiarity; that users and polluters should pay according to their use; and that exemptions should apply for less mobile members of society and rural residents.
ilsp.proxy: The reporter is pleased about the fundamental agreement on the basic principles contained in the report, namely that it is within the competence of the community to develop a common methodology for calculating transport costs; that external costs should be included in such an assessment; that the revenue should be used to reduce environmental damage and promote the transition to more environmentally friendly modes of transport; that the implementation should be determined by the principle of subsidiarity; that users and polluters should pay according to their use; and that exceptions should apply to less mobile members of society and residents of rural areas.
ilsp.reference: The rapporteur welcomes the fundamental agreement on the basic principles contained in the report, namely that it falls within the competence of the community to develop a common methodology for calculating the costs of transport; that external costs should be taken into account in such an assessment; that revenues for reducing environmental damage and promoting a transition to more environmentally friendly modes of transport should be used; that implementation should be determined by the principle of subsidiarity; that users and polluters should pay in proportion to their use; and that exceptions should apply to the less mobile members of society and residents of rural areas.

ilsp.query: Herr Kollege Posselt, selbst wenn es wirklich eine Bereicherung wäre, wenn Sie 20 Minuten redeten - ich könnte ja dann auch 20 Minuten reden, weil auch von unserer Fraktion keiner mehr da ist -, wäre es in der Tat so, dass die Arbeit, die der Kollege Deprez sehr sorgfältig durchgeführt hat, hier nicht in dem Maße diskutiert werden könnte, wie es angemessen wäre.

ilsp.query: Herr Präsident, die Älteren unter uns haben die außergewöhnlichen, grauenhaften Berichte, die 1975 aus Kambodscha kamen, noch nicht vergessen. Es gab Luftaufnahmen von einer verlassenen Hauptstadt, weil die Roten Khmer, deren Anführer nach den Lehrsätzen der Gewalt in der Tradition der französischen Revolution geschult wurden und von einer Mischung aus politischem Idealismus und Massenpsychopathologie erfüllt waren, zwei Millionen Menschen von der Stadt auf das Land umsiedelten, um unter der Führung des "großen " Pol Pot im Jahre Null mit einer neuen Gesellschaft zu beginnen.
ilsp.judge: Mr. President, those of us who are older have not yet forgotten the extraordinary and horrific reports that came from Cambodia in 1975. There were aerial photographs of an abandoned capital city, as the Khmer Rouge, whose leaders were trained in the tradition of violence according to the principles of the French Revolution and were filled with a mixture of political idealism and mass psychopathy, relocated two million people from the city to the countryside, under the leadership of "Great" Pol Pot, to begin a new society in the year zero.
ilsp.proxy: Mr. President, those of us who are older still remember the extraordinary, horrifying reports that came out of Cambodia in 1975. ilsp.reference: Mr. President, those of us who are older have not forgotten the extraordinary, horrific reports that came from Cambodia in 1975. lsp.query: Meiner Ansicht nach können wir nicht auf der einen Seite die Vollbeschäftigung zu einer Aktionspriorität der Europäischen Union erheben und uns mit der Ausarbeitung eines Statuts der Europäischen Aktiengesellschaft beschäftigen, das neue Rechte für Arbeitnehmer vorsieht, und auf der anderen Seite passiv eine derartige Strategie hinnehmen, die den Gesetzen der Aktienmärkte Vorrang vor allen anderen Erwägungen einräumt.
lsp.judge: In my opinion, we cannot make full employment a top priority of the European Union on one hand and simultaneously engage in drafting a statute for the European Stock Corporation that grants new rights to employees, while on the other hand passively accepting a strategy that gives precedence to the laws of stock markets over all other considerations.
lsp.proxy: In my view, we cannot on the one hand make full employment a priority action of the European Union and work on a statute for the European company which provides new rights for employees, and on the other hand passively accept a strategy which gives precedence to the laws of the stock market over all other considerations.
lsp.reference: In my opinion, we cannot elevate full employment to a priority of the European Union on one side and engage in drafting a statute for the European Company that provides new rights for employees, while passively accepting a strategy on the other side that gives precedence to the laws of the stock markets over all other considerations.

lsp.query: Ich möchte die Präsidentin bitten, der Regierung in Ankara gegenüber unsere Sorge über diesen Vorfall sowie unsere Hoffnung, dass dieser bedauerliche Vorfall die Lösung des Zypernproblems und die wieder aufgenommenen Friedensverhandlungen nicht beeinträchtigen möge, wie wir auch hoffen, dass Herr Tsiakourmas so schnell wie möglich wieder auf freien Fuß gesetzt wird.
lsp.judge: I would like to ask the President to convey our concern about this incident to the government in Ankara, and to express our hope that this regrettable incident does not impair the solution of the Cyprus problem and the resumed peace negotiations, as we also hope for Mr. Tsiakourmas to be set free as soon as possible.
lsp.proxy: I would like to ask the President to express to the government in Ankara our concern about this incident, as well as our hope that this unfortunate incident will not affect the solution to the Cyprus problem and the resumed peace talks, just as we also hope that Mr. Tsiakourmas will be released as soon as possible.
lsp.reference: I would like to ask the President to request the government in Ankara to take note of our concern over this incident and our hope that this unfortunate incident may not hinder the solution of the Cyprus problem and the resumed peace negotiations, as we also hope that Mr. Tsiakourmas will be released as soon as possible.

lsp.query: Zudem lehnt es Herr Denktasch, der Führer "Nord-Zyperns ", das - nur zur Erinnerung - unter türkischer Besatzung steht, ab, an weiteren Gesprächen zur Lösung des Zypernproblems teilzunehmen. Offensichtlich fühlt er sich weitaus stärker als je zuvor, nachdem die Europäische Union die Türkei ohne langes Nachdenken, wie ich meine, in den Kreis der EU-Beitrittskandidaten aufgenommen hat.
lsp.judge: Moreover, Mr. Denktash, the leader of "Northern Cyprus," which, as a reminder, is under Turkish occupation, refuses to participate in further talks aimed at solving the Cyprus problem. Clearly, he feels much stronger than ever before, after the European Union admitted Turkey, without much hesitation, as I see it, into the circle of EU candidate countries.

lsp.reference: In addition, Mr. Denktasch, the leader of "Northern Cyprus", which is under Turkish occupation, as a reminder, rejects participating in further talks to solve the Cyprus problem. lsp.query: Faktisch soll diese Richtlinie Sicherheit hinsichtlich der Vorschriften bieten, die kohärente und sektorspezifische Regelungen für die Institute, die Aktiva, die Rechte und die geschäftlichen Beziehungen vorsehen, falls eine in mehreren Mitgliedstaaten der Union tätige Bank in Schwierigkeiten gerät oder Konkurs anmelden muss.
lsp.judge: In fact, this directive aims to ensure safety in terms of regulations that provide coherent and sector-specific rules for the institutions, their assets, rights, and business relationships, should a bank active in several Member States of the Union run into difficulties or be forced into insolvency.
lsp.proxy: In practice, this directive is intended to provide security with regard to the provisions that provide coherent and sector-specific rules for institutions, assets, rights, and business relationships in the event that a bank operating in several Member States of the Union encounters difficulties or is required to file for bankruptcy.
lsp.reference: In substance, this guideline is intended to provide security with regard to the rules that provide for coherent and sector-specific regulations for institutions, assets, rights, and business relationships, in the event that a bank active in several member states of the Union encounters difficulties or is forced to file for bankruptcy.

lsp.query: In seinem mit qualifizierter Mehrheit angenommenen Gemeinsamen Standpunkt beweist der Rat ein feines und sicheres Gespür für die Eigenheiten des Banksektors, die ihn sowohl hinsichtlich des Insolvenzverfahrens generell als auch eines Vergleichs mit den anderen Finanzsektoren, wie dem Versicherungswesen und dem Wertpapierhandel, eine Sonderstellung einnehmen lassen.
lsp.judge: In its Common Position adopted with a qualified majority, the Council demonstrates a fine and secure sense for the peculiarities of the banking sector, which enables it to occupy a special position both generally regarding insolvency proceedings and when compared to other financial sectors such as insurance and securities trading.
lsp.proxy: In its common position adopted by qualified majority, the Council demonstrates a fine and secure sense of the specific characteristics of the banking sector, which give it a special position both in terms of insolvency proceedings in general and in comparison with other financial sectors, such as insurance and securities trading.
lsp.reference: In its Common Position adopted by a qualified majority, the Council demonstrates a fine and secure sense of the idiosyncrasies of the banking sector, which, in general terms, as well as in comparison with other financial sectors, such as insurance and securities trading, entitles it to a special position in the context of insolvency proceedings.

lsp.query: In dem Bericht von Frau Peijs - zu dem ich ihr im Namen der Kommission gratulieren möchte, wobei ich mich den Komplimenten von Frau Villiers und Herrn Skinner gern anschließe -, der weitestgehend positiv zu dem Gemeinsamen Standpunkt steht, werden - wie heute Abend bereits erwähnt - mehrere Änderungsanträge zu Artikel 20 vorgeschlagen.
lsp.judge: In the report by Mrs. Peijs - for which I would like to congratulate her on behalf of the Commission, and I would also like to join the compliments of Mrs. Villiers and Mr. Skinner - which is largely positive towards the Common Position, several amendments to Article 20 are proposed, as already mentioned this evening.
lsp.proxy: In the report by Mrs Peijs - to which I would like to offer my congratulations on behalf of the Commission, while associating myself with the compliments paid by Mrs Villiers and Mr Skinner -, which is largely positive with regard to the common position, several amendments to Article 20 are proposed, as mentioned this evening.

lsp.query: In der berühmt-berüchtigten Sonderzulage, die so viel Kritik ausgelöst hat, möchte ich anmerken, dass, wenn jeder Bedienstete der Europäischen Zentralbank pro Jahr Anrecht auf eine 9 %ige Gehaltszulage hat, die 38 %, die ihnen über einen Zeitraum von 54 Monaten gezahlt wurden, einem Satz von 8,5 % pro Jahr entsprechen.
lsp.judge: In the notoriously controversial special allowance, which has sparked so much criticism, I would note that if each employee of the European Central Bank is entitled to a 9% salary supplement per year, the 38% paid to them over a period of 54 months correspond to an annual rate of 8.5%.

lsp.judge: The Commission should propose project management, develop "best practice" methods, introduce benchmarks to check how much time passes from the first application to the successful creation of jobs, track cash flows, and ultimately sell the whole concept to the public.

lsp.query: Drittens sollte die Kommission bei sämtlichen bilateralen Steuervereinbarungen, die getroffen werden, sorgfältiger auf die Einhaltung des Grundsatzes des Beschäftigungslandes achten, dem zufolge die Steuergesetzgebung und die soziale Sicherheit zu koordinieren sind, um Problemen vorzubeugen und zu verhindern, dass die Arbeitnehmer zwischen zwei Stühlen sitzen.
lsp.judge: Thirdly, the Commission should carefully ensure compliance with the principle of the country of employment in all bilateral tax agreements that are concluded, according to which tax legislation and social security should be coordinated to prevent problems and to avoid having workers sitting between two stools.

lsp.query: Um eine qualitativ hochstehende Schulbildung zu sichern, sind genügend Schulen, Klassen mit einer begrenzten Schülerzahl, eine ausreichende Zahl von Lehrkräften, Lehrer und technisches sowie Verwaltungspersonal auf allen Unterrichtsstufen, angefangen von der Grundschule, erforderlich, denn in allen Ländern Europas beginnt gerade in den Grundschulklassen ein Differenzierungsprozess, der sich für die Kinder der weniger begüterten Schichten in einem vielfach nicht wieder auszugleichenden Bildungsrückstand äußert.
lsp.judge: To ensure high-quality school education, there must be sufficient schools, classes with a limited number of students, an adequate number of teachers, educators, and technical as well as administrative personnel at all levels of instruction, starting from primary school, because in all European countries, a differentiation process begins in primary school classes that results in an educational disadvantage for children from less affluent backgrounds, which is often not fully reversible.
lsp.proxy: To ensure a high-quality school education, sufficient schools, classes with a limited number of students, an adequate number of teachers, instructors, and technical as well as administrative staff at all levels of instruction, starting from elementary school, are required, because in all European countries, a differentiation process begins precisely in the elementary school classes, which for children from less affluent backgrounds often results in an educational disadvantage that cannot be compensated for in many cases.
lsp.reference: To ensure a high-quality education, sufficient schools, classes with a limited number of students, an adequate number of teaching staff, teachers, and technical as well as administrative personnel are required at all levels of instruction, starting from elementary school, because in all European countries, a differentiation process begins in elementary school classes, which manifests itself in a frequently irreparable educational backlog for the children of less affluent strata.

lsp.query: Daher müssen wir in diesem Rahmen der Verteidigung, der Wahrung und Förderung unseres Erbes unsere Architektur erhalten, unser Handwerk unterstützen, unsere Landschaften pflegen und erschließen, doch - und das möchte ich hervorheben - ohne sie vom Leben abzuschneiden und ohne die darin lebendigen Traditionen und kulturellen Gebräuche auszuschließen.
lsp.judge: Therefore, within this framework of defense, preservation, and promotion of our heritage, we must retain our architecture, support our craftsmanship, and conserve and develop our landscapes; yet - and this is what I want to emphasize - we must not cut them off from life and exclude the living traditions and cultural customs that exist within them.
lsp.proxy: Therefore, within this framework of defending, preserving, and promoting our heritage, we must preserve our architecture, support our craftsmanship, cultivate and develop our landscapes, but - and I would like to emphasize this - without isolating them from life and without excluding the living traditions and cultural customs that thrive within them.

lsp.query: Der Bericht des Parlaments offenbart vor allem, wie die genannten Finanzmittel verwaltet wurden, und zeigt die unkontrollierte, undurchsichtige Verschwendung von Steuergeldern der EU-Bürger auf, die ungeachtet der erklärten "humanitären und friedenstiftenden " Absichten zur Absicherung des Vordringens der großen Interessen der EU im NATO-Protektorat Bosnien eingesetzt werden.
lsp.judge: The parliamentary report reveals primarily how the mentioned financial resources were managed, and it shows the uncontrolled, opaque waste of EU taxpayers' money, which, despite the declared "humanitarian and peace-promoting" intentions, was used to secure the advance of the major interests of the EU in Bosnia, the NATO protectorate.

lsp.query: Wir werden nicht für den Bericht Staes stimmen, obgleich er nicht wenige zutreffende Feststellungen und Vorschläge enthält, denn generell kommt darin eine Auffassung zum Ausdruck, die der imperialistischen Präsenz nicht im Entferntesten etwas entgegensetzt und deren einziges Anliegen darin besteht, diese zu verklären, um sie den Völkern schmackhaft zu machen.
lsp.judge: We will not vote for the report by Staes, although it contains not a few accurate observations and proposals, because generally it expresses an outlook that in no way opposes imperialist presence and whose sole concern is to glorify it in order to make it palatable to the peoples.

lsp.query: Herr Präsident, ich habe zwar für den Bericht Dell'Alba gestimmt, doch möchte ich betonen, dass sich hinter dieser Zustimmung mein Standpunkt als Vertreter der italienischen Rentnerpartei verbirgt, den ich hiermit darlegen möchte: Ich bin unter allen Umständen gegen die inzwischen übliche und zur Gewohnheit gewordene Forderung, die Strukturfonds und die Gemeinschaftshilfen zu den einzelstaatlichen Hilfen hinzuzurechnen.
lsp.judge: Mr. President, although I voted for the Dell'Alba report, I would like to emphasize that my position as a representative of the Italian pensioners' party lies behind this vote, which I wish to outline here: Under no circumstances am I in favor of including the structural funds and community aid among the state aids.
lsp.proxy: Mr President, although I voted in favour of the Dell'Alba report, I would like to stress that behind this approval lies my position as a representative of the Italian pensioners' party, which I would like to outline as follows: I am, under all circumstances, opposed to the now common and habitual demand to add the Structural Funds and Community assistance to national assistance.
lsp.reference: Mr. President, I did vote for the Dell'Alba report, but I would like to emphasize that my stance as a representative of the Italian pensioners' party is hidden behind this vote, which I would like to present here: I am opposed to the demand, which has become a habit and is now customary, to include the structural funds and community aid in the individual state aid.

lsp.query: Vergegenwärtigen wir uns doch bloß einmal - und dabei beziehe ich mich auf mein Land -, wie in der Milchwirtschaft nun wirklich alles, vom Grashalm bis zur Milchablieferung im Supermarkt, kontrolliert wird, wie ferner Landwirte und Gärtner schon seit langem eine lückenlose Umwelt- und Kundenbuchhaltung führen müssen - was sie ja auch überaus engagiert tun -, und wie gleichzeitig die Tierschutzbestimmungen in den Ländern der Europäischen Union zu den weltweit strengsten gehören.
lsp.judge: Let us just once imagine – and I am referring to my country here – how in dairy farming, from the grass blade to milk delivery to supermarkets, everything is controlled, how farmers and gardeners have long had to maintain a comprehensive environmental and customer accounting system – which they do with great engagement – and how at the same time, animal protection regulations in the countries of the European Union are among the strictest in the world.

lsp.query: Einrichtungen, die mit Grenzarbeitnehmern zu tun haben, sind für den Grundsatz des Wohnlandes, die Gewerkschaften plädieren für den Grundsatz des Beschäftigungslandes, die Regierung selbst wiederum spricht sich für das Wohnlandprinzip aus usw. usw. Da der Knoten jedoch endlich einmal durchgeschlagen werden muss, werden wir einige der von Frau Oomen-Ruijten eingereichten Änderungsanträge, denen zufolge beide Grundsätze gemischt angewendet werden sollten, nicht unterstützen und schlagen vor, den Grundsatz des Beschäftigungslandes als Ausgangspunkt zu nehmen und auf das so genannte europäische Sozialmodell hinzuarbeiten.
lsp.judge: Institutions dealing with border workers advocate for the principle of the country of residence, trade unions argue for the principle of the country of employment, while the government itself speaks in favor of the principle of the country of residence, etc. etc. However, since this knot must eventually be untangled, we will not support some of the amendments submitted by Mrs. Oomen-Ruijten, according to which both principles should be applied in a mixed manner, but instead propose to take the principle of the country of employment as a starting point and work towards what is known as the European social model.

lsp.query: Ich möchte zwei Aspekte dieser Entwicklung hervorheben: Zum einen wird in unseren Ländern der Umweltschutz nur zögerlich in die Konzepte der verschiedenen sektoralen Politiken aufgenommen und stattdessen nach wie vor als eine Reihe von im Nachhinein durchzuführenden Maßnahmen betrachtet, mit denen eventuelle Schäden behoben werden können; zum anderen werden gerade aufgrund dieses nachträglichen Handelns die Kosten der Umsetzung der Richtlinien häufig als zu belastend und nicht wirklich sinnvoll empfunden, was auch auf die knappen von den Mitgliedstaaten bereitgestellten Mittel zurückzuführen ist.
lsp.judge: I would like to highlight two aspects of this development: On one hand, environmental protection is only slowly being integrated into the concepts of various sectoral policies and is still primarily viewed as a series of measures to be implemented after the fact, aimed at remedying any potential damage; on the other hand, precisely because of this reactive approach, the costs of implementing the directives are often perceived as overly burdensome and not really worthwhile, which also reflects the scarce resources provided by the member states.
lsp.proxy: I would like to highlight two aspects of this development: Firstly, environmental protection is only being gradually incorporated into the concepts of various sectoral policies in our countries, and is instead still viewed as a series of measures to be implemented retrospectively to rectify any potential damage; secondly, precisely due to this retrospective approach, the costs of implementing the directives are often perceived as too burdensome and not really meaningful, which can also be attributed to the limited funds provided by the Member States.
lsp.reference: I would like to highlight two aspects of this development: On the one hand, environmental protection is only gradually being incorporated into the concepts of various sectoral policies in our countries and is instead still viewed as a series of measures to be taken after the fact to rectify any damage; on the other hand, the costs of implementing the guidelines are often felt to be too burdensome and not truly meaningful, which can also be attributed to the limited funds provided by the member states.

lsp.query: Auch ich schließe mich der Auffassung an, dass das Fünfte Umweltaktionsprogramm hauptsächlich auf einen sektoralen Ansatz der Umweltpolitik abzielte, und vielleicht sollten wir, wenn wir uns Gedanken über das Sechste Programm machen, mehr Nachdruck auf die Einbeziehung der sozioökonomischen Akteure sowie der lokalen Behörden bei der Erreichung der jeweils festgelegten Ziele legen, damit der Schutz unserer Umwelt immer mehr in die Gesamtplanung integriert wird.
lsp.judge: I also subscribe to the view that the Fifth Environmental Action Programme primarily aimed at a sectoral approach to environmental policy, and perhaps when we consider the Sixth Programme, we should place more emphasis on involving socio-economic actors as well as local authorities in achieving the respective targets, so that the protection of our environment is increasingly integrated into overall planning.

lsp.query: In diesem Kontext wird es wichtig sein, wie es in unserem Entschließungsantrag heißt, beispielsweise auch über das Internet eine weite Verbreitung der besten und der schlechtesten Ergebnisse der Mitgliedstaaten bei der Umsetzung der Umweltrichtlinien zu gewährleisten, um ihr unterschiedliches Engagement in diesem Bereich deutlich zu machen und die Öffentlichkeit über das Verhalten der Mitgliedstaaten urteilen zu lassen, was fast immer auch wirksamer ist als ein Urteil des Gerichtshofs.
lsp.judge: In this context, it will be important, as our resolution proposal states, for example, to ensure a wide dissemination of both the best and the worst results of the Member States in implementing environmental directives via the internet, in order to clearly demonstrate their varying levels of engagement in this area and allow the public to judge the behavior of the Member States, which is usually more effective than a judgment by the Court.

lsp.query: Ich freue mich, dass ich den Großteil dessen, was die Vorsitzende des Ausschusses für Umweltfragen, Volksgesundheit und Verbraucherpolitik gesagt hat, unterstützen kann, wenngleich mir dabei nicht ganz wohl ist, denn die nächste Strafe, die der Europäische Gerichtshof verhängt, trifft möglicherweise das Vereinigte Königreich, weil es die Vorgaben der Badegewässer-Richtlinie trotz hoher Ausgaben und großer Anstrengungen immer noch nicht erfüllt.
lsp.judge: I am pleased to support much of what the Chairwoman of the Committee on Environment, Public Health and Food Safety said, although I feel uncomfortable doing so, as the next penalty imposed by the European Court of Justice might fall on the United Kingdom because it has still not met the requirements of the Bathing Waters Directive despite making significant expenditures and great efforts.

lsp.query: Selbstverständlich liegt die finanzielle und rechtliche Hauptverantwortung dafür bei den Mitgliedstaaten, aber die EU darf sich nicht darauf beschränken, Rechtsvorschriften zu erlassen und Fondsmittel bereitzustellen - was natürlich positiv ist - sondern muss auch die vielen vorhandenen guten Beispiele bekannt machen und eigene finanzielle Mittel dafür einsetzen, um eine positive Entwicklung zu fördern.
lsp.judge: Of course, the financial and legal main responsibility lies with the member states, but the EU must not limit itself to issuing regulations and providing funds - which is of course positive - but must also make many of the existing good examples known and use its own financial means to promote a positive development.

lsp.query: Einmal im Hinblick auf den Umweltschutz, den Hauptzweck der Richtlinien. lsp.query: Abschließend möchte ich Neil Parish und der Kommission empfehlen, diesen Bericht nicht als einen Schlusspunkt, sondern als Ausgangspunkt für ein gründliches Nachdenken über die Erneuerung der Landwirtschaft und die Reform der Gemeinsamen Agrarpolitik unter Einbeziehung vor allem der Vereinigungen der Junglandwirte zu sehen.
lsp.judge: In conclusion, I would like to recommend to Neil Parish and the Commission to view this report not as a conclusion, but as a starting point for thorough reflection on the renewal of agriculture and the reform of the Common Agricultural Policy, particularly involving young farmers' associations.

lsp.query: Diese zukünftige soziale Gemeinschaft bildet die Grundlage der Gemeinsamen Agrarpolitik, für die wir die Niederlassungsbeihilfe und die zusätzlichen Investitionshilfen verstärken müssen, hauptsächlich in jenen strukturschwachen Regionen mit zahlreichen stillgelegten Betrieben und verlassenen Dörfern, wo die jungen Leute die ländliche Wirtschaft wieder ankurbeln können, und zwar durch die Entwicklung von neuartigen Produkten wie dem Agrotourismus, dem ländlichen Tourismus von regionaler Bedeutung oder durch die Wiederansiedlung von Tier- und Pflanzenarten in diesen Naturräumen, womit ein Beitrag zu einer nachhaltigen und dauerhaften Entwicklung der Region geleistet wird.
lsp.judge: This future social community forms the basis for the Common Agricultural Policy, for which we must strengthen the investment support and additional investment aids, primarily in those structurally weak regions with numerous closed-down businesses and abandoned villages, where young people can revitalize rural economy through the development of new products such as agrotourism, regional rural tourism, or by reintroducing animal and plant species in these natural areas, thereby making a contribution to a sustainable and lasting regional development.
lsp.proxy: This future social community forms the basis of the Common Agricultural Policy, for which we must strengthen the settlement aid and additional investment aid, mainly in those structurally weak regions with numerous abandoned businesses and deserted villages, where young people can revive the rural economy, and this through the development of innovative products such as agrotourism, rural tourism of regional importance, or through the reintroduction of animal and plant species in these natural areas, thereby making a contribution to a sustainable and lasting development of the region.

lsp.query: Zweitens fehlt es in den meisten Fällen an Möglichkeiten, die Anreize auch wirklich zu nutzen. So kann sich ein Junglandwirt aufgrund der Quoten nicht wirklich betätigen, da die Quoten für alle Erzeugnisse ausgeschöpft sind und er entweder warten muss, bis eine nationale Reserve gebildet und auf die Junglandwirte aufgeteilt wird, oder aber Quoten aufkaufen muss, was ihn aber nie auf einen grünen Zweig bringen dürfte.
lsp.judge: Secondly, there are usually insufficient opportunities to actually make use of the incentives. Thus, a young farmer may not be able to fully utilize the quotas due to them being exhausted for all products, and he either has to wait until a national reserve is formed and distributed among the young farmers, or buy additional quotas, which would never put him on a solid financial footing.
lsp.proxy: Secondly, in most cases, there is a lack of opportunities to actually take advantage of the incentives. Thus, a young farmer cannot really get started due to the quotas, as the quotas for all products are exhausted and he either has to wait until a national reserve is formed and distributed to the young farmers, or he has to buy quotas, which should never bring him a profit.
lsp.reference: Secondly, in most cases, there is a lack of opportunities to actually utilize the incentives. So, a young farmer cannot really operate due to the quotas, as the quotas for all products are exhausted, and he either has to wait until a national reserve is formed and distributed to young farmers, or he has to buy quotas, which would never bring him to a green branch.

lsp.query: Nicht zufällig führen wir, nach der Verabschiedung der Agenda 2000, in der gegenwärtigen neuen Verhandlungsphase der WTO sowie nunmehr am Vorabend der nächsten Erweiterung, auch heute hier wieder eine Diskussion über die Zukunft der Junglandwirte, jener jungen Leute, die in vielen Ländern unserer Union auf die Möglichkeit einer dauerhaften Tätigkeit im Agrarsektor setzen.
lsp.judge: Not coincidentally, after the adoption of Agenda 2000, during the current new negotiation phase of the WTO, and now on the eve of the next expansion, we are once again discussing the future of young farmers, those young people who in many countries of our Union rely on the prospect of a sustainable career in agriculture.

lsp.query: Vergegenwärtigen wir uns doch bloß einmal - und dabei beziehe ich mich auf mein Land -, wie in der Milchwirtschaft nun wirklich alles, vom Grashalm bis zur Milchablieferung im Supermarkt, kontrolliert wird, wie ferner Landwirte und Gärtner schon seit langem eine lückenlose Umwelt- und Kundenbuchhaltung führen müssen - was sie ja auch überaus engagiert tun -, und wie gleichzeitig die Tierschutzbestimmungen in den Ländern der Europäischen Union zu den weltweit strengsten gehören.
lsp.judge: Let us just once imagine – and I am referring to my country here – how in dairy farming, from the grass blade to milk delivery to supermarkets, everything is controlled, how farmers and gardeners have long had to maintain a comprehensive environmental and customer accounting system – which they do with great engagement – and how at the same time, animal protection regulations in the countries of the European Union are among the strictest in the world.

lsp.query: Frau Ahern, meine Damen und Herren! lsp.judge: Ms. Ahern, ladies and gentlemen! The Commission values the achieved progress and shares the inspectors' wish to see a sustained impetus for improving the safety culture at all levels of leadership, and of course, we will continue to monitor the events at Sellafield within our areas of responsibility, or rather, the areas where we lack such responsibilities.

lsp.query: Abschließend und im Rahmen dieser Hilfen für die erneuerbaren Energien, die für mich wesentlich sind und nicht nur für Erklärungen herhalten, sondern eine Zielsetzung darstellen - und denken Sie daran, dass zum ersten Mal Staat für Staat konkrete und differenzierte Ziele aufgestellt werden und zwar in der Richtlinie über grüne Energie -, halte ich es auf jeden Fall für unerlässlich, der Forschung im Nuklearsektor weiterhin Unterstützung zu geben, insbesondere im Bereich der Sicherheit, Lagerung und Aufbereitung von Rückständen, denn sie u vergraben ist keine Lösung, oder bei Alternativfragen wie beispielsweise der Kernfusion.
lsp.judge: Finally, and within the framework of these aids for renewable energies, which are crucial for me and not just for explanations but represent a goal – and remember that for the first time concrete and differentiated targets have been set on a country-to-country basis, specifically in the Green Energy Directive – I consider it absolutely essential to continue supporting research in the nuclear sector, especially in the areas of safety, storage, and processing of waste, because burying it is not a solution, or when considering alternative questions such as nuclear fusion, for example.
lsp.proxy: In conclusion, and within the framework of these measures to support renewable energy, which are essential to me and not just for explanations, but represent a goal - and remember that for the first time, country by country, concrete and differentiated goals are being set, namely in the directive on green energy - I consider it essential to continue providing support to research in the nuclear sector, particularly in the areas of safety, storage, and processing of residues, because burying them is not a solution, or in alternative questions such as nuclear fusion.
lsp.reference: In conclusion, and within the framework of these aids for renewable energies, which are essential to me and not just there to provide explanations, but represent a goal-setting - and remember that for the first time, state by state, concrete and differentiated goals are being set, namely in the directive on green energy - I firmly believe it is essential to continue supporting research in the nuclear sector, particularly in the areas of safety, storage, and processing of residues, because burying it is no solution, or in alternative questions such as, for example, nuclear fusion.

lsp.query: Unser Potenzial an erneuerbaren Energien in der Europäischen Union ist begrenzt, sowohl aus physikalischen Gründen - denn mit Ausnahme der Sonnenenergie, bei der wir vielleicht einen größeren Spielraum haben, sind den anderen klare Grenzen gesetzt - wie auch aus wirtschaftlichen Gründen, denn in der Tat benötigen die erneuerbaren Energien Hilfen - und ich sagte schon, dass ich konkrete und positive Maßnahmen in dieser Richtung ergriffen habe -, aber dennoch müssen ein gewisses Niveau der Wettbewerbsfähigkeit und eine bestimmte Ausgewogenheit gewahrt bleiben.
lsp.judge: Our potential for renewable energies within the European Union is limited, both for physical reasons - because, with the exception of solar energy, where we might have a larger margin, clear limits are set for the others - and for economic reasons, as renewable energies do indeed require support - and I already mentioned that I took concrete and positive measures in this direction - but still, a certain level of competitiveness and a specific balance must be maintained.
lsp.proxy: Our potential for renewable energy in the European Union is limited, both for physical reasons - because, apart from solar energy, where we may have more leeway, the others have clear limits - and for economic reasons, because in fact renewable energies need help - and I said that I have taken concrete and positive measures in this direction -, but still a certain level of competitiveness and a certain balance must be maintained.
lsp.reference: Our potential for renewable energies in the European Union is limited, both from physical reasons - since, with the exception of solar energy, where we may have a larger scope, clear boundaries are set for the others - as well as from economic reasons, since in fact renewable energies require assistance - and I mentioned that I have taken concrete and positive measures in this regard -, but nonetheless a certain level of competitiveness and a certain balance must be maintained.

lsp.query: Die Außenpolitik unserer Union auf dem Gebiet des Fischereiwesens muss an Glaubwürdigkeit und Ansehen gewinnen, was sie heute noch nicht hat, indem man der Weltöffentlichkeit vor Augen führt, was sie wirklich ist: die Politik einer Fischereimacht, die in jeder Hinsicht den Grundsätzen der Vereinten Nationen verbunden ist, d.h. der Entwicklung des internationalen Seerechts, der Erhaltung unser aller natürlichen Ressourcen, der Entwicklungszusammenarbeit etc.
lsp.judge: The foreign policy of our union in the field of fisheries must gain credibility and prestige, which it does not have today, by showing the world what it really is: the policy of a fishing power that is connected in every respect to the principles of the United Nations, i.e., the development of international maritime law, the conservation of our natural resources, development cooperation, etc.
lsp.proxy: The foreign policy of our Union in the field of fisheries must gain credibility and reputation, which it still lacks today, by showing the world public what it really is: the policy of a fishing power that is committed to the principles of the United Nations in every respect, i.e. the development of international maritime law, the preservation of our natural resources, development cooperation, etc.
lsp.reference: The foreign policy of our union in the field of fisheries must gain credibility and reputation, which it does not have today, by presenting to the world public what it really is: the policy of a fishing power that is connected to the principles of the United Nations in every respect, i.e. the development of international maritime law, the conservation of our natural resources, development cooperation, etc.

lsp.query: Wir sollten deshalb eine aktive Politik betreiben, sowohl bei den Fischereiabkommen mit Drittländern, die an die jeweilige Situation anzupassen sind, als auch in den regionalen Fischereiorganisationen, in denen wir, wie so oft gesagt, die Führung übernehmen müssen und uns nicht damit zufrieden geben dürfen, dass die fünfzehn Staaten, die derzeit die Europäische Union bilden - morgen sind es vielleicht zwanzig oder fünfundzwanzig -, immer das gleiche Gewicht behalten wie zum Beispiel heute Estland.
lsp.judge: We should therefore pursue an active policy both in fisheries agreements with third countries, which need to be tailored to the respective situation, as well as in regional fisheries organizations, in which we must take the lead, as we often say, and cannot content ourselves with the fact that the fifteen states that currently make up the European Union - tomorrow there might be twenty or twenty-five - always retain the same weight as, for example, Estonia does today.

lsp.query: In den Schlussfolgerungen zu ihrer Mitteilung führt die Kommission u. a. folgende Prioritäten auf: verbesserte Kohärenz unter den verschiedenen Zielen, die die GFP verfolgt, wie etwa die Erhaltung der Ressourcen, die Wirtschaftlichkeit der Fischereiflotten und die Arbeitsplatzsicherung in Gebieten, die von der Fischerei abhängig sind; Berücksichtigung der wirtschaftlichen Dimension der Fischereibewirtschaftung; verbesserte Integration der Umwelt- und der Fischereipolitik; Verbesserung der Bewirtschaftungsinstrumente, wie beispielsweise die mehrjährigen Bewirtschaftungsziele und -pläne, die Steuerung des Fischereiaufwands und die vollständige Integration des Mittelmeerraums in die Bewirtschaftungsregelung der Gemeinschaft; ein übersichtlicherer Entscheidungsfindungsprozess und die Erhaltung der externen Dimension der GFP.
lsp.judge: In the conclusions of their communication, the Commission highlights the following priorities: improved coherence among the various objectives pursued by the Common Fisheries Policy (CFP), such as the conservation of resources, the economic viability of fishing fleets, and job security in regions dependent on fisheries; consideration of the economic dimension of fisheries management; improved integration of environmental and fisheries policies; better management tools, such as multi-annual management plans and objectives, the regulation of fishing effort, and the full integration of the Mediterranean into the Community's management regulation; a more transparent decision-making process and the maintenance of the external dimension of the CFP.

lsp.query: Ihre Anwesenheit geht auf ein Ersuchen der PSE-Fraktion in der Konferenz der Präsidenten zurück, und ich erinnere Sie daran, dass Sie im Oktober 1999, einen Monat vor dem Auslaufen des Abkommens, hier sagten, dass Sie sich "massiv dafür einsetzen würden, dass es hier zu einer Lösung kommt " und dass Sie "auch nasse Füße in Kauf nehmen würden ".
