lsp.query: Das Problem besteht für mich darin, dass es keine Abstimmung zwischen den Bemühungen der verschiedenen Dienste der Kommission gegeben hat, dass kein ausreichender politischer Impuls des Rates vorhanden war und es seitens der Regierung des am stärksten betroffenen Landes keine deutlichen Worte, kein kluges Vorgehen und keine parallele Arbeit gegeben hat, was meiner Meinung nach der gravierendste Punkt ist.
lsp.judge: The problem for me lies in the lack of coordination between the efforts of the various Commission services, the absence of a sufficient political impetus from the Council, and the lack of clear words, wise action, and parallel work on the part of the government of the most affected country, which I consider to be the gravest point.
lsp.proxy: The problem for me is that there was no coordination between the efforts of the Commission's various services, that there was no sufficient political impetus from the Council, and that on the part of the government of the country most affected, there were no clear words, no wise approach, and no parallel work, which in my opinion is the most serious point.
lsp.reference: The problem lies in the fact that there has been no coordination between the efforts of the various services of the commission, that there was no sufficient political impetus from the council, and that from the government of the most affected country, there were no clear words, no wise approach, and no parallel work, which in my opinion is the most critical point.

lsp.query: Wir verbringen hier ganze Tage mit der Diskussion über das demokratische Defizit und die verantwortungsvolle Regierung der Union und wenn wir dann eine Angelegenheit behandeln, die direkte Auswirkungen auf über 4 000 Fischer hat, wollen wir nicht sehen, was offenkundig ist, und nicht tun, was jede Regierung tun würde, um einen so bedeutenden Teil ihres produktiven Geflechts zu schützen.
lsp.judge: We spend entire days discussing the democratic deficit and responsible governance of the Union, and then we address an issue that directly affects over 4,000 fishermen, yet we refuse to see what is obvious and fail to do what any government would do to protect such an important part of its productive fabric.
lsp.proxy: We spend whole days here discussing the democratic deficit and the responsible government of the Union, and when we then deal with a matter that has a direct impact on over 4,000 fishermen, we do not want to see what is obvious and do not do what any government would do to protect such a significant part of its productive fabric.
lsp.reference: We spend whole days here discussing the democratic deficit and the Union's responsible government, and when we then deal with a matter that has direct impacts on over 4,000 fishermen, we don't want to see what's obvious and we won't do what any government would do to protect such a significant part of their productive network.

lsp.query: Wir sind nicht für die Vergabe von Subventionen zur Förderung der extrem industrialisierten Fischerei, jener Fischerei, die alles ohne Unterschied fängt auf das Risiko hin, die Arten zu gefährden, die Ernährungssicherheit und die Artenvielfalt zu beeinträchtigen, jener Fischerei, die zu einer übermäßigen Vergrößerung der Flotten führt usw. In diesem Zusammenhang sind wir der Meinung, dass die unkontrollierten Marktkräfte eine der Hauptursachen darstellen, die zu dieser Überinvestition führt, und dass diese Fragen im Rahmen der künftigen WTO-Verhandlungen über die Liberalisierung des Handels berücksichtigt werden müssen.
lsp.judge: We are not in favor of subsidies for the promotion of extremely industrialized fishing, that kind of fishing which catches everything indiscriminately at the risk of endangering species, compromising food security, and reducing biodiversity. In this context, we believe that uncontrolled market forces represent one of the main causes leading to this overinvestment, and that these issues must be taken into account within the framework of future WTO negotiations on the liberalization of trade.
lsp.proxy: We are not in favor of granting subsidies to promote extremely industrialized fishing, that fishing which catches everything indiscriminately at the risk of endangering species, food security, and biodiversity, that fishing which leads to excessive fleet enlargement, etc. In this context, we believe that uncontrolled market forces are one of the main causes leading to this overinvestment, and that these issues must be taken into account in the context of future WTO negotiations on trade liberalization.
lsp.reference: We are not in favor of the allocation of subsidies to promote the extremely industrialized fishing industry, that fishing industry which catches everything without distinction at the risk of endangering species, impairing food security and biodiversity, that fishing industry which leads to an excessive expansion of the fleets, etc. In this context, we believe that uncontrolled market forces are one of the main causes leading to this overinvestment, and that these issues must be taken into account in the framework of future WTO negotiations on trade liberalization.

lsp.query: Jetzt müssen wir daran arbeiten, dass gerade in diesem beispielhaften Sektor die gemeinsame Politik nicht aufgegeben wird, doch um dies zu tun, müssen wir denjenigen eine Antwort geben, die sich darüber beklagen - und das sind die Akteure -, dass es keine ausreichende Mitwirkung gibt, dass keine Zustimmung zu den getroffenen Entscheidungen eingeholt wird, mit anderen Worten, dass keine Teilhabe am Entscheidungsprozess stattfindet.
lsp.judge: Now we must ensure that in this exemplary sector, the common policy is not abandoned, but to do so, we must address those who complain – and they are the actors – that there is not enough participation, that consent to the decisions made is not sought, in other words, that there is no involvement in the decision-making process.

lsp.query: Einerseits ist jeder Einzelne der hier Anwesenden am Fortbestand der Fischereiindustrie interessiert, und zwar nicht zuletzt deshalb, weil wir gern dessen Produkt essen; andererseits gibt es ernst zu nehmende wissenschaftliche Hinweise auf eine Verknappung der Fischbestände, die im Falle einiger Arten deren Verschwinden zur Folge haben kann.
lsp.judge: On one hand, each and every one of us present here is interested in the survival of the fishing industry, not least because we enjoy eating its products; on the other hand, there are serious scientific indications of a decline in fish stocks that could lead to the disappearance of certain species.

lsp.query: Die Gemeinschaftsbeihilfen müssen hauptsächlich für einen echten Kapazitätsabbau sowie für Investitionen in den Umweltschutz und die Qualitätsförderung bestimmt sein, wobei es um folgende Maßnahmen geht: eine Fangtageregelung in sämtlichen EU-Mitgliedstaaten, mit der wir in meinem Land hervorragende Erfahrungen gesammelt haben, was sich auch bei dem vor einigen Monaten in Brüssel stattgefundenen Treffen zur Gemeinsamen Fischereipolitik gezeigt hat.
lsp.judge: Community aid must primarily be aimed at a genuine capacity reduction as well as investments in environmental protection and quality enhancement, including measures such as a fishing effort regulation in all EU member states, where we have gathered outstanding experiences in my country, which was also evident in the recent meeting on Common Fisheries Policy in Brussels.
lsp.proxy: Community assistance must be mainly intended for genuine capacity reduction and for investments in environmental protection and quality promotion, involving the following measures: a system of days at sea in all EU Member States, with which we have had excellent experience in my country, as was also shown at the meeting on the Common Fisheries Policy held in Brussels a few months ago.
lsp.reference: Community aids must primarily be determined for a genuine capacity reduction as well as for investments in environmental protection and quality promotion, with the following measures in mind: a catch limit regulation in all EU member states, with which we have collected excellent experiences in my country, which has also been shown at the recent meeting in Brussels on the Common Fisheries Policy.

lsp.query: Auch unterstreichen die beiden Berichterstatter folgende gravierenden Mängel, die bereits im Kommissionsbericht festgestellt wurden: die Beschränkungen des Fischereiaufwands haben nicht oder nur ungenügend funktioniert, die Verordnung über technische Maßnahmen im Mittelmeer ist nur lückenhaft umgesetzt worden, das MAP 4 ist bei weitem nicht ehrgeizig genug, die Kontrollbestimmungen wurden nicht, wie von uns 1998 vorgeschlagen, verstärkt.
lsp.judge: The two rapporteurs also highlight the following serious deficiencies that were already identified in the Commission report: the limitations on fishing effort have not or only inadequately functioned, the regulation on technical measures in the Mediterranean has only been implemented incompletely, the MAP 4 is far from being ambitious enough, and the control provisions have not been strengthened, as we proposed in 1998.
lsp.proxy: The two rapporteurs also highlight the following serious shortcomings, which were already identified in the Commission report: the restrictions on fishing effort have not worked or have been insufficient, the regulation on technical measures in the Mediterranean has been implemented only patchily, MAP 4 is by no means ambitious enough, and the control provisions have not been strengthened as we proposed in 1998.
lsp.reference: Both rapporteurs also emphasize the following serious shortcomings that were already identified in the commission report: the restrictions on fishing effort have not or only insufficiently worked, the regulation on technical measures in the Mediterranean has been only patchily implemented, MAP 4 is by far not ambitious enough, and the control provisions were not strengthened, as we had proposed in 1998.

lsp.query: Dann einen Fischereisektor schaffen, der nachhaltig wirtschaftet, aber auch wirtschaftlich lebensfähig und international konkurrenzfähig ist - dabei sollten wir aber auch gleichzeitig denen helfen, die sich nach einer anderen Arbeit umsehen müssen -, eine moderne Fischereiaußenpolitik in enger Abstimmung mit den anderen Gemeinschaftspolitiken entwickeln, um eine verantwortungsbewusste und rationelle Bewirtschaftung der Ressourcen zu erreichen, und vor allem die Mittelmeerdimension neu entwickeln.
lsp.judge: Then create a fishing sector that is economically sustainable but also viable and competitive on an international level – at the same time, we should also help those who need to look for other types of work – develop a modern fisheries foreign policy in close coordination with other community policies to achieve responsible and rational resource management, and especially revitalize the Mediterranean dimension.
lsp.proxy: Then create a fishing sector that operates sustainably, but is also economically viable and internationally competitive - at the same time, we should also help those who have to look for another job -, develop a modern fisheries foreign policy in close coordination with the other Community policies to achieve a responsible and rational management of resources, and above all, redevelop the Mediterranean dimension.
lsp.reference: Then create a fishing sector that sustainably operates, but is also economically viable and internationally competitive - in doing so, we should also help those who need to look for another job at the same time -, develop a modern fisheries external policy in close coordination with the other community policies to achieve a responsible and rational management of resources, and above all, develop the Mediterranean dimension anew.

lsp.query: Die zentrale Frage, die sich uns stellt, besteht in einer genauen Untersuchung, ob es einen Zusammenhang zwischen dem Einsatz dieser Munition und den von den Truppen oder von den Personen, die auf dem Balkan in Friedensmissionen tätig waren, gemeldeten Erkrankungen gibt oder ob sich im Gegenteil diese Krankheitserscheinungen nicht von denen unterscheiden, die man bei unseren Soldaten im Allgemeinen feststellt.
lsp.judge: The central question that arises for us concerns a precise investigation into whether there is a connection between the use of this ammunition and the illnesses reported by the troops or by the individuals who were active on the Balkan in peace missions, or whether, on the contrary, these disease manifestations do not differ from those that we generally observe in our soldiers.

lsp.query: Ich kann nicht vergessen, wie ich im Jahre 1994, als ich mein Land als Außenminister vertrat, aufmerksam die Ergebnisse und Schlussfolgerungen dieses Parlaments las, in denen die Außenminister der Staaten der Union zum Handeln aufgerufen wurden und gefordert wurde, dieser Missachtung der Menschenrechte durch die Gewalt in Bosnien-Herzegowina Einhalt zu gebieten.

lsp.query: Ich danke Herrn Solana und auch der Kommission ausdrücklich, dass sie sich bereit erklärt haben, das Europäische Parlament zu unterrichten, so dass wir auf dieser Grundlage zum angemessenen Zeitpunkt unser abschließendes Urteil treffen können, um auf diese Art und Weise Sicherheit für unsere Bürger und unsere Soldaten zu gewährleisten und die Glaubwürdigkeit unserer für die Verwirklichung der Menschenrechte notwendigen militärischen Einsätze auch in der Zukunft sicherzustellen.
lsp.judge: I thank Mr. Solana and also the Commission explicitly for being willing to inform the European Parliament so that we can reach our final judgment at an appropriate time, thereby ensuring safety for our citizens and our soldiers and securing the credibility of our military operations necessary for the realization of human rights also in the future.

lsp.query: Herr Präsident, wir behandeln heute ein äußerst wichtiges Thema, auf das eigentlich sehr viel Zeit verwendet und zu dem sehr eingehende Überlegungen angestellt werden müssten, während wir es allerdings voller Emotionen angehen, die der Politik, zu der wir doch hier als Nichtfachleute gehalten sind, schlecht zu Gesicht stehen.

lsp.query: Herr Präsident, es gibt zwei Gruppen von Personen, gegenüber denen wir eine besondere Verantwortung haben: Das sind zum einen die Jugendlichen, die auf verdienstvolle Art und Weise an den Militäroperationen in Bosnien und im Kosovo beteiligt waren, und natürlich ihre Familienangehörigen, sowie zum anderen die Empfänger dieser Friedensmissionen, d. h. die Bevölkerung der Balkanländer.
lsp.judge: Mr. President, there are two groups of people towards whom we have a special responsibility: on the one hand, the young people who participated in military operations in Bosnia and Kosovo in a worthy manner, and of course their family members, as well as on the other hand, the recipients of these peace missions, that is, the population of the Balkan countries.
lsp.proxy: Mr. President, there are two groups of people towards whom we have a special responsibility: Firstly, the young people who were involved in a commendable manner in the military operations in Bosnia and Kosovo, and of course their family members, and secondly, the recipients of these peace missions, i.e. the population of the Balkan countries.

lsp.query: Herr Wurtz, wenn Sie in diesem Zusammenhang die Grundrechtscharta und die hohen Prinzipien Europas zitieren, dann muss ich Sie darauf hinweisen, dass in dem Moment, als es um europäische Grundrechte ging, als es um ethnische Säuberungen, um Vertreibung und Terror auf dem Balkan ging, ihre politische Gruppierung abseits stand und versagt hat.
lsp.judge: Mr. Wurtz, if you cite the Charter of Fundamental Rights and the high principles of Europe in this context, then I must point out that when it came to European fundamental rights, when it came to ethnic cleansing, expulsion, and terror on the Balkan peninsula, your political group stood aside and failed.

lsp.query: Deshalb haben wir den federführenden Ausschuss auch gebeten, zweierlei zu tun: einmal die Kommission und den Rat aufzufordern, in einem gemeinsamen Bericht ihre Absichten zu erläutern, vor allen Dingen darzulegen, wie sie die Zuständigkeiten untereinander aufteilen und wie sie die Maßnahmen finanzieren wollen, und zweitens eine Erwägung in den Text einzufügen, in der klar und deutlich gesagt wird, dass die Mittel für die Sonderfazilität im Rahmen der Rubrik IV finanziert werden müssen.
lsp.judge: That is why we have asked the leading committee to do two things: first, to request the Commission and the Council to present their intentions in a joint report, especially to outline how they intend to divide responsibilities among themselves and how they plan to finance the measures; second, to insert a consideration into the text stating clearly and unequivocally that the funds for the special facility must be financed within the framework of category IV.
lsp.proxy: That is why we have also asked the lead committee to do two things: first, to call on the Commission and the Council to explain their intentions in a joint report, above all to set out how they will divide up their responsibilities and how they intend to finance the measures, and secondly to insert a recital into the text which clearly and unequivocally states that the funds for the special facility must be financed within the framework of heading IV.
lsp.reference: That is why we have also asked the leading committee to do two things: first, to ask the Commission and the Council to explain their intentions in a joint report, above all to explain how they intend to divide up their responsibilities among themselves and how they plan to finance the measures, and secondly, to insert a consideration into the text in which it is clearly stated that the funds for the special facility must be financed within the framework of Section IV.

lsp.query: Schließlich hätte ich gern gewusst, ob künftig noch Diskussionen mit dem Herrn Kommissar über eventuelle Einsatzszenarien möglich sind, denn jetzt reden wir theoretisch über Instrumente, wir müssen in Zukunft aber auch über die praktische Anwendung sprechen, und dafür dürfte eine Szenariendiskussion, so meine ich, überaus sinnvoll sein.
lsp.judge: Finally, I would like to know if future discussions with Commissioner about potential deployment scenarios are still possible, because while we are currently talking theoretically about instruments, we will have to discuss their practical application in the future as well, and for that, I believe a scenario discussion would be highly worthwhile.
lsp.proxy: Finally, I would have liked to know whether it will still be possible in the future to have discussions with the Commissioner about potential scenarios for use, because now we are talking theoretically about instruments, but in the future we will also have to talk about practical application, and for that, I think, a discussion of scenarios would be extremely useful.
lsp.reference: Finally, I would have liked to know if future discussions with the Commissioner about possible deployment scenarios are still possible, because we are now talking theoretically about instruments, but in the future we also have to talk about the practical application, and I think a scenario discussion would be extremely useful for that.

lsp.query: Daher hätten wir eine umfassendere Finanzierung gewünscht, eine stärkere Koordinierung zur höheren Wirksamkeit der verschiedenen Programme, die angewendet werden können, sowie eine stärkere Mitverantwortung im Hinblick auf die spätere - manchmal leider notwendige - militärische Intervention, die möglicherweise nicht erforderlich wäre, wenn die vorangehenden Phasen realisiert würden.
lsp.judge: Therefore, we would have preferred more comprehensive financing, stronger coordination for higher effectiveness of the various programs that can be applied, as well as greater shared responsibility regarding any subsequent - sometimes unfortunately necessary - military intervention, which might not be required if the preceding phases were realized.
lsp.proxy: We would therefore have liked more comprehensive funding, stronger coordination for greater effectiveness of the various programmes that can be applied, and greater co-responsibility with regard to the later - sometimes unfortunately necessary - military intervention, which might not be necessary if the preceding phases were implemented.

lsp.query: Hier geht es darum, eine Politik zu unterstützen, die Demokratie und Menschenrechte in Nordkorea ermöglicht und auf dieser Grundlage einen wesentlichen Beitrag dazu leistet, dass es eine zunehmende Verständigung zwischen den beiden Teilen Koreas gibt: Die hat nach dem Treffen der Präsidenten dazu geführt, dass man erstmals wieder über die Einheit dieses Landes debattiert.
lsp.judge: This is about supporting a policy that enables democracy and human rights in North Korea and contributes to increasing understanding between the two parts of Korea: This has led to debates about the unification of this country for the first time since the meeting of the presidents.
lsp.proxy: This is about supporting a policy that enables democracy and human rights in North Korea and, on this basis, makes a significant contribution to increasing understanding between the two parts of Korea: This has led, following the meeting of the presidents, to the unity of this country being debated again for the first time.
lsp.reference: It's about supporting a policy that enables democracy and human rights in North Korea and, on this basis, makes a significant contribution to increasing understanding between the two parts of Korea: This has led to the fact that, following the meeting of the presidents, the issue of the unity of this country is being debated for the first time again.

lsp.query: Bei allen Kontakten mit der Demokratischen Volksrepublik Korea hat die Union ihre überaus große Beunruhigung im Hinblick auf die schweren Menschenrechtsverletzungen in diesem Land betont. Das betrifft auch die Anzahl politischer Gefangener, das Fehlen einer nationalen Gesetzgebung sowie die Weigerung der koreanischen Behörden, gemäß den internationalen Mechanismen zum Schutz der Menschenrechte zusammenzuarbeiten.
lsp.judge: In all contacts with the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, the Union has emphasized its extremely great concern regarding the serious human rights violations in this country. This also applies to the number of political prisoners, the lack of national legislation, as well as the refusal of the Korean authorities to cooperate according to international mechanisms for the protection of human rights.
lsp.proxy: In all contacts with the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, the Union has emphasized its extreme concern regarding the serious human rights violations in this country. This also concerns the number of political prisoners, the lack of national legislation, and the refusal of the Korean authorities to cooperate in accordance with the international mechanisms for the protection of human rights.
lsp.reference: At all contacts with the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, the Union has emphasized its extremely great concern regarding the severe human rights violations in this country. This also includes the number of political prisoners, the lack of a national legislation, as well as the refusal of the North Korean authorities to cooperate with international mechanisms for the protection of human rights.

lsp.query: Nordkorea hat Mühe, die wenigen und ohnehin symbolhaften Verpflichtungen, die es auf militärischem Gebiet übernommen hat, einzuhalten; es verzögert die Zusammenführung der seit dem Krieg in den 50er Jahren getrennten Familien und lässt durch nichts seinen Willen erkennen, den Gegenbesuch von Kim Jong Il in Seoul, der für das kommende Frühjahr vorgesehen war und von dem noch nicht bekannt ist, wann und ob er stattfinden wird, auch wirklich in die Tat umzusetzen.
lsp.judge: North Korea struggles to fulfill even the few, and anyway symbolic, military obligations it has taken on; it delays the reunification of families separated since the war in the 1950s and shows no willingness to follow through with Kim Jong Il's planned reciprocal visit to Seoul, which was scheduled for the coming spring and whose timing and whether it will take place are still unknown.
lsp.proxy: North Korea is having trouble adhering to the few and largely symbolic commitments it has made in the military sphere; it is delaying the reunification of families separated since the war in the 1950s and is showing no indication of its willingness to actually implement the planned reciprocal visit of Kim Jong Il to Seoul, which was scheduled for the coming spring and whose timing and feasibility are still unknown.
lsp.reference: North Korea is having trouble keeping up with the few and already symbolic commitments it has taken on in the military field; it is delaying the reunification of families separated since the war in the 1950s and shows no intention of actually carrying out the reciprocal visit of Kim Jong Il to Seoul, which was planned for the upcoming spring and whose date and whether it will take place are still unknown.

lsp.query: Deshalb sage ich: Selbstverständlich fördern wir die Annäherung zwischen den beiden koreanischen Staaten, selbstverständlich unterstützen wir die Nordkoreaner, damit sie nicht hungers sterben - der Kollege Ford hat soeben davon gesprochen -, doch stellen wir hierfür harte Bedingungen, um zu gewährleisten, dass die Hilfe auch bei denjenigen, die sie wirklich benötigen, ankommt und wir nicht ein paranoides und unberechenbares Regime unterstützen, das daran gewöhnt ist, uns mit Nuklearwaffen und Raketen zu erpressen, um sein Überleben zu sichern.
lsp.judge: Therefore, I say: Of course, we promote the rapprochement between the two Korean states, and of course, we support the North Koreans so they do not starve to death - as my colleague Ford just mentioned - but we set hard conditions for this to ensure that aid reaches those who truly need it and we do not support a paranoid and unpredictable regime that is accustomed to using nuclear weapons and missiles to extort us in order to secure its survival.
lsp.proxy: That's why I say: Of course, we promote rapprochement between the two Korean states, of course, we support the North Koreans so they don't starve to death - colleague Ford has just spoken about this -, but we set tough conditions to ensure that the aid actually reaches those who really need it and we don't support a paranoid and unpredictable regime that is used to blackmailing us with nuclear weapons and missiles to secure its survival.
lsp.reference: That's why I say: Of course, we promote the rapprochement between the two Korean states, of course, we support the North Koreans so that they do not starve to death - colleague Ford just spoke about this - but we set tough conditions for this to ensure that the help reaches those who really need it and we do not support a paranoid and unpredictable regime that is accustomed to blackmailing us with nuclear weapons and missiles to secure its survival.

lsp.judge: Exactly because the Union deliberately allows these ambiguities to remain, some countries are having difficulties publishing their lists for "Natura 2000" and implementing the Habitats Directive in a target-oriented manner without resistance from their farmers, despite the high goals of this directive being generally acknowledged.

lsp.query: Also habe ich mir gesagt: "Wenn über den Bericht Van den Bos abgestimmt wird, dann stimme mit Ja - erinnere Dich daran, Fatuzzo -, aber weise auch darauf hin, dass es angebracht wäre, darauf Acht zu geben und zu kontrollieren, dass die aufgrund dieses Abkommens der Bevölkerung von Bangladesch gewährten Beihilfen auch dazu verwendet werden, damit der Staat einigen älteren Menschen eine Rente bewilligt. "
lsp.judge: So I told myself: "If Van den Bos's report is voted on, vote yes - remember, Fatuzzo - but also point out that it would be appropriate to pay attention to and ensure that the aid provided to the people of Bangladesh under this agreement is also used to allow the state to grant pensions to some elderly people."

lsp.judge: The report on the situation of border workers, which our Committee on Employment and Social Affairs has presented to us, undoubtedly stems from the praiseworthy intention of not discriminating against border workers regarding their working and wage conditions and social security, and of addressing any existing issues in this regard.

(FR) Wenn die Richtlinien über die Bewahrung der natürlichen Lebensräume, die Beseitigung von PCB und PCT und den Schutz der Gewässer vor Verunreinigung durch Nitrate in den Mitgliedstaaten nicht ausreichend angewendet werden, so bedeutet dies keineswegs, dass diese Richtlinien schlecht sind und abgeändert werden müssten, wie uns manch einer in diesem Haus glauben machen möchte.
lsp.judge: If the directives on the conservation of natural habitats, the removal of PCBs and PCTs, and the protection of waters from nitrate pollution are not sufficiently applied in the member states, this does not mean that these directives are bad and should be changed, as some people in this house might want us to believe.
lsp.proxy: If the guidelines on the conservation of natural habitats, the elimination of PCB and PCT, and the protection of waters against pollution by nitrates are not sufficiently applied in the Member States, this does not mean that these guidelines are bad and need to be amended, as some people in this House would have us believe.

lsp.query: Die Kommission als Hüterin der Verträge muss sich einerseits unnachgiebig gegenüber den Mitgliedstaaten zeigen, damit diese die Richtlinien einhalten, und andererseits muss sie sich den Bestrebungen zur Änderung dieser Texte widersetzen, bevor sie ihre volle Nützlichkeit unter Beweis stellen konnten, insbesondere in den Bereichen der Verunreinigung der Gewässer durch Nitrate sowie des Schutzes und der Aufwertung besonders wertvoller Naturräume.
lsp.judge: The Commission as guardian of the treaties must be unbending towards the Member States so that they comply with the directives, and at the same time, it must resist efforts to change these texts before they have demonstrated their full effectiveness, especially in the areas of water pollution by nitrates and the protection and enhancement of particularly valuable natural habitats.
lsp.proxy: The Commission, as guardian of the Treaties, must on the one hand be uncompromising towards the Member States to ensure that they comply with the guidelines, and on the other hand must resist attempts to amend these texts before they have been able to demonstrate their full usefulness, particularly in the areas of water pollution by nitrates and the protection and enhancement of particularly valuable natural areas.
lsp.reference: The Commission as guardian of the treaties must show itself to be uncompromising towards the member states on the one hand, so that they adhere to the guidelines, and on the other hand, it must resist the efforts to change these texts before they have proven their full usefulness, especially in the areas of water pollution by nitrates and the protection and enhancement of particularly valuable natural areas.

lsp.query: Wir müssen, auch in der Welthandelsorganisation, die Ursprungsbezeichnungen unserer Qualitätsprodukte, u. a. des Weins, verteidigen und sichern, denn unsere Zukunft in der EU und was den Export in Drittländer betrifft, liegt in Produkten hochwertiger Qualität, für die es bei uns, und auch in der Welt, zahlungskräftige und mündige Verbraucher gibt.
lsp.judge: We must defend and secure the origin designations of our quality products, including wine, in the World Trade Organization, as our future in the EU and for exports to third countries lies in high-quality products for which there are financially sound and discerning consumers both here and around the world.
lsp.proxy: We must also defend and secure the designations of origin of our quality products, including wine, in the World Trade Organization, because our future in the EU and with regard to exports to third countries lies in high-quality products for which there are solvent and discerning consumers both here and around the world.
lsp.reference: We must, also within the World Trade Organization, defend and secure the origin designations of our high-quality products, including wine, as our future in the EU and with regard to exports to third countries depends on products of superior quality, for which there are price-paying and informed consumers both at home and around the world.

lsp.query: Die Kommission führt folgende Prioritäten auf: verbesserte Kohärenz zwischen den verschiedenen Zielen, die die GFP verfolgt, insbesondere zwischen Erhaltung der Ressourcen, Wirtschaftlichkeit und Arbeitsplatzsicherung in den von der Fischerei abhängigen Gebieten; stärkere Berücksichtigung der wirtschaftlichen Dimension des Fischereisektors; verbesserte Integration der Umwelt- und Fischereipolitik; Verbesserung der Bewirtschaftungsinstrumente, wie insbesondere die Einbeziehung der mehrjährigen Bewirtschaftungsziele; ein übersichtlicherer Entscheidungsfindungsprozess und die Erhaltung der externen Dimension der GFP.
lsp.judge: The Commission lists the following priorities: improved coherence between the various goals pursued by the GFP, especially between resource conservation, economic viability, and job security in fishing-dependent areas; stronger consideration of the economic dimension of the fisheries sector; improved integration of environmental and fisheries policies; better management tools, particularly the inclusion of multi-year management objectives; a more transparent decision-making process; and the maintenance of the external dimension of the GFP.
lsp.proxy: The Commission sets the following priorities: improved coherence between the various objectives pursued by the CFP, in particular between the conservation of resources, economic viability and job security in areas dependent on fishing; greater consideration of the economic dimension of the fisheries sector; improved integration of environmental and fisheries policies; improvement of management instruments, in particular the inclusion of multi-annual management objectives; a more transparent decision-making process and the preservation of the external dimension of the CFP.
lsp.reference: The Commission sets the following priorities: improved coherence between the various objectives pursued by the GFP, in particular between the conservation of resources, economic viability and job security in the areas dependent on fishing; stronger consideration of the economic dimension of the fishing sector; improved integration of environmental and fisheries policy; improvement of management instruments, including in particular the inclusion of multi-annual management objectives; a more transparent decision-making process and the preservation of the external dimension of the GFP.

lsp.query: Das Europäische Parlament hat sich natürlich konsequent gegenüber sich selbst verhalten, denn - wie der Kriegsverbrecher und ehemalige NATO-Generalsekretär sowie jetzige Hohe Vertreter der EU, Javier Solana, in zynischen Worten in seiner Ansprache hervorhob - das Europäische Parlament hat selbst beharrlich die militärische Intervention auf dem Balkan, sowohl in Bosnien als auch im Kosovo, gefordert.
lsp.judge: The European Parliament has, of course, consistently held itself to this standard, as the war criminal and former NATO Secretary-General, currently the High Representative of the EU, Javier Solana, emphasized in his cynical words during his speech: the European Parliament itself persistently called for military intervention on the Balkans, both in Bosnia and Kosovo.
lsp.proxy: The European Parliament has naturally acted consistently towards itself, because - as the war criminal and former NATO Secretary General, now the EU's High Representative, Javier Solana, cynically pointed out in his speech - the European Parliament itself has persistently demanded military intervention in the Balkans, both in Bosnia and in Kosovo.
lsp.reference: The European Parliament has naturally acted consistently against itself, for - as the war criminal and former NATO Secretary-General as well as current EU High Representative, Javier Solana, pointed out in cynical words in his address - the European Parliament itself has persistently demanded military intervention in the Balkans, both in Bosnia and in Kosovo.

(FR) Dass den Armeen der größten Mächte seit zehn Jahren die Schädlichkeit von Munition mit abgereichertem Uran, auch für diejenigen, die sie einsetzen, bekannt ist, beweist nur, dass die Generalstäbe ihren eigenen Soldaten die gleiche Missachtung entgegenbringen wie der Zivilbevölkerung und den gegnerischen Streitkräften.
lsp.judge: The fact that the armies of the great powers have known for ten years about the harmfulness of ammunition containing depleted uranium, not just for those who use it, proves that the general staffs treat their own soldiers with the same disregard as they do the civilian population and the opposing forces.

lsp.query: Seit Beginn des Atomzeitalters mit dem Zweiten Weltkrieg sind die Gefahren und Vorsorgemaßnahmen wohl bekannt, die man beim Umgang mit Uran und anderen radioaktiven Stoffen beachten muss, weil es sich um ein hochtoxisches (chemisch und radiologisch toxisches) Element handelt, wenn man es einatmet oder aufnimmt, das auch genetisch gefährlich ist.
lsp.judge: Since the beginning of the atomic age, starting with World War II, the dangers and precautionary measures that must be observed when handling uranium and other radioactive substances are well known, as it is a highly toxic (chemically and radiologically toxic) element that can be hazardous to genetic material if inhaled or ingested.

lsp.query: Herr Präsident, nach all den tragischen Geschehnissen im Zusammenhang mit der Bombardierung Jugoslawiens und nach den Enthüllungen über die Verwendung von Munition mit abgereichertem Uran ist es nunmehr dringend erforderlich, diese Art von Waffen zu verbieten, die selbst nach ihrem Einsatz noch über eine lange Zeit hinweg gefährliche Auswirkungen haben und blind, d. h. ohne erkennbaren Unterschied, all diejenigen treffen können, die Gefahr laufen, mit ihnen in Berührung zu kommen.
lsp.judge: Mr. President, following all the tragic events in connection with the bombing of Yugoslavia and the revelations about the use of munitions with depleted uranium, it is now urgently necessary to ban this type of weapon, which continues to have dangerous effects for a long time after its use and can affect indiscriminately, that is, without any discernible distinction, all those who are at risk of coming into contact with them.
lsp.proxy: Mr President, following all the tragic events connected with the bombing of Yugoslavia and the revelations about the use of ammunition with depleted uranium, it is now urgently necessary to ban this type of weapon, which even after use still has dangerous effects over a long period and strikes blindly, i.e. without distinction, all those who risk coming into contact with them.
lsp.reference: Mr. President, in light of the tragic events surrounding the bombing of Yugoslavia and the revelations about the use of depleted uranium ammunition, it is now urgently necessary to ban this type of weapon, which, even after its use, has hazardous effects for a long time and can, blind, i.e., without discernible distinction, affect all those who run the risk of coming into contact with them.

lsp.query: Abschließend möchte ich meine Ratlosigkeit angesichts der politischen Kehrtwende zum Ausdruck bringen, die bei unserer Aussprache zutage getreten ist. Während uns seinerzeit einige vorhielten, unsere Kritik an Milosevics Politik diene der NATO und ihren Bombardements, wirft uns Herr Solana heute vor, wir würden bei unseren Vorbehalten gegenüber dem abgereicherten Uran die Menschenrechte der Opfer von Milosevic vergessen.
lsp.judge: In conclusion, I want to express my helplessness regarding the political about-face that has become apparent during our discussion. While some had previously argued that our criticism of Milosevic's politics served the NATO and their bombings, Mr. Solana now accuses us of forgetting the human rights of the victims of Milosevic when we harbor reservations about depleted uranium.
lsp.proxy: In conclusion, I would like to express my bewilderment at the political about-face that has emerged during our discussion. While some people previously accused us that our criticism of Milosevic's policy served the interests of NATO and its bombing campaigns, Mr. Solana now accuses us of forgetting the human rights of the victims of Milosevic due to our reservations regarding depleted uranium.
lsp.reference: In conclusion, I would like to express my bewilderment in the face of the political U-turn that has become apparent in our discussion. While some of us were accused at the time of using our criticism of Milosevic's policy to serve the interests of NATO and their bombings, Mr. Solana now accuses us of forgetting the human rights of the victims of Milosevic in our reservations about the enriched uranium.

lsp.query: Ich habe im letzten Jahr außerdem mit Sorge beobachtet, dass die derzeitige russische Führung - zu der viele ehemalige KGB-Mitarbeiter gehören, die von Präsident Putin, der ja früher selbst KGB-Oberst war, berufen wurden - großen Eifer bei der Verhaftung so genannter britischer, amerikanischer und russischer Spione an den Tag gelegt hat.
lsp.judge: In the past year, I have also observed with concern that the current Russian leadership - many of whom are former KGB employees appointed by President Putin, who himself used to be a KGB Colonel - has shown great zeal in arresting so-called British, American, and Russian spies.
lsp.proxy: I also observed with concern last year that the current Russian leadership - which includes many former KGB employees appointed by President Putin, who was himself a former KGB colonel - has shown great zeal in arresting so-called British, American, and Russian spies.
lsp.reference: I have also been observing with concern in the past year that the current Russian leadership - which includes many former KGB employees who were appointed by President Putin, who was himself a KGB colonel in the past - has shown great zeal in the arrest of so-called British, American, and Russian spies.

lsp.query: Ich sage das eingedenk des Völkermords in Ruanda im Jahre 1994, wo die Völkergemeinschaft mit ansehen musste, wie Hunderttausende Menschen ermordet wurden. Im Hinblick auf Zentralafrika möchte ich darauf drängen, dass die Europäische Union energischer handelt und auch die Vereinten Nationen größere Wachsamkeit zeigen.
lsp.judge: I say this in remembrance of the genocide in Rwanda in 1994, where the international community had to watch as hundreds of thousands of people were murdered. Regarding Central Africa, I urge that the European Union take more decisive action and that the United Nations also show greater vigilance.
lsp.proxy: I say this in light of the genocide in Rwanda in 1994, where the international community had to watch as hundreds of thousands of people were murdered. With regard to Central Africa, I would like to urge the European Union to take more energetic action and the United Nations to show greater vigilance.
lsp.reference: I say this mindful of the genocide in Rwanda in 1994, where the international community had to witness the murder of hundreds of thousands of people. In light of Central Africa, I would like to urge that the European Union takes more decisive action and that the United Nations displays greater vigilance.

lsp.query: Zum Beispiel zeichnet Schweden seit vielen Jahren auf der Vollversammlung der UN für eine Resolution zur Lage in Birma/Myanmar verantwortlich und die Union ist im Hinblick auf die Tatsache, dass es in Birma immer noch Zwangsarbeit gibt, als Ganzes aktiv an Gesprächen im Rahmen der Internationalen Arbeitsorganisation, ILO, engagiert.
lsp.judge: For example, Sweden has been advocating for a resolution on the situation in Burma/Myanmar at the UN General Assembly for many years, and the union is actively engaged in discussions within the framework of the International Labour Organization (ILO), taking into account the fact that forced labor still exists in Burma.
lsp.proxy: For example, Sweden has for many years been responsible for a resolution on the situation in Burma/Myanmar at the UN General Assembly, and the Union as a whole is actively engaged in discussions within the International Labour Organization, ILO, in view of the fact that forced labour still exists in Burma.

lsp.query: (Beifall) Zweitens: Wir fordern Sie auf, schon ziemlich schnell - die Vorbereitungen müssen unter Ihrer Präsidentschaft beginnen und sollten dann in Laken unter belgischer Präsidentschaft zu einem Beschluss führen - eine Konferenz einzusetzen, die sich an der Methodik und an dem Modell des Konventes orientiert, unter starker Beteiligung des Europäischen Parlaments und natürlich der nationalen Regierungen, vor allen Dingen aber auch der Kommission.
lsp.judge: (Applause) Second: We urge you to start making preparations quite swiftly – these must begin under your presidency and should then lead to a decision in Laeken under the Belgian presidency – by convening a conference that is oriented towards the method and model of the Convention, with strong involvement of the European Parliament and, of course, the national governments, but especially also of the Commission.
lsp.proxy: (Applause) Secondly: We urge you to set up a conference, fairly quickly - the preparations must begin under your presidency and should then lead to a decision in Laeken under Belgian presidency - which is based on the methodology and the model of the Convention, with strong participation of the European Parliament and, of course, the national governments, but above all also the Commission.

lsp.query: Schweden übernimmt zum ersten Mal den Ratsvorsitz und hat seine Prioritäten gesetzt, die berühmten 3 "E ", die mit dem Manifest der europäischen Sozialisten und Sozialdemokraten übereinstimmen, weil ich stolz sagen kann, dass Herr Persson und seine Partei zu meiner politischen Familie gehören, und der Ministerpräsident Schwedens hier darüber hinaus eine Verteidigung des europäischen Sozialmodells und seiner Anpassungsfähigkeit in Zeiten der Globalisierung vorgenommen hat, die uns mit Stolz erfüllt.
lsp.judge: Sweden is taking on the presidency for the first time and has set its priorities, which align with the famous 3 "E's" from the Manifesto of European Socialists and Social Democrats, because I can proudly say that Mr. Persson and his party belong to my political family, and the Swedish Prime Minister has also defended the European social model and its adaptability in times of globalization, which fills us with pride.
lsp.proxy: Sweden is taking over the presidency of the Council for the first time and has set its priorities, the famous three "E"s, which are in line with the manifesto of European socialists and social democrats, because I can proudly say that Mr Persson and his party belong to my political family, and the Prime Minister of Sweden has also made a defence of the European social model and its adaptability in times of globalisation, which fills us with pride.

lsp.query: Ebenso wie einige andere Redner des heutigen Tages bin auch ich beunruhigt über die Tendenz, das zwischenstaatliche Modell oft und nachdrücklich auf Kosten des so genannten Community Approach hervorzuheben, der der Kommission eine stärkere Rolle und Bedeutung zuweist.
lsp.judge: Similarly to some other speakers today, I am also concerned about the tendency to often and emphatically highlight the intergovernmental model at the expense of what is known as the Community Approach, which assigns the Commission a stronger role and significance.
lsp.proxy: Like some other speakers today, I am also concerned about the tendency to often and emphatically emphasize the inter-state model at the expense of the so-called Community Approach, which assigns a stronger role and significance to the Commission.
lsp.reference: Just like some other speakers of today, I am also concerned about the trend of often and emphatically highlighting the inter-state model at the expense of what is called the Community Approach, which assigns a stronger role and significance to the Commission.

lsp.query: Wenn es Ihnen gelingt, Ihre Landsleute davon zu überzeugen, dass der Euro ein gutes Projekt ist, dass er nach innen stabil ist, dass seine Stabilität nach außen auch immer besser wird, wenn Sie sie davon überzeugen können, dieses große Werk der europäischen Integration mitzutragen, tragen Sie damit auch dazu bei, dass dieser Bereich der Europäischen Union auch von den Bürgern besser verstanden werden kann.
lsp.judge: If you manage to convince your fellow citizens that the Euro is a good project, that it is stable internally, and that its stability is getting better externally over time, and if you can persuade them to contribute to this great work of European integration, then you will also help to ensure that this area of the European Union is better understood by its citizens.
lsp.proxy: If you succeed in convincing your fellow citizens that the euro is a good project, that it is stable internally, that its external stability is also constantly improving, if you can convince them to support this major work of European integration, you will also contribute to this area of the European Union being better understood by its citizens.
lsp.reference: If you succeed in convincing your fellow countrymen that the Euro is a good project, that it is stable internally, that its stability will also improve externally, and if you can convince them to contribute to this great work of European integration, you will also contribute to the fact that this area of the European Union can be better understood by its citizens.

lsp.query: Gleichzeitig verkündet der Europarat, dass die Folter weiterhin in den Polizeirevieren der Türkei an der Tagesordnung ist, und Amnesty International verurteilt die Folter, die Nichtbestrafung der Verantwortlichen und generell die Verstöße gegen die Menschenrechte seitens der Türkei und fordert die Europäische Union auf, zu verlangen, dass die Folter unverzüglich eingestellt wird, und nicht erst 2002­2003, wie in dem Verfahren für den Beitritt der Türkei zur Europäischen Union vorgesehen.
lsp.judge: Simultaneously, the Council of Europe announces that torture continues to be practiced in Turkish police stations, and Amnesty International condemns the torture, the impunity of those responsible, and generally the human rights violations by Turkey, calling on the European Union to demand an immediate end to torture, rather than in 2002-2003 as planned in the accession process for Turkey's membership in the European Union.
lsp.proxy: At the same time, the Council of Europe announces that torture is still a daily occurrence in Turkish police stations, and Amnesty International condemns the torture, the impunity of those responsible, and the general human rights violations by Turkey, and calls on the European Union to demand that torture be stopped immediately, and not just in 2002-2003, as provided for in the procedure for Turkey's accession to the European Union.
lsp.reference:
# English
At the same time, the Council of Europe announces that torture is still on the agenda in Turkish police stations, and Amnesty International condemns the torture, the non-prosecution of those responsible, and generally the human rights violations by Turkey, and demands that the European Union call for torture to be immediately stopped, and not just in 2002-2003, as provided for in the accession procedure for Turkey's entry into the European Union.

lsp.query: Herr Präsident, Herr Simpson, Frau Kommissarin! Nachdem ich soeben die Nachrichten gesehen hatte, hoffte ich - und eigentlich sah es auch fast danach aus -, wir würden eine Aussprache über fox hunting führen, worüber es heute Abend zweifellos eine äußerst lebhafte Debatte im britischen Parlament geben wird.
lsp.judge: Mr. President, Mr. Simpson, Mrs. Commissioner! After just watching the news, I hoped – and it actually seemed that way – that we would have a discussion about fox hunting, which will undoubtedly lead to a very lively debate in the British Parliament this evening.
lsp.proxy: Mr President, Mr Simpson, Commissioner! Having just watched the news, I had hoped - and it almost seemed that way - that we would be having a discussion on fox hunting, on which there will undoubtedly be a most lively debate in the British Parliament this evening.
lsp.reference: Mr. President, Mr. Simpson, Commissioner! After I had just seen the news, I had hoped - and it actually seemed almost like it - that we would have a discussion about fox hunting, which will undoubtedly lead to a very lively debate in the British Parliament tonight.

lsp.query: Herr Präsident, Herr Simpson hat wirklich einen ausgezeichneten Bericht vorgelegt. Ich kann das behaupten, weil ich wohl zu den wenigen gehöre, die nicht nur politisch, sondern auch fachlich mit diesem Sektor vertraut sind, denn bevor ich mich meiner Tätigkeit als Abgeordneter dieses Parlaments zuwandte, hatte ich etwa 10 000 Flugstunden als Mitglied einer Cockpitbesatzung absolviert.
lsp.judge: Mr. President, Mr. Simpson has indeed presented an excellent report. I can say this because I am one of the few who are not only politically but also professionally familiar with this sector, as before I devoted myself to my work as a Member of this Parliament, I had accumulated approximately 10,000 flight hours as a member of a cockpit crew.

lsp.query: Ich weise Sie darauf hin, dass die Sicherheit das A und O des Luftverkehrs ist, wobei zu beachten ist, dass diese Sicherheit auf zwei Faktoren beruht: zum einen auf dem technischen Faktor, das heißt den Ausrüstungen, Flugzeugen, Flughäfen, Funknavigations- und Flugleiteinrichtungen usw., und zum anderen auf dem äußerst bedeutsamen menschlichen Faktor, der zwar keinen entscheidenden, aber doch einen sehr hohen Anteil an den Flugzeugunglücken hat.
lsp.judge: I draw your attention to the fact that safety is the paramount concern in air traffic, with two factors being crucial for this safety: on one hand, the technical factor, which includes equipment, aircraft, airports, radio navigation and control facilities, etc., and on the other hand, the extremely important human factor, which, although not decisive, still plays a very high role in aircraft accidents.
lsp.proxy: I would like to point out that safety is the top priority in air traffic, with the understanding that this safety is based on two factors: on the one hand, the technical factor, i.e. the equipment, aircraft, airports, radio navigation and air traffic control facilities, etc., and on the other hand, the extremely significant human factor, which, although not decisive, has a very high share in aircraft accidents.
lsp.reference: I would like to draw your attention to the fact that safety is the A and O of air traffic, where it is worth noting that this safety is based on two factors: on the one hand, the technical factor, that is to say the equipment, aircraft, airports, navigation and air traffic control facilities, etc., and on the other hand, the extremely important human factor, which, although it does not have a decisive share, yet has a very high share in aircraft accidents.

lsp.query: Entweder einigen sich die Parteien bis zum Mai, oder wir erwarten, dass die Kommission einen Vorschlag macht, den wir in die zweite Lesung einbauen können, denn es geht nicht an, dass die entscheidende Frage für die Sicherheit der Passagiere, nämlich, ob die Kapitäne, die Besatzungen, so ausgeruht sind, dass sie ihre Aufgaben wahrnehmen können, nicht geregelt wird.
lsp.judge: Either the parties reach an agreement by May, or we expect the Commission to make a proposal that we can incorporate into the second reading, as it is unacceptable that the crucial question for passenger safety, namely whether the captains and crew are sufficiently rested to perform their duties, remains unresolved.
lsp.proxy: Either the parties agree by May, or we expect the Commission to make a proposal that we can incorporate into the second reading, because it is unacceptable that the crucial question for passenger safety, namely whether captains and crews are rested enough to perform their duties, is not regulated.
lsp.reference: Either the parties will agree by May, or we expect the commission to make a proposal that we can incorporate into the second reading, because it's not acceptable that the crucial question for passenger safety, namely whether the captains and crews are so well-rested that they can perform their duties, is not regulated.

lsp.query: Davon ausgehend verfolgt die von uns vorgeschlagene Änderung zur bestehenden Verordnung ein zweifaches Ziel: Zum einen zielt sie auf die weitere Harmonisierung des Regulierungssystems im Bereich der Sicherheit der Zivilluftfahrt durch seine Ausdehnung auf die Harmonisierung der Betriebsanforderungen für Luftfahrzeuge; zum anderen geht es um die Festlegung von Verfahren, die es der Gemeinschaft ermöglichen, die Varianten und die Ausnahmen zu bearbeiten, die die Mitgliedstaaten hin und wieder aus operativen Erfordernissen anwenden müssen.
lsp.judge: Based on this, our proposed amendment to the existing regulation aims at achieving a dual objective: on the one hand, it seeks to further harmonize the regulatory system in the field of civil aviation safety by extending it to include the harmonization of operational requirements for aircraft; on the other hand, it focuses on establishing procedures that will enable the community to address the variations and exceptions that member states must occasionally apply due to operational necessities.
lsp.proxy: Based on this, the amendment we propose to the existing regulation has a twofold objective: on the one hand, it aims to further harmonise the regulatory system in the field of civil aviation safety by extending it to the harmonisation of operational requirements for aircraft; on the other hand, it is about establishing procedures that will enable the Community to process the variants and exemptions that Member States must apply from time to time for operational reasons.
lsp.reference:
# English
Starting from this, the proposed amendment to the existing regulation pursues a twofold objective: On the one hand, it aims at further harmonization of the regulatory system in the field of civil aviation safety through its extension to the harmonization of operational requirements for aircraft; on the other hand, it is about establishing procedures that enable the community to handle the variants and exceptions that Member States occasionally have to apply from operational requirements.

lsp.query: Hinsichtlich des konkreten Problems der Thrombose - die jemand von Ihnen angesprochen hat - hat die Kommission die Luftverkehrsgesellschaften schriftlich aufgefordert, die Fluggäste über die Gefahren, Prädispositionsfaktoren und die Maßnahmen zur Minimierung dieser Risiken, konkret im Zusammenhang mit der Thrombose und den gesundheitlichen Problemen im Allgemeinen zu informieren.
lsp.judge: Regarding the specific issue of thrombosis - which someone mentioned - the Commission has written to airlines to inform passengers about the dangers, predisposing factors, and measures to minimize these risks, specifically in the context of thrombosis and general health issues.
lsp.proxy: With regard to the specific problem of thrombosis - which one of you mentioned - the Commission has written to the airlines asking them to inform passengers about the dangers, predisposing factors and the measures to minimize these risks, specifically in connection with thrombosis and general health problems.
lsp.reference: Regarding the specific issue of thrombosis, which was brought up by someone of you, the Commission has formally requested the airlines to inform passengers in writing about the dangers, predisposing factors, and measures to minimize these risks, specifically in relation to thrombosis and general health problems.

lsp.query: Schaffen wir Vorschriften, suchen wir nach einem größeren Harmonisierungsgrad, fördern wir Maßnahmen, um den Fußgänger- und Fahrradverkehr vernünftig und sicher zu gestalten, und suchen wir nach Formeln zur Reduzierung des Schwerlastverkehrs, zumindest in den Ortschaften; harmonisieren wir die Geschwindigkeitsbeschränkungen durch einen ambitiösen Rechtsrahmen, wie von der Kommission 1986 vorgeschlagen wurde, indem wir die Mitgliedstaaten aus ihrer Trägheit wecken.
lsp.judge: Let us create regulations, seek a greater degree of harmonization, promote measures to design pedestrian and bicycle traffic reasonably and safely, and look for formulas to reduce heavy goods vehicle traffic, at least in urban areas; harmonize speed limits through an ambitious legal framework, as proposed by the Commission in 1986, by waking up the Member States from their inertia.
lsp.proxy: Let us establish regulations, seek a greater degree of harmonisation, promote measures to make pedestrian and cycle traffic reasonable and safe, and seek formulas to reduce heavy goods traffic, at least in towns; let us harmonise speed limits through an ambitious legal framework, as proposed by the Commission in 1986, by rousing the Member States from their inertia.
lsp.reference: Let's create regulations, seek a higher degree of harmonization, promote measures to reasonably and safely arrange pedestrian and bicycle traffic, and seek formulas to reduce heavy traffic, at least in local communities; harmonize speed limits through an ambitious legislative framework, as proposed by the Commission in 1986, by waking the member states from their lethargy.

lsp.query: Ich möchte betonen, dass ich allgemein voll und ganz mit dem Inhalt des Berichts und seiner Krönung, der Entschließung, einverstanden bin, sowohl im Hinblick auf das laufende Aktionsprogramm, das in Kürze seinen Abschluss findet, als auch in Bezug auf das künftige Programm über die Straßenverkehrssicherheit, dessen Vorlage die Kommission für die nächsten Monate vorgesehen hat.
lsp.judge: I would like to emphasize that I am in full agreement with the content of the report and its conclusion, the resolution, both with regard to the ongoing action program, which will soon come to a close, and concerning the future program on road safety, for which the Commission has prepared a draft for the coming months.
lsp.proxy: I would like to stress that I am in full agreement with the content of the report and its crowning glory, the resolution, both with regard to the current action programme, which is shortly to come to an end, and with regard to the future programme on road safety, the presentation of which the Commission has scheduled for the coming months.

lsp.query: In einer ersten Etappe müssen die letzten vorrangigen Maßnahmen, die im Rahmen des derzeit laufenden Programms über die Straßenverkehrssicherheit festgelegt wurden, verwirklicht werden. Insbesondere ist vorzuschlagen, dass die Pflicht zum Einbau von Geschwindigkeitsbegrenzern auf eine größere Zahl von Lastkraftwagen angewendet wird, indem Fahrzeuge mit geringerer Nutzlast einbezogen werden.
lsp.judge: In the first stage, the final priority measures that have been established for road traffic safety within the current program must be implemented. lsp.query: Zum zweiten gibt es Gepflogenheiten, Gewohnheiten, Gründe, die mich zu der Überlegung führen, dass dies das klassische Thema ist, das im Bereich der Subsidiarität verbleiben sollte, und deshalb machen wir nur eine Empfehlung über 0,5. Ich nehme an, dass Sie einen anderen Standpunkt vertreten - ich habe das schon bemerkt -, und es ist überdies natürlich eine Tatsache, dass es bis jetzt keine ausreichende Mehrheit im Rat gegeben hat, um eine derartige Initiative auf den Weg zu bringen.

lsp.query: Analysiert man die Reibungskosten im intermodalen Güterverkehr im Einzelnen, so ist festzustellen, dass die Hauptproblempunkte gegenüber dem traditionellen unimodalen Verkehr in höheren Preisen, längeren Fahrzeiten, zunehmenden von den Gütern zurückgelegten durchschnittlichen Entfernungen, Qualitätsminderung, größeren Beschädigungsrisiken, Beschränkungen bezüglich der Art der beförderten Güter sowie komplexeren Verwaltungsverfahren liegen.
lsp.judge: When analyzing the friction costs in intermodal freight transport in detail, it becomes apparent that the main issues compared to traditional unimodal transport lie in higher prices, longer transit times, increased average distances traveled by the goods, quality degradation, greater risk of damage, limitations regarding the type of goods transported, and more complex administrative procedures.
lsp.proxy: Analyzing the friction costs in intermodal freight transport in detail reveals that the main problem areas compared to traditional unimodal transport lie in higher prices, longer travel times, increasing average distances covered by the goods, reduced quality, greater risk of damage, restrictions on the type of goods transported, and more complex administrative procedures.
lsp.reference: Analyzing the friction costs in intermodal freight transport in detail, it can be determined that the main problem areas compared to traditional unimodal transport lie in higher prices, longer travel times, increasing average distances covered by the goods, quality degradation, greater damage risks, restrictions on the type of goods being transported, and more complex administrative procedures.

lsp.query: Schließlich kennzeichnet eine Reihe von Hindernissen, verursacht durch mangelnde Harmonisierung der Fristen und Zeitpläne zwischen den einzelnen Verkehrsträgern, das gesamte System, wodurch es zu Unvereinbarkeiten zwischen den mit der Gütertransportkette verknüpften Erfordernissen und den operativen Erfordernissen der im Prozess eingesetzten Ressourcen kommt: So sind beispielsweise die Arbeitszeiten der Fahrer und Besatzungen nicht auf die intermodalen Operationen abgestimmt und die Terminals können sich nicht immer den auf einem 24-Stunden-Dienst beruhenden Zug- und Schiffsplänen anpassen.
lsp.judge: Finally, a series of obstacles characterize the entire system, caused by the lack of harmonization of deadlines and schedules between individual transport modes, leading to inconsistencies between the requirements linked to the goods transportation chain and the operational requirements of the resources employed in the process: For example, the working hours of drivers and crews are not aligned with intermodal operations, and terminals cannot always adapt to the train and ship schedules based on a 24-hour service.
lsp.proxy: Ultimately, a series of obstacles caused by the lack of harmonization of deadlines and schedules between the individual modes of transport characterize the entire system, resulting in incompatibilities between the requirements associated with the goods transport chain and the operational requirements of the resources used in the process: For example, the working hours of drivers and crews are not coordinated with intermodal operations, and terminals cannot always adapt to train and ship schedules based on a 24-hour service.

In the end, a series of obstacles, caused by a lack of harmonization of deadlines and schedules between individual modes of transport, characterizes the entire system, resulting in incompatibilities between the requirements linked to the goods transport chain and the operational requirements of the resources used in the process: For example, the working hours of drivers and crews are not adjusted to intermodal operations and terminals cannot always adapt to train and ship schedules based on a 24-hour service.

lsp.query: In ihrem Bericht "Intermodalität und intermodaler Güterverkehr in der Europäischen Union " hatte die Kommission die im intermodalen Verkehr zu erreichenden Ziele aufgezeigt und sie entsprechend der spezifischen Probleme in drei vorrangige Interventionsbereiche, so genannte Schlüsselaktionen unterteilt. Die erste Schlüsselaktion betrifft die Integration von Infrastruktur und Transportmitteln, die zweite die Interoperabilität und den Verbundbetrieb und die dritte die verkehrsträgerunabhängigen Dienste und Vorschriften.
lsp.judge: In her report "Intermodality and Intermodal Goods Traffic in the European Union," the Commission outlined the goals to be achieved in intermodal transport and divided them into three priority intervention areas, known as key actions, according to the specific problems at hand. The first key action concerns the integration of infrastructure and transport modes, the second addresses interoperability and coupled operation, and the third focuses on mode-independent services and regulations.
lsp.proxy: In its report "Intermodality and Intermodal Freight Transport in the European Union", the Commission had outlined the objectives to be achieved in intermodal transport and divided them into three priority areas of intervention, so-called key actions, according to the specific problems. The first key action concerns the integration of infrastructure and modes of transport, the second interoperability and coordinated operation, and the third transport mode-independent services and regulations.
lsp.reference: In their report "Intermodality and Intermodal Freight Transport in the European Union", the Commission had shown the goals to be achieved in intermodal transport and divided them into three priority intervention areas, so-called key actions, corresponding to the specific problems. The first key action concerns the integration of infrastructure and transport modes, the second the interoperability and the combined operation, and the third the transport mode-independent services and regulations.

lsp.query: Ziel ist die Einrichtung eines Informationssystems, das ein Echtzeit-Verkehrsmanagement und den Einsatz elektronischer Transaktionen im Güterverkehr ermöglichen soll, und zwar durch folgende Maßnahmen: Entwicklung intermodaler elektronischer Echtzeit-Transaktions- und Informationssysteme; Harmonisierung der Kommunikationsstandards, der Verfahren und der Transportdokumente auf EDI-Grundlage; Vereinheitlichung der Haftungsregelung mit dem Ziel, dem Kunden ein klares Regelwerk transparenter Haftungsbedingungen und -verfahren für beschädigte oder unterwegs abhanden gekommene Frachten bieten zu können; Entwicklung der Technologien der Informationsgesellschaft zum Nutzen des intermodalen Verkehrs durch die Schaffung einer offenen Systemarchitektur, die eine intermodale Ortung und Laufverfolgung (tracking and tracing) ermöglicht; Ermöglichung des papierlosen Verkehrs durch Harmonisierung der vorgeschriebenen Dokumente und Entwicklung einer einzigen elektronischen Anlaufstelle.
lsp.judge: The goal is to establish an information system that should enable real-time traffic management and the use of electronic transactions in freight transport through the following measures: development of intermodal real-time transaction and information systems; harmonization of communication standards, procedures, and transport documents based on EDI; unification of liability regulations with the aim of providing customers with a clear regulatory framework of transparent liability conditions and procedures for damaged or lost shipments; development of information society technologies for the benefit of intermodal transport by creating an open system architecture that allows for intermodal location and tracking; enabling paperless transport through harmonization of prescribed documents and development of a single electronic point
lsp.proxy: The goal is to establish an information system that will enable real-time traffic management and the use of electronic transactions in freight transport, through the following measures: development of intermodal electronic real-time transaction and information systems; harmonization of communication standards, procedures, and transport documents based on EDI; standardization of liability regulations with the aim of offering customers a clear set of transparent liability conditions and procedures for damaged or lost freight; development of information society technologies for the benefit of intermodal transport by creating an open system architecture that enables intermodal tracking and tracing; and enabling paperless transport through harmonization of required documents and development of a single electronic point

lsp.query: Die Kommissionsmitteilung und der Bericht haben viele, ja alle wichtigen Problempunkte zur Sprache gebracht. Die Revisionen der transeuropäischen Netze hin zu einem wirklich intermodalen Netz, Maßnahmen zur Schaffung eines Logistikmehrwertes, Harmonisierungen, die noch nötig sind bei Ladeeinheiten und anderem mehr, wirklich intermodale Informationen, standardisierte Meldungen und Dokumente, Förderung von intermodalen Haftungsregeln und vieles andere mehr.
lsp.judge: The communication and report have addressed many, indeed all, important issues. Revisions of the trans-European networks towards a truly multimodal network, measures to create added value in logistics, harmonizations still needed for loading units and more, truly multimodal information, standardized reports and documents, promotion of multimodal liability rules, and much more.

lsp.query: Zur Frage der Intermodalität bei der Überquerung der Alpen ist festzustellen, dass, abgesehen von der Entscheidung der Schweiz zugunsten erheblicher Investitionen im Eisenbahnsektor, ein Besorgnis erregender Rückstand beim Bau der anderen Verkehrsachsen und neuen Eisenbahntunnel besteht, die bereits von der Gemeinschaft geplant wurden, wie die Achse Turin-Lyon-Brenner, oder in der Diskussion sind, wie die Achse Aosta-Martigny.
lsp.judge: Regarding the issue of intermodality in crossing the Alps, it must be noted that, apart from Switzerland's decision to invest significantly in the rail sector, there is a concerning backlog in the construction of other transport axes and new railway tunnels that were already planned by the community, such as the Turin-Lyon-Brenner axis, or those currently under discussion, like the Aosta-Martigny axis.

lsp.query: Der Beitrag, den wir somit leisten, hat zwei Konsequenzen, die ich hier hervorheben möchte: Erstens werden wir, wenn wir dank der Methodik, die wir hoffentlich von der Kommission vorgelegt bekommen und akzeptieren können, eine klarere Definition und Anlastung der internen und externen Kosten an die Nutzer erreichen, die Voraussetzungen dafür schaffen, die Finanzierung der Infrastruktur, die gegenwärtig durch die öffentliche Hand gesichert wird bzw. über die allgemeine Besteuerung erfolgt, auf die Benutzer als solche zu verlagern.
lsp.judge: The contribution we thus make has two consequences that I would like to highlight: Firstly, if we, thanks to the methodology that we hope to receive and accept from the Commission, achieve a clearer definition and allocation of both internal and external costs to users, we will create the prerequisites for shifting the financing of the infrastructure, which is currently secured by the public sector or through general taxation, onto users themselves.

lsp.query: Ich verweise hier auf ein Schreiben der Organisation, welche die Automobilclubs, wie zum Beispiel den AA und den RAC, in ganz Europa repräsentiert, und unsere Arbeit sehr begrüßt und unterstützt. Grund für diese Unterstützung ist die Erkenntnis, dass Europa hier mit gutem Beispiel vorangehen muss und wir die besten Konzepte aus der gesamten Europäischen Union zusammentragen müssen, weil andernfalls die Großstädte, die Städte und ländlichen Gebiete auch weiterhin unter unzumutbaren Verkehrsstaus und einer unerträglichen Umweltverschmutzung zu leiden haben werden.

lsp.query: Wenn mir ein gewisser Vergleich mit der Diskussion erlaubt ist, die vor dem Hintergrund der Probleme im Zusammenhang mit der Nahrungsmittelsicherheit über die Reform der Agrarpolitik gegenwärtig nicht nur in Deutschland, sondern auch in einigen weiteren Mitgliedstaaten - mein Land zählt dazu - geführt wird, so prophezeie ich Ihnen angesichts der heutigen Umweltprobleme - trotz gescheiterter Klimakonferenzen - eine ähnliche Situation auch im Bereich der Verkehrspolitik.
lsp.judge: If a comparison with the current discussion on reforming agricultural policy against the background of food security issues, which is not only taking place in Germany but also in several other member states - my country included - is allowed, then I foresee a similar situation in transport policy given today's environmental problems, despite failed climate conferences.

lsp.query: Dabei erwarten wir nicht, sie würden einhellige Zustimmung finden, vielmehr soll vor allem der Kommission signalisiert werden, wie notwendig es ist, in Bälde eine gewisse Koordinierung, wenn nicht gar Harmonisierung dieser Maßnahmen, zu denen unter anderem die kilometerabhängige Schwerverkehrsabgabe zählt, auf europäischer Ebene vorzunehmen, um zu verhindern, dass sie zwar in dem einen, nicht aber in dem anderen Land angewandt werden, dass das eine Land erklärt, die Kosten seien wissenschaftlich nicht berechenbar, während in dem anderen Land die Berechnung ohne weiteres möglich ist, was selbstverständlich eine völlig groteske Situation wäre.
lsp.judge: We do not expect uniform approval, but rather aim to signal to the Commission how urgent it is to soon coordinate, if not harmonize, these measures, including the kilometer-dependent heavy traffic charge, at the European level, to prevent them from being applied in one country but not in another, where one country declares that the costs cannot be scientifically calculated, while in another country the calculation can be done without any difficulty, which would of course be a completely absurd situation.
lsp.proxy: We do not expect them to receive unanimous approval, but rather to signal to the Commission how necessary it is to implement a certain coordination, if not even harmonization, of these measures, which include the kilometer-based heavy goods vehicle toll, at European level in the near future, in order to prevent them from being applied in one country but not in another, with one country claiming that the costs are not scientifically calculable, while in another country the calculation is straightforward, which would, of course, be a completely absurd situation.
