lsp.query: Um es nicht dazu kommen zu lassen, darf unser Ziel nicht darin bestehen, die Verkehrsinfrastrukturkosten zu minimieren, um somit möglichst wenig Kosten anzulasten, sondern wir müssen den Verkehrsbetreibern eine entsprechende Rechtsgrundlage bieten, damit sie die verursachten Kosten der Gruppe anlasten können, die dafür aufzukommen haben, nämlich den Endnutzern.
lsp.judge: To prevent this from happening, our goal must not be to minimize traffic infrastructure costs in order to shift as little cost as possible, but we must provide traffic operators with the appropriate legal basis so that they can pass on the costs incurred to the group responsible for bearing them, namely the end users.
lsp.proxy: To avoid this, our goal must not be to minimize traffic infrastructure costs in order to charge as little as possible, but rather we must provide the transport operators with a corresponding legal basis so that they can charge the costs incurred to the group that has to bear them, namely the end users.
lsp.reference: In order to prevent this from happening, our goal must not be to minimize traffic infrastructure costs so as to assign as few costs as possible, but rather we must provide the operators of the traffic with a corresponding legal basis, so that they can assign the costs caused by the group that is responsible for them, namely the end-users.

lsp.query: Ich möchte die von uns allen mitgetragenen Schwerpunkte noch einmal nennen: Kostenaufteilung in einem direkteren Verhältnis zur Nutzung der Infrastrukturen; Berücksichtigung der sozialen Kosten, aber auch Schutz benachteiligter Gebiete und Bevölkerungsgruppen; Förderung der Umweltverträglichkeit, aber gleichzeitig auch Durchsetzung des Rechts auf Mobilität als Universalrecht.
lsp.judge: I would like to reiterate the focal points that we have all agreed upon: cost allocation in a more direct proportion to the use of infrastructure; consideration of social costs, but also protection for disadvantaged areas and population groups; promotion of environmental sustainability, but at the same time enforcement of the right to mobility as a universal right.

lsp.query: Die soziale Infrastruktur zur Seniorenbetreuung ist auszubauen, und schließlich müssen die Mitgliedstaaten bei der nächsten Regierungskonferenz den Vertrag dahingehend ändern, dass eine solide gesetzliche Basis geschaffen wird, die eine ausgewogene Mitwirkung beider Geschlechter in den institutionellen Organen der Europäischen Union sicherstellt, damit endlich das Selbstverständliche Realität wird, also das natürliche Gleichgewicht der Geschlechter auch in den Machtzentren seinen Niederschlag findet und jedwede die Zukunft Europas betreffenden Entscheidungen nicht ohne Einbeziehung der Frauen gefällt werden.
lsp.judge: The social infrastructure for senior care needs to be expanded, and ultimately, the member states must change the treaty at the next intergovernmental conference to create a solid legal basis that ensures balanced gender representation in the institutional bodies of the European Union, so that finally, the natural balance of genders also finds expression in the centers of power, and any decisions concerning the future of Europe are not made without including women.

lsp.query: Frau Karamanou, ich glaube nicht, dass die schwache Vertretung der Frauen oder auch der Jugendlichen in unseren Parlamenten auf ein Übermaß an Demokratie zurückzuführen ist, sondern auf ein Demokratiedefizit, und die Wahllisten, die von den Parteien aufgestellt werden - die sogar, wie Sie es in Ihrem Bericht empfehlen, als Listen mit einer Quotenregelung aufgestellt werden, wo es nicht einmal mehr möglich ist, eine Vorzugsstimme abzugeben - bilden ein hervorragendes System, um eine proportionale Vertretung der Parteien, d. h. der von den Parteien ausgewählten Funktionäre und Kandidaten, egal ob Frauen oder Männer, in den politischen Organen zu erreichen.
lsp.judge: Ms. Karamanou, I do not believe that the weak representation of women or even young people in our parliaments is due to an excess of democracy, but rather to a democratic deficit. The election lists that parties submit - which, as you recommend in your report, could even be quota-regulated lists where it is no longer possible to cast a preferential vote - form an excellent system to achieve proportional representation of parties, i.e., of the party-selected officials and candidates, whether they are women or men, in political bodies.

lsp.query: Die doppelte Belastung durch familiäre Pflichten und Berufstätigkeit kann man meiner Meinung nach nicht als Diskriminierung bezeichnen, und sie ist auch kein zweifacher Nachteil wie in Erwägungsgrund D dargestellt. Familie und Beruf miteinander verbinden zu können, stellt eher ein hohes Maß an Organisationstalent und eine nicht zu unterschätzende Lebenserfahrung dar, die als besondere Qualifikation für Führungspersönlichkeiten gewertet werden muss.
lsp.judge: The double burden of family duties and professional activity, in my opinion, cannot be described as discrimination, and it is also not a double disadvantage as presented in consideration point D. The ability to combine family and career requires a high level of organizational talent and a significant life experience that must be valued as a special qualification for leadership positions.

lsp.query: Eine Reform der Schulung (beispielsweise Verkehrserziehung bereits in der Schule und Schulung in Notbremsung in der Fahrschule), die Systematisierung der aktiven und passiven Sicherheitselemente auch in einfachen Kraftfahrzeugen durch steuerliche Anreize für die Hersteller oder die Veränderung der Infrastrukturen, indem die "Unfallschwerpunkte " völlig beseitigt werden, das sind die echten Herausforderungen einer intelligenten Politik der Straßenverkehrssicherheit.
lsp.judge: Reforming training (for example, traffic education already in school and training in emergency braking at driving schools), systematizing active and passive safety elements also in simple vehicles through tax incentives for manufacturers or changing infrastructure by completely eliminating "accident hotspots," these are the true challenges of an intelligent policy for road traffic safety.

lsp.query: Diese Problematik ist für den Alpenbereich - und ich komme ja aus dem Alpenbereich - und vor allem in Bezug auf die Alpentransversale München-Verona von ganz besonderer Bedeutung, und wir hoffen, dass sich die Kommission durch das neuerliche Votum, das das Parlament hier zum Ausdruck gebracht hat, veranlasst sieht, die entsprechenden Vorbereitungsarbeiten noch zu beschleunigen und mit viel größerer Konzentration und Stärke voranzutreiben, als es bisher erfolgt ist, damit dieses dringende Problem im Alpenbereich einer Lösung zugeführt werden kann.
lsp.judge: This issue is particularly significant for the Alpine region - and I do come from this region - especially in relation to the transverse Alpine route from Munich to Verona, and we hope that the Commission will be prompted by the new vote expressed by the Parliament here to accelerate the preparatory work even further and to advance it with much greater concentration and strength than has been the case so far, in order to address this urgent problem in the Alpine region.

lsp.query: Lino Miserotti sagte zu mir: "Ich als Rentner finde es richtig, dass ich für die Benutzung dieser Autobahn eine Maut bezahlen muss, denn so leiste ich einen Beitrag zum Bau und zur Unterhaltung von Autobahnen, die eine wichtige Verkehrsinfrastruktur darstellen. Doch es wäre gut, wenn die Arbeitnehmer, die einer Arbeit nachgehen und sich noch nicht im Ruhestand befinden, von der Gebührenzahlung befreit würden. "
lsp.judge: Lino Miserotti told me: "As a retiree, I find it right that I have to pay a toll for using this motorway, because in this way I contribute to the construction and maintenance of motorways, which represent an important transportation infrastructure. However, it would be good if employees who are still working and not yet retired were exempt from paying the toll."
lsp.proxy: Lino Miserotti said to me: "As a retiree, I think it's right that I have to pay a toll for using this highway, because that way I'm contributing to the construction and maintenance of highways, which are an important part of the transportation infrastructure. lsp.query: Aus diesen Gründen kann ich, obwohl ich für viele Änderungsanträge der Fraktion der Grünen/Freie Europäische Allianz, in denen konkrete Maßnahmen gefordert werden, Verständnis habe, diese hier nicht unterstützen, da sie den Konsens in den vorstehend genannten Prinzipien gefährden würden. Sie können später im Verlauf der Umsetzung eines Gebührenrahmens geprüft werden.
lsp.judge: For these reasons, although I understand many of the amendments proposed by the Green/Freie European Alliance faction, which call for specific measures, I cannot support them here as they would jeopardize the consensus in the aforementioned principles. They can be reviewed later during the implementation of a fee framework.

lsp.query: Wenn der Kraftstoffpreis schwindelerregend hoch ist und das Fünf- bis Sechsfache dessen beträgt, was das Benzin beim Verlassen der Raffinerie kostet, weil er sich zu mehr als 80 % aus Steuern zusammensetzt, so kann man wohl sagen, dass der Straßennutzer, gemessen an der Nutzung seines Fahrzeugs, bereits in hohem Maße dafür zur Kasse gebeten wird, dass er öffentliche Straßeninfrastrukturen nutzt.
lsp.judge: When the fuel price is dizzyingly high, and amounts to five to six times what gasoline costs when it leaves the refinery, because it consists of more than 80% taxes, one can say that the road user is already contributing significantly to the cost of using public road infrastructure based on the use of their vehicle.
lsp.proxy: When the fuel price is dizzyingly high and is five to six times what the gasoline costs when leaving the refinery, because it consists of more than 80% taxes, one can well say that the road user, measured by the use of his vehicle, is already being asked to pay a high price for using public road infrastructure.

lsp.query: Für uns sollte dies Anlass ein, unsere Stimme zu erheben, um diese Machenschaften Russlands gegenüber seinem ehemaligen Vasallen zu verurteilen, und durch konkretes Handeln zur politischen Stabilisierung dieser Region und ihrem ökonomischen Aufschwung beizutragen. Und dann sollten wir, wie in der Entschließung vorgeschlagen, einen Sondergesandten für den Südkaukasus benennen, denn ein Flächenbrand im Südkaukasus würde auch Europa nicht verschonen.
lsp.judge: For us, this should serve as an opportunity to raise our voice to condemn Russia's machinations against its former vassal, and through concrete action, contribute to the political stabilization of this region and its economic upswing. And then, as proposed in the resolution, we should appoint a special envoy for the South Caucasus, for a conflagration in the South Caucasus would not spare Europe either.

lsp.judge: So it reads in the resolution motion submitted by highly esteemed colleague Duff on behalf of the ELDR faction: "The European Parliament welcomes the decision of the Turkish government to postpone its controversial plans for transferring prisoners to these prisons and to strive for a 'social consensus on prison reform'."

ilsp.query: Frau Präsidentin! Wie schon mehrere Male zuvor und in meinen mehrfachen Schreiben an Sie zum Ausdruck gebracht, möchte ich auch mit meiner heutigen Wortmeldung darauf hinweisen, dass in der Türkei seit dem 20. Oktober, also seit Monaten, Hunderte unter menschenunwürdigen Bedingungen lebende politische Gefangene in einem Hungerstreik stehen, wobei sie auch den Tod in Kauf nehmen - einige von ihnen sind bereits gestorben -, damit die türkische Regierung ihr Vorhaben, sie in weiße Einzelzellen zu sperren und dadurch ihre Moral und ihren Widerstand zu brechen, nicht verwirklichen kann.
ilsp.judge: Madam President! As I have expressed on several occasions and in my multiple letters to you, I would like to draw your attention once again with today's statement that hundreds of political prisoners in Turkey have been on a hunger strike since October 20th, thus for months, living under inhuman conditions, and are even willing to risk death – some of them have already passed away – in order to prevent the Turkish government from carrying out its plan to confine them to white solitary cells and thereby break their morale and resistance.
ilsp.proxy: Madam President! As I have already expressed several times before and in my multiple letters to you, I would also like to point out with my statement today that in Turkey, since October 20th, thus for months, hundreds of political prisoners living under inhumane conditions have been on a hunger strike, accepting the risk of death - some of them have already died - so that the Turkish government cannot realize its plan to lock them in white single cells and thereby break their morale and resistance.
ilsp.reference: Madam President! As I have already expressed on several occasions and in my multiple written submissions to you, I would like to draw your attention once again today to the fact that in Turkey, hundreds of political prisoners living under inhumane conditions have been on hunger strike since October 20, putting their lives at risk - some of them have already died - in order to prevent the Turkish government from carrying out its plan to imprison them in white solitary cells and thereby break their morale and their resistance.

ilsp.query: Herr Präsident, wir möchten den Ausschuss für Kultur, Jugend, Bildung, Medien und Sport zu der Initiative beglückwünschen, diesen Bericht über den Schutz des Kultur- und Naturerbes in der Europäischen Union zu verfassen, und unserer Berichterstatterin zu den von ihr getroffenen Feststellungen und vorgeschlagenen Maßnahmen, denen ich weitgehend zustimme.
ilsp.judge: Mr. President, we would like to congratulate the Committee on Culture, Youth, Education, Media, and Sport on initiating this report on the protection of cultural and natural heritage in the European Union, and our rapporteur on the findings and proposed measures she has made, with which I largely agree.
ilsp.proxy: Mr President, we would like to congratulate the Committee on Culture, Youth, Education, the Media and Sport on the initiative to draw up this report on the protection of cultural and natural heritage in the European Union, and our rapporteur on the findings and proposed measures she has made, which I largely agree with.
ilsp.reference: Mr. President, we would like to congratulate the Committee on Culture, Youth, Education, Media and Sport on taking the initiative to draft this report on the protection of cultural and natural heritage in the European Union, and our rapporteur on the findings she has made and the proposed measures, to which I largely agree.

ilsp.query: Herr Präsident, ich gratuliere Frau de Veyrac zu ihrer engagierten Erarbeitung des Themas "Übereinkommen zum Schutz des Kultur- und Naturerbes der Welt in den Staaten der Europäischen Union ", denn mit ihrem Bericht wird unterstrichen, wie unerlässlich ein nachhaltiges Eintreten Europas für diese so wichtige Frage ist und welcher Maßnahmen es zudem weltweit bedarf.
ilsp.judge: Mr. President, I congratulate Mrs. de Veyrac on her engaged elaboration of the topic "Convention for the Protection of Cultural and Natural Heritage of Europe in the States of the European Union," for her report underscores how indispensable it is for Europe to take sustained action on this crucial issue and what global measures are also required.
ilsp.proxy: Mr President, I would like to congratulate Mrs de Veyrac on her committed work on the subject of the "Convention for the Protection of the World Cultural and Natural Heritage in the States of the European Union", because her report highlights how essential it is for Europe to take a sustainable stance on this important issue and what measures are also needed worldwide.
ilsp.reference: Mr. President, I congratulate Mrs. de Veyrac on her dedicated work on the topic "Convention for the Protection of the World's Cultural and Natural Heritage in the Member States of the European Union", as her report underscores the importance of Europe's sustainable commitment to this crucial issue and the need for further measures worldwide.

ilsp.query: Ich möchte darauf verweisen, und das wird auch in dem Bericht anerkannt, dass in fünf Bereichen - Rechnungsabschluss, Institutionelle Probleme hinsichtlich Verwaltung und Kontrolle, Büros für Technische Hilfe, partnerschaftlich durchgeführte Verwaltung der Gemeinschaftspolitiken und Bekämpfung von Betrug und Korruption - zwar Fortschritte erzielt worden sind, gleichwohl aber noch eine Menge aufzuarbeiten bleibt.
ilsp.judge: I would like to point out, and this will also be acknowledged in the report, that progress has been made in five areas - final accounts, institutional problems concerning administration and control, offices for technical assistance, jointly managed community policies on a partnership basis, and combating fraud and corruption - yet there is still much to be done.
ilsp.proxy: I would like to point out, and this is also acknowledged in the report, that although progress has been made in five areas - closure of accounts, institutional issues regarding administration and control, technical assistance offices, jointly managed administration of Community policies and the fight against fraud and corruption - there is still a lot to be done.

ilsp.query: Erwiesenermaßen war es richtig, das Büro in Thessaloniki zu belassen, denn hätten wir es nach Pristina ausgelagert, hätte Jugoslawien heute keinerlei Aussicht auf eine finanzielle Unterstützung durch die Agentur für Wiederaufbau, denn kein Serbe könnte jemals nach Pristina reisen, um dort auch nur einen Euro einzufordern.
ilsp.judge: It turned out to be correct to keep the office in Thessaloniki, as if we had relocated it to Pristina, Yugoslavia would have had no chance of receiving any financial support from the Reconstruction Agency today, since no Serb could ever travel to Pristina to claim even a single euro.
ilsp.proxy: It has proven to be correct to leave the office in Thessaloniki, because if we had outsourced it to Pristina, Yugoslavia would have no prospect of financial support from the Reconstruction Agency today, because no Serb could ever travel to Pristina to demand even one euro there.
ilsp.reference: It was undoubtedly the right decision to leave the office in Thessaloniki, because if we had relocated it to Pristina, Yugoslavia would have no prospect of financial support from the Reconstruction Agency, since no Serb could ever travel to Pristina to claim even a single euro.

ilsp.query: Die tiefgreifende politische Umgestaltung der Strukturen der bundesdeutschen Regierung ist ein deutliches Signal dafür, dass es selbst im Herzen Europas, wo die GAP entworfen wurde und wo sie stets ihre große Stütze fand, immer unhaltbarer ist, ein Modell einer Agrarpolitik aufrecht zu erhalten, das zur Bewahrung des industriellen Systems und der großen landwirtschaftlichen Betriebe konzipiert wurde.
ilsp.judge: The profound political restructuring of the federal German government's structures is a clear signal that it is increasingly untenable to maintain an agricultural policy model designed to preserve the industrial system and large agricultural enterprises, even at the heart of Europe where the Common Agricultural Policy was conceived and always found its strong support.
ilsp.proxy: The profound political restructuring of the structures of the West German government is a clear signal that even in the heart of Europe, where the CAP was designed and where it has always found its greatest support, it is becoming increasingly unsustainable to maintain a model of agricultural policy designed to preserve the industrial system and large agricultural enterprises.
ilsp.reference: The far-reaching political restructuring of the federal government's structures is a clear indication that even at the heart of Europe, where the Common Agricultural Policy (CAP) was designed and where it has always found its strong support, it is becoming increasingly unsustainable to maintain a model of agricultural policy that was conceived to preserve the industrial system and large-scale agricultural enterprises.

ilsp.query: Allerdings haben wir Vorbehalte gegenüber europäischen Rechtsvorschriften, die unter dem Vorwand des Schutzes (eines viel zu ausschließlichen Konzepts) der Umwelt nur zur Beseitigung der örtlichen Traditionen und Gebräuche führen, die untrennbarer Bestandteil der Kultur unserer Regionen sind, was ja wohl das Gegenteil dessen wäre, was dieser Bericht anstrebt, den wir unterstützen, aber bei dessen Abstimmung wir uns aus diesem Grunde der Stimme enthalten.
ilsp.judge: However, we have reservations about European regulations that, under the pretext of protecting (a far too exclusive concept) the environment, only lead to the elimination of local traditions and customs, which are an integral part of the culture of our regions, which is certainly the opposite of what this report aims to achieve, which we support, but for whose vote we abstain on this account.
ilsp.proxy: However, we have reservations about European regulations that, under the pretext of protection (of a far too exclusive concept) of the environment, only serve to eliminate local traditions and customs that are an integral part of the culture of our regions, which would indeed be the opposite of what this report, which we support, aims to achieve, but for which we will abstain from voting for this reason.

ilsp.query: (ES) Meine Zustimmung zum Bericht de Veyrac über die Umsetzung des Übereinkommens zum Schutz des Kultur- und Naturerbes der Welt in den Staaten der Europäischen Union basiert auf der Überzeugung, dass es notwendig ist, die kulturelle Dimension der Europäischen Union weiterzuentwickeln und eine Kulturpolitik in der Union zu gewährleisten, die als eines der Hauptmerkmale ihres geistigen Reichtums und des Alten Kontinents die kulturelle, sprachliche, architektonische und künstlerische Vielfalt sowie alle jene Elemente zum Tragen bringt, die unser gemeinsames kulturelles Erbe darstellen.
ilsp.judge: My consent to the de Veyrac report on the implementation of the Convention for the Protection of Cultural and Natural Heritage of World Heritage Sites in the States of the European Union is based on the conviction that it is necessary to further develop the cultural dimension of the European Union and to ensure a culture policy within the Union that, as one of the main features of its spiritual wealth and that of the Old Continent, secures cultural, linguistic, architectural, and artistic diversity as well as all those elements that constitute our common cultural heritage.
ilsp.proxy: (ES) My approval of the de Veyrac report on the implementation of the Convention for the Protection of the World's Cultural and Natural Heritage in the States of the European Union is based on the conviction that it is necessary to further develop the cultural dimension of the European Union and to ensure a cultural policy in the Union that, as one of the main features of its spiritual wealth and the Old Continent, brings to bear the cultural, linguistic, architectural and artistic diversity, as well as all those elements that represent our common cultural heritage.
ilsp.reference: My consent to the report by de Veyrac on the implementation of the Convention for the Protection of the World's Cultural and Natural Heritage in the Member States of the European Union is based on the conviction that it is necessary to further develop the cultural dimension of the European Union and to ensure a cultural policy in the Union that, as one of the main characteristics of its spiritual wealth and the Old Continent, encompasses the cultural, linguistic, architectural, and artistic diversity, as well as all those elements that represent our shared cultural heritage.

ilsp.query: Deshalb bestehe ich darauf, im Rahmen dieser Vereinfachung und Verbesserung der gemeinschaftlichen Rechtsvorschriften im Hinblick auf die in diesem Bericht erwähnte Koordinierung der sozialen Sicherheit zu berücksichtigen, dass es angebracht wäre, wenn ein Arbeitnehmer, der in mehreren Mitgliedstaaten der Europäischen Union beschäftigt war, seine Rente nicht "häppchenweise " in verschiedenen Staaten, sondern von einer einzigen Rentenzahlstelle erhielte.
ilsp.judge: That is why I insist on taking into account, within this simplification and improvement of the community laws concerning the coordination of social security as mentioned in this report, that it would be appropriate for an employee who has been employed in several Member States of the European Union to receive their pension not "piecemeal" in different states, but from a single pension payment office.
ilsp.proxy: I therefore insist that, within the framework of this simplification and improvement of the Community's legal provisions with regard to the coordination of social security mentioned in this report, it would be appropriate to consider that a worker who has been employed in several Member States of the European Union should receive his pension not "piecemeal" in various countries, but from a single pension payment office.
ilsp.reference: Therefore, I insist that, in the context of this simplification and improvement of the community regulations regarding the coordination of social security mentioned in this report, it would be appropriate for an employee who has been employed in several member states of the European Union to receive their pension not "piecemeal" in various states, but from a single pension payment office.

ilsp.query: Da die Debatte zudem öffentlich ist und von einer konsternierten europäischen Öffentlichkeit verfolgt wird, sind wir meines Erachtens folglich alle verpflichtet, den Hohen Vertreter der Gemeinsamen Außen- und Sicherheitspolitik der Europäischen Union, der bis vor kurzem NATO-Generalsekretär war und gegen den nach Aussage der Staatsanwältin in der Zeitung "La Repubblica " und anderenorts eine Untersuchung des Internationalen Gerichtshofs in Den Haag wegen einer Klage aufgrund von Verbrechen gegen die Menschlichkeit anhängig ist, aufzufordern, uns - damit man uns nicht der Mittäterschaft beschuldigen kann - darzulegen, wie er als Generalsekretär der NATO einem "Mini "Atomkrieg auf dem Balkan zustimmen konnte.
ilsp.judge: Since the debate is also public and being watched by a shocked European public, we are, in my opinion, all obliged to request that the High Representative of the European Union's Common Foreign and Security Policy, who until recently was the NATO Secretary-General and against whom, according to the statement of the prosecutor in the newspaper "La Repubblica" and elsewhere, an investigation by the International Court of Justice in The Hague is pending due to a complaint of crimes against humanity, explain how, as NATO Secretary-General, he could have agreed to a "mini" nuclear war on the Balkans.

ilsp.reference: Given that the debate is public and being followed by a stunned European public, we are, in my opinion, all obliged to call on the High Representative of the Common Foreign and Security Policy of the European Union, who was recently the NATO Secretary-General and against whom an investigation by the International Court of Justice in The Hague is pending due to a complaint of crimes against humanity, as stated by the prosecutor in the newspaper "La Repubblica" and elsewhere, to explain to us - so that we cannot be accused of complicity - how he could agree to a "mini" nuclear war in the Balkans as NATO Secretary-General.

ilsp.query: Daraus geht eindeutig hervor, zu wessen Gunsten hier die "Engpässe in der Infrastruktur ", insbesondere in den "Verkehrs- und Energieinfrastrukturen " beseitigt, das "Finanzsystem effizient " gestaltet oder "transparente und demokratische institutionelle Rahmenbedingungen " geschaffen werden sollen, ein Euphemismus, mit dem man sich angesichts der allgegenwärtigen Korruption gegen sämtliche Beeinträchtigungen der westlichen Investoren wendet.
ilsp.judge: It is clear that the removal of "constraints in infrastructure," particularly in "transport and energy infrastructure," the "efficient shaping of the financial system," or the creation of "transparent and democratic institutional frameworks" is intended for the benefit of someone, an euphemism used to shield against all disruptions to Western investors in the face of pervasive corruption.
ilsp.proxy: It clearly emerges in whose favour the "bottlenecks in infrastructure", particularly in "transport and energy infrastructure", are to be eliminated, the "financial system made efficient" or "transparent and democratic institutional framework conditions" created, an euphemism with which one addresses all the impairments to Western investors in view of the omnipresent corruption.
ilsp.reference: It is clearly evident here whose interests are being served by eliminating the "bottlenecks in the infrastructure," particularly in the "traffic and energy infrastructures," by making the "financial system efficient" or by creating "transparent and democratic institutional frameworks," a euphemism used to address all the obstacles faced by Western investors in the face of ubiquitous corruption.

ilsp.query: Was den Wunsch nach Verzicht auf eine geographische Begrenzung für diese schnelle Eingreiftruppe anbelangt, so erinnert dies an die Raubzüge der früheren Kolonialmächte in Afrika und anderswo, wie sie etwa von Frankreich begangen wurden, um vom Volk abgelehnte Diktatoren zu schützen, oder wie sie derzeit von Großbritannien in Sierra Leone durchgeführt werden.
ilsp.judge: Regarding the desire to forgo a geographical limitation for this rapid reaction force, this reminds us of the plundering expeditions of former colonial powers in Africa and elsewhere, such as those carried out by France to protect despotic leaders rejected by the people, or as they are currently conducted by the United Kingdom in Sierra Leone.
ilsp.proxy: As for the desire to waive geographical restrictions for this rapid intervention force, this is reminiscent of the raids of former colonial powers in Africa and elsewhere, such as those committed by France to protect dictators rejected by the people, or as currently being carried out by Great Britain in Sierra Leone.

ilsp.query: Der Vorschlag für eine Verordnung zur Schaffung der Sonderfazilität für Kriseneinsätze ist nichts anderes als der Rahmen für zwar nichtmilitärische, aber nichtsdestoweniger imperialistische politische und wirtschaftliche Interventionen in jedem beliebigen Teil der Welt. Was die führenden Kreise der EU anstreben, ist ein Mechanismus zur sofortigen Mobilisierung von Human- und Finanzressourcen, der rasch eingesetzt werden kann, und zwar nicht nur in "Krisensituationen " (vielleicht könnten uns die Verfasser des Textes einmal sagen, welche Merkmale eine "Krisensituation " kennzeichnen), sondern auch dann, wenn lediglich eine Bedrohung oder selbst nur eine Beeinträchtigung der so genannten Unterstützungs- und Kooperationsprogramme mit diesen Ländern zu befürchten ist.
ilsp.judge: The proposal for a regulation establishing the special facility for crisis operations is nothing but the framework for non-military, yet no less imperialist political and economic interventions in any part of the world. What the leading circles of the EU aim for is a mechanism for immediate mobilization of human and financial resources that can be deployed quickly, not only in "crisis situations" (perhaps the authors of the text could tell us once what characteristics define a "crisis situation"), but also when merely a threat or even just an impairment of the so-called support and cooperation programs with these countries is to be feared.

ilsp.query: Abgesehen davon spricht der Entschließungsantrag kurz überaus ernste Fragen im Zusammenhang mit der Analyse und der notwendigen Erforschung von abgereichertem Uran an, geht aber an keiner Stelle auf die fortgesetzten Bemühungen ein, Tatsachen, unabhängige, uns allen bekannte Forschungsarbeiten, ja sogar wissenschaftliche Abhandlungen aus NATO-Ländern zu verschleiern und zu verheimlichen, die die Gefährlichkeit von abgereichertem Uran nachweisen und Vorsorgemaßnahmen nennen, die diese Länder ihren Streitkräften auferlegen.
ilsp.judge: Apart from that, the resolution motion briefly touches on extremely serious issues related to the analysis and necessary research of enriched uranium, but nowhere addresses the ongoing efforts to conceal and hide facts, independent research works known to all of us, and even scientific papers from NATO countries that demonstrate the danger of enriched uranium and preventive measures that these countries impose on their armed forces.
ilsp.proxy: Apart from that, the resolution proposal briefly addresses extremely serious questions related to the analysis and necessary research of depleted uranium, but does not address anywhere the continued efforts to conceal and hide facts, independent, well-known research works, even scientific papers from NATO countries that prove the dangers of depleted uranium and name precautionary measures that these countries impose on their armed forces.
ilsp.reference: Apart from that, the resolution proposal briefly addresses extremely serious questions related to the analysis and necessary research of depleted uranium, but it does not address the continued efforts to conceal and cover up facts, independent and well-known research works, yes, even scientific papers from NATO countries, which demonstrate the danger of depleted uranium and recommend preventive measures that these countries impose on their armed forces.

ilsp.query: Der von mir bereits erwähnte Beschluss besagt, dass ein Bürger eines EU-Mitgliedstaates, der sich um konsularische Hilfe an eine diplomatische oder konsularische Vertretung eines anderen Mitgliedstaates wendet, so zu behandeln ist, als wäre er Bürger des Landes, das durch die betreffende Botschaft oder das Konsulat vertreten wird.
ilsp.judge: The resolution I have already mentioned states that a citizen of an EU member state who seeks consular assistance from a diplomatic or consular representation of another member state should be treated as if they were a citizen of the country represented by the embassy or consulate.
ilsp.proxy: The decision I have already mentioned states that a citizen of an EU member state who seeks consular assistance from a diplomatic or consular mission of another member state is to be treated as if he were a citizen of the country represented by the embassy or consulate in question.
ilsp.reference: The decision I mentioned earlier states that a citizen of an EU member state who seeks consular assistance from a diplomatic or consular representation of another member state is to be treated as if they were a citizen of the country represented by the relevant embassy or consulate.

ilsp.query: Der Rat begrüßt außerdem die Tatsache, dass sich die EU und die ASEAN in ihrer in Vientiane beschlossenen gemeinsamen Erklärung verpflichten, die Bemühungen des Sonderbeauftragten des UNO-Generalsekretärs für Birma, Tan Sri Razali Ismail, um eine positive Entwicklung in Burma zu unterstützen.
ilsp.judge: The Council also welcomes that the EU and the ASEAN have committed themselves in their joint declaration adopted in Vientiane to support the efforts of the Special Adviser of the UN Secretary-General for Myanmar, Tan Sri Razali Ismail, to promote a positive development in Myanmar.
ilsp.proxy: The Council also welcomes the fact that the EU and ASEAN, in their joint declaration adopted in Vientiane, undertook to support the efforts of the UN Secretary-General's Special Envoy for Burma, Tan Sri Razali Ismail, towards a positive development in Burma.
ilsp.reference: The Council also welcomes the fact that the EU and ASEAN have committed themselves in their joint statement adopted in Vientiane to supporting the efforts of the UN Secretary-General's Special Envoy for Myanmar, Tan Sri Razali Ismail, to promote a positive development in Myanmar.

ilsp.query: Meines Erachtens wird hierdurch deutlich, dass die Verkehrssicherheit nicht mit herausgegriffenen Einzelmaßnahmen im erforderlichen Maße erhöht werden kann, sondern dass dies nur durch einen ganzen Komplex von Maßnahmen machbar ist, und dazu gehören Verkehrserziehung, Geschwindigkeitsbegrenzung, Alkoholbegrenzung, besserer Straßenausbau, Verkehrsleitsysteme, erhöhter Sicherheitsstandard der Fahrzeuge, stärkere Kontrollen der Einhaltung der Straßenverkehrsordnung und auch eine permanente Begutachtung der Fahrzeuge, die sich im Straßenverkehr befinden.
ilsp.judge: In my opinion, it becomes clear here that traffic safety cannot be increased sufficiently through makeshift individual measures alone, but can only be achieved through a comprehensive range of measures, which include traffic education, speed limits, alcohol limits, better road infrastructure, traffic control systems, higher vehicle safety standards, stronger enforcement of traffic regulations, and also continuous inspection of vehicles in circulation.
ilsp.proxy: In my opinion, this makes it clear that road safety cannot be sufficiently increased by isolated individual measures, but rather that this can only be achieved through a comprehensive package of measures, which includes traffic education, speed limits, alcohol limits, improved road construction, traffic guidance systems, a higher safety standard for vehicles, stricter controls on compliance with the road traffic regulations, and also a permanent inspection of vehicles in road traffic.
ilsp.reference: In my opinion, it becomes clear that road safety cannot be increased to the required extent by isolated individual measures, but rather that this can only be achieved through a comprehensive set of measures, including traffic education, speed limits, alcohol restrictions, improved road infrastructure, traffic management systems, enhanced vehicle safety standards, stricter enforcement of traffic regulations, and also a permanent inspection of vehicles that are in operation on the roads.

ilsp.query: In unserer Stellungnahme wollten wir die gesamte Herstellungskette der Forstwirtschaft einschließlich der Waldpflege und Holzgewinnung sowie der Bedeutung von Rentabilität der Forstwirtschaft als Rohstoffgrundlage herausstellen, gründet sich doch eine nachhaltige europäische Forstwirtschaft nach wie vor auf die sogenannte "Familienwirtschaft " von zwölf Millionen privaten Waldbesitzern und ihrer Tätigkeit.
ilsp.judge: In our statement, we aimed to highlight the entire forestry production chain, including forest management and timber harvesting, as well as the significance of the profitability of private forest owners and their activities as the foundation for a sustainable European forestry sector.
ilsp.proxy: In our statement, we wanted to highlight the entire production chain of forestry, including forest care and wood harvesting, as well as the importance of the profitability of forestry as a raw material base, as sustainable European forestry is still based on the so-called "family economy" of twelve million private forest owners and their activities.
ilsp.reference: In our statement, we wanted to highlight the entire production chain of forestry, including forest management and wood harvesting, as well as the importance of forestry profitability as a raw material basis, since a sustainable European forestry system still relies on the so-called "family forestry" of twelve million private forest owners and their activities.

ilsp.query: Herr Kollege Posselt, selbst wenn es wirklich eine Bereicherung wäre, wenn Sie 20 Minuten redeten - ich könnte ja dann auch 20 Minuten reden, weil auch von unserer Fraktion keiner mehr da ist -, wäre es in der Tat so, dass die Arbeit, die der Kollege Deprez sehr sorgfältig durchgeführt hat, hier nicht in dem Maße diskutiert werden könnte, wie es angemessen wäre.
ilsp.judge: Mr. Colleague Posselt, even if it would indeed be a enrichment if you spoke for 20 minutes - I could then also speak for 20 minutes, since none of our faction members are still here either - it would still be the case that the work that colleague Deprez has carried out very carefully would not be discussed to the extent that would be appropriate.

ilsp.query: Vor allem für die Angehörigen der Opfer ist es nämlich unerträglich, dass noch keiner der Kommandeure der Roten Khmer für die von ihnen verübten Verbrechen bestraft worden ist und die Hauptschuldigen am Genozid völlig unbehelligt in Kambodscha leben, ganz zu schweigen von der Beteiligung ehemaliger Roter Khmer an der Regierung.
ilsp.judge: Es ist besonders für die relatives der Opfer unerträglich, dass bis heute keiner der Kommandeure der Roten Khmer für die von ihnen begangenen Verbrechen verantwortlich gemacht wurde und die Hauptverantwortlichen am Genozid in Kambodscha ungestraft leben, geschweige denn, dass ehemalige Roter Khmer an der Regierung beteiligt waren.
ilsp.proxy: Above all, it is unbearable for the relatives of the victims that none of the commanders of the Red Khmer have been punished for the crimes they committed and that those mainly responsible for the genocide live completely untroubled in Cambodia, not to mention the participation of former Red Khmer in the government.
ilsp.reference: Above all, it is unbearable for the relatives of the victims that none of the commanders of the Khmer Rouge have been punished for the crimes they committed, and that the main perpetrators of the genocide are completely unharmed and living in Cambodia, not to mention the involvement of former Khmer Rouge members in the government.

ilsp.query: Herr Präsident, die Älteren unter uns haben die außergewöhnlichen, grauenhaften Berichte, die 1975 aus Kambodscha kamen, noch nicht vergessen. Es gab Luftaufnahmen von einer verlassenen Hauptstadt, weil die Roten Khmer, deren Anführer nach den Lehrsätzen der Gewalt in der Tradition der französischen Revolution geschult wurden und von einer Mischung aus politischem Idealismus und Massenpsychopathologie erfüllt waren, zwei Millionen Menschen von der Stadt auf das Land umsiedelten, um unter der Führung des "großen " Pol Pot im Jahre Null mit einer neuen Gesellschaft zu beginnen.
ilsp.judge: Mr. President, those of us who are older have not yet forgotten the extraordinary and horrific reports that came from Cambodia in 1975. There were aerial photographs of an abandoned capital city, as the Khmer Rouge, whose leaders were trained in the tradition of violence according to the principles of the French Revolution and were filled with a mixture of political idealism and mass psychopathy, relocated two million people from the city to the countryside, under the leadership of "Great" Pol Pot, to begin a new society in the year zero.

ilsp.query: Wir warten vergebens auf den einzigen geeigneten Vorschlag, um die gesamte Region zu stabilisieren, um vor die Tore Tschetscheniens zu gelangen, um der russischen Umklammerung dieser Region ein Ende zu setzen, den einzigen seriösen Vorschlag, der darin bestünde, dass Georgien offiziell vorgeschlagen wird, der Europäischen Union beizutreten.
ilsp.judge: We wait in vain for the single appropriate proposal to stabilize the entire region, to reach the gates of Chechnya, to put an end to Russia's stranglehold on this region, the only serious proposal that Georgia should officially be suggested to join the European Union.
